chapters.title: Chapter 1451: Huo Xiaoyu’s Arrival
paragraphs: Qi Qingxiu wanted to go pick up Feng Shanxi and the others, but Zhang Fei stopped her because someone had already picked them up, confusing her.
After a while, two women brought Feng Shanxi and her entourage, which caused the demihumans around the shop to fall silent, especially after they saw their dresses.
From their dresses, the demihumans could recognize their identities as part of the Blazing Nirvana Domain, and none of them dared to say anything, even though the two women were human.

The demihumans wondered about the arrival of the two women, especially Zhang Fei’s relationship with the people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain. They heard of the women’s actions some time ago, and they had slaughtered countless cultivators from various domains who had tried to attack them in the past.

Long Xiaolian was also shocked by the presence of the two women, and she stole glances at Zhang Fei, wondering in her heart about her relationship with Empress Huo Yanling and the people of the Blazing Nirvana Domain. ’How... how did he know the women of that domain?’
Jia Yuyan, Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue laughed in their hearts after they saw Long Xiaolian’s shocked expression.

Huo Xiaoyu and the other woman ignored the demihumans’ stares and led Feng Shanxi and her entourage into the shop. "Zhang Fei, our empress ordered Huo Fengyin and me to stay in this domain, specifically to protect your shop and your people."

"She told me that she would send you to this domain, but she didn’t tell me she would send anyone else. Even so, I’m glad you two are here, and I feel confident leaving my people here." Zhang Fei glanced at Huo Fengyin, but she maintained a stiff expression. "Did something happen to her?"

Huo Xiaoyu put her arm around Huo Fengyin’s shoulder and answered Zhang Fei. "Fengyin lost her vocal cord because an evil person damaged it in the past, so she hasn’t been able to speak since then. Moreover, she has never left our domain, and she has never met anyone else, so I hope you can understand her."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows for a moment and reached out his hand to Huo Fengyin, but she shifted away and hid behind Huo Xiaoyu. "You don’t have to be afraid of me, okay? You’re her subordinate, so I would never do anything bad to you, and I just want to check on your condition."

Huo Xiaoyu pulled Huo Fengyin forward and spoke to her. "You heard our empress’s words yesterday, right? She sent you here to meet Zhang Fei because he might have a solution to cure you, so you should let him examine your body."
Upon hearing that, Huo Fengyin nodded to Huo Xiaoyu and extended her right hand to Zhang Fei, but she trembled as their hands almost touched each other due to her past trauma.
Zhang Fei knew that all of Feng Yao’s followers were victims of past violence, but he was surprised to find that among them, Huo Fengyin was particularly afraid of men due to her trauma.

Zhang Fei grabbed Hui Fengyin’s hand and channeled his light element into her body, surprising her. Her body quickly stopped shaking, and she felt an incredible sense of calm, and she had never felt so calm since the incident that had happened to her in the past. ’Can I regrow her vocal cord with my body modification ability?’

[You are asking a stupid question, master.] Zhang Fei’s expression darkened when Mei made that comment. [You can even turn a man into a woman and vice versa, so regenerating this woman’s vocal cords is the most trivial thing. However, she hasn’t spoken for too long, so she might need to adapt to speaking again.]

Zhang Fei didn’t answer Mei and used his body modification ability on Huo Fengyin directly, making her feel a little uncomfortable as something grew inside her mouth. She wanted to pull her hand back, but he grabbed it tightly and held her back. "Don’t move."
Huo Xiaoyu sighed slightly and restricted Huo Fengyin’s movements because she was stronger than Zhang Fei, but she was not stronger than her.
A few minutes later, Zhang Fei let go of Huo Fengyin’s hand. "Try to talk now."
Huo Fengyin looked at Zhang Fei angrily because Huo Xiaoyu had already explained to her that she didn’t have vocal cords, but he asked her to try speaking, which was clearly impossible.

"You should try speaking now, Fengyin." Huo Fengyin turned to Huo Xiaoyu with a frown. "Are you doubting our empress’ words? She said that Zhang Fei can treat you and make you talk again, so you should believe her. If you doubt her words, I will report you to her, and she will lock you up in the dungeon."

Huo Fengyin shuddered after hearing Huo Xiaoyu’s words, and she looked at Zhang Fei again with her mouth slightly open. Even though her empress said that he could cure her, she still doubted his abilities.
"I—" Huo Fengyin was stunned as soon as she heard her voice, and she looked at Zhang Fei in shock.
Huo Xiaoyu breathed a sigh of relief and released Huo Fengyin from her restrictions, and she looked at Zhang Fei in admiration because he could do something that other healers could not.

Zhang Fei smiled at Huo Fengyin. "You’ve recovered now, and you can speak again. However, you haven’t spoken for a long time, so you might need some time to adapt, and you’ll be able to speak fluently after some time."
"Thank... you..." After saying that, Huo Fengyin fell to her knees and sobbed. "Sob... Xiaoyu, I can speak again... Sob..."
Huo Xiaoyu rubbed her head. "Silly girl! Our empress will never lie to us, you know? She said that Zhang Fei could help you, but you didn’t believe her, and you finally proved it yourself."
"Sob... Yes..." Huo Fengyin nodded her head several times and continued to cry.

Huo Xiaoyu shook her head at Huo Fengyin’s appearance, but she didn’t stop her from crying. "Thank you for healing her and allowing her to speak again, Zhang Fei. You don’t need to worry about your shop and your people because we will protect them, and our empress ordered us to kill anyone who dares to touch them."
The demihumans outside the building were shocked when they heard Huo Xiaoyu’s words, and they fled in droves with their tails between their legs, as they were truly frightened of her.

Long Xiaolian had already heard about the cruelty of the women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, so she felt fearful of Huo Xiaoyu. She immediately hid behind Qi Qingxiu and hugged her arm tightly, amusing her.
"You don’t need to thank me." Zhang Fei looked at Feng Shanxi and her party. "Why did you come with them to this domain, Ren Xiyi?"
"Haha." Ren Xiyi laughed while rubbing her head. "I was bored of staying in our domain, so I decided to come here with Feng Shanxi and the others to relieve my boredom."
Zhang Fei sighed softly. "Do Old Ren and your mother know that you went to this domain?"
"Of course! Do you think I can leave without their permission?"

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding before turning to Long Xiaolan, but she was hiding behind Qi Qingxiu. ’This woman is truly terrified of Huo Xiaoyu.’ "Second princess, you don’t need to be afraid of them; they are my friends, and they won’t do anything to you."
"But—"

"That’s enough." Qi Qingxiu interrupted and pulled Long Xiaolian forward. "You are a cultivator and a princess, so you must maintain your dignity. They are indeed stronger than you, and they are also cruel. However, they won’t do anything bad to you as long as you don’t do anything wrong, so you don’t need to be afraid of them."
"Moreover, you have the fire dragon bloodline in your body, and a dragon is not a timid creature." Jia Yuyan spoke.

Long Xiaolian pursed her lips after hearing Jia Yuyan’s words. "I do have the fire dragon bloodline, but I’m not a true dragon. They’re as powerful as my parents, and that woman’s words just now were extremely frightening."
"Hahaha." Huo Xiaoyu laughed at that. "You haven’t met my empress yet; you’ll probably be even more frightened in her presence."

Long Xiaolian wanted to say something to Huo Xiaoyu, but a crimson flame suddenly shot out from Zhang Fei’s body and transformed into Feng Yao. She jumped slightly and hid behind Qi Qingxiu again, making her feel helpless with her behavior. ’Is... is this woman Empress Huo Yanling? How... how could she be inside Zhang Fei’s body?’

Feng Yao looked at Long Xiaolian and gave her a playful smile, causing the second princess of the demihuman race to be even more afraid of her. She ignored the princess, turned to Huo Fengyin, lifted her to her feet, and wiped her tears.
"Empress, I—"
Feng Yao placed her index finger on Huo Fengyin’s lips. "Are you happy now? Even though you have to wait so long, you can finally talk again like before."
Huo Fengyin nodded her head strongly and hugged Feng Yao, who immediately hugged her back. "Thank you, Empress. I will not disappoint you; I will protect these people and shop."
"I believed you would protect them, so I sent you and Xiaoyu here." Feng Yao turned to Zhang Fei. "The two of them are enough to protect your people, and no one can hurt them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1452: Meeting
paragraphs: "Since you sent them here, I will hand over the protection of my people to them." Feng Yao looked at Long Xiaolan again, sent a voice message to Zhang Fei, and turned into a crimson flame before entering his body. ’Mei, show her status again.’
[There’s nothing special about this woman, Master.]
Name: Long Xiaolian
Gender: Female
Race: Demihuman
Cultivation: 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm
Elements:
> Fire [Peak Stage]
> Wind [Peak Stage]
Elemental Laws:
> Fire [Perfection Stage]
>Wind [Half-Perfection Stage]
Cores:
> Fire Core [Upper Rank]
> Wind Core [Upper Rank]
Physique: Demihuman
Elemental Spirit:
> Fire Dragon Spirit
’Hmm? What does Feng Yao mean about this woman?’ Zhang Fei inwardly wondered.

Long Xiaolian raised an eyebrow when she noticed Zhang Fei’s gaze on her, and she looked down at her body, not understanding why he was looking at her like that. ’Why is he looking at me like that? Is he interested in me? He’s handsome, but he’s a man with many wives, so I’ll never be attracted to him.’

Zhang Fei shook his head and turned to Feng Shanxi. "As I explained to you last night, I got this shop because I promised their Emperor to teach the alchemists of this kingdom. I asked you to this domain because you were the only mythical beast on my side who mastered alchemy, and I wanted you to teach them more about that field. However, you don’t need to teach them if they underestimate you, let alone doubt your abilities."
"Yes." Feng Shanxi nodded and asked him. "Are you going to sell all your pills in this shop?"

Zhang Fei thought for some time before making a decision, and he handed a storage ring to Feng Shanxi. "For now, I will only sell my basic pills in this shop, and you can sell all the pills you have concocted since you ascended to the alchemist god. You don’t need to give me the proceeds from this shop, and you can keep them all for yourself."
"Eh?" Feng Shanxi was surprised to hear that, but Zhang Fei immediately sent her a voice transmission and explained some things to her. "I understand."
Zhang Fei spoke to her again. "I’ve inspected this building, and it’s ready for us to open our shop. You can start arranging all the pills, and we’ll open this shop today."

"Alright." Feng Shanxi turned to Ren Xiyi and the others, distributing many kinds of pills to them. However, she did not hand over Zhang Fei’s basic pills to them, and she would sell them on a limited basis. "Let’s start now."
Zhang Fei looked at Huo Xiaoyu and Huo Fengyin. "I’ll take my five wives away now, and I’ll leave the protection of this shop to the two of you."
"Leave it to us."
After Zhang Fei took the six women away, Huo Fengyin asked Huo Xiaoyu. "Xiaoyu, I still don’t understand how he managed to repair my vocal cords and make me speak again."

"Hehe." Huo Xiaoyu chuckled, put her arm around Huo Fengyin’s shoulders, and led her outside. "Do you think our empress’s husband is an ordinary man? Honestly, I don’t know much about him or his abilities, but our empress has high confidence in him. Since she trusts him, we both should trust him too. Moreover, he has restored your vocal cords so you can speak normally, so we have to carry out our duties well, and we have to protect the people in this shop from those bad people."
Huo Fengyin became serious and turned into the shop. "Whoever dares disturb them, I will kill them all, no matter the identity of those people."
"I agree with you." Huo Xiaoyu nodded in response. "We should leave and watch them from afar; otherwise, those demihumans won’t dare come to this shop."
"Let’s go."
Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying, who were in a meeting with the demihuman dignitaries of their kingdom, looked at a man with a half-wolf, half-human appearance who had walked in hurriedly.
"What happened, Hong Shi? Why are you in such a hurry?" Long Huoyan asked the man.

Hong Shi saluted Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying, reporting the appearance of two human women in the building that would become Zhang Fei’s shop. His report shocked the two leaders and everyone present in the room, especially after he told them that the two women were wearing dresses from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, meaning they were subordinates of Empress Huo Yanling.
"Are you sure about what you saw?"

"Yes." Hong Shi nodded. "Empress, I’ve met several women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain in the past, so I can’t possibly mistake the symbols on the backs of their dresses. They are indeed subordinates of Empress Huo Yanling, and they seem to have a close relationship with Zhang Fei."
After Hong Shi made that statement, the atmosphere in the room grew noisy as everyone present started to question Zhang Fei’s true identity and his relationship with Empress Huo Yanling.
Huo Jinying looked at her husband, who asked her to contact Long Xiaolan and ask about the truth. Long Huoyan then asked the man again. "What are those two women doing in that building?"

"According to witnesses who observed the incident at the building earlier, Zhang Fei cured one of the women of her muteness." Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying were utterly shocked to hear that. "The woman’s friend told him that an evil cultivator had made her mute by destroying her vocal cords, but he managed to restore her vocal cords, allowing her to speak again. I don’t know how he did it, but witnesses said that he simply held her hand, and she suddenly regained her voice."

"Husband." Long Huoyan turned to Huo Jinying, who immediately informed him of Long Xiaolan’s information. "The names of those two women are Huo Xiaoyu and Huo Fengyin, and they are indeed members of the Blazing Nirvana Domain. Moreover, Empress Huo Yanling also appeared in that building after everyone left, and she emerged from Zhang Fei’s body."
"What?" Long Huoyan and everyone present were shocked to hear that. "Did Empress Huo Yanling really come out of Zhang Fei’s body?"

"Xiaolan couldn’t possibly lie to us, husband." Long Huoyan knew that his second daughter was not a liar, but he could hardly believe it. "After Empress Huo Yanling finished speaking to her two subordinates, she disappeared into Zhang Fei’s body again. Moreover, Xiaolan said that she felt a strong pressure on her bloodline when she appeared, and she guessed that she was a pure beast with the same bloodline as mine."
"Phoenix or golden crow?"

"Phoenix." Huo Jinying paused for a moment before continuing. "However, I’m confused by that because Xiaolan said that Empress Huo Yanling’s appearance and departure were marked by a crimson flame, but no phoenix possesses a crimson flame. I forgot to tell you that Zhang Fei has several other beast bloodlines in his body, and two of them are the phoenix and golden crow bloodlines. I have both bloodlines in my body, so I can sense them clearly."

"Yes." Long Huoyan nodded at her. "In fact, I also sensed the fire dragon bloodline in Zhang Fei’s body when I spoke to him last night, and I also sensed other bloodlines from him, but I can’t confirm them all. If you’re right that he has the phoenix bloodline in his body, he most likely got it from Empress Huo Yanling."
Huo Jinying told him something else. "Xiaolan also told me that Zhang Fei invited a female alchemist to take care of his shop, and she is a pure fire phoenix."
"Hmm?" Long Huoyan instantly fell into contemplation. "If you are correct that Empress Huo Yanling is a phoenix, that woman is most likely one of her relatives."

"For now, all of this is still just our guesses, but I think we should secure a favorable relationship with Zhang Fei, which will be very beneficial for our demihuman race." Long Huoyan agreed with Huo Jinying. "After this, you should go meet Sister Yingwu, and we will send Xiaolan to the Moonlit Passion Sect as our ambassador."

Long Huoyan did not immediately give Huo Jinying an answer, and he thought about the pros and cons first. He was reluctant to send his second daughter to the sect, but he needed someone to establish a better relationship with Zhang Fei.

Long Huoyan thought about sending Long Lingxun, but he couldn’t possibly do it because there were several demons in the Moonlit Passion Temple, and his presence in the sect would actually bring trouble among them.
Long Huoyan considered sending his second daughter and son-in-law there, but they had a young child, so he couldn’t send them because their child would be disturbed.
Si Yingwu suddenly walked into the room, and the high-ranking officials of the demihuman race hurriedly stood up from their seats. They bowed their heads, paying their respects to her.
Si Yingwu said nothing to them and immediately approached Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying. "Husband, I want you to send Xiaolan to the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Why do you want to send our daughter to that sect, Wife?" Long Huoyan asked with a frown.

Si Yingwu let out a soft sigh. "I understand your concern for our daughter’s safety, but I’m sure Xiaolan will be fine in that sect. Moreover, she doesn’t harbor hatred for demons like her big brother or the rest of our race, so I feel that she is a suitable person to be our representative, and I want her to gain new experiences there."

"Whoever dares disturb them, I will kill them all, no matter the identity of those people."
"I agree with you." Huo Xiaoyu nodded in response.
"We should leave and watch them from afar; otherwise, those demihumans won’t dare come to this shop."
"Let’s go."
Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying, who were in a meeting with the demihuman dignitaries of their kingdom, looked at a man with a half-wolf, half-human appearance who had walked in hurriedly.
"What happened, Hong Shi?
Why are you in such a hurry?" Long Huoyan asked the man.
Hong Shi saluted Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying, reporting the appearance of two human women in the building that would become Zhang Fei’s shop.

His report shocked the two leaders and everyone present in the room, especially after he told them that the two women were wearing dresses from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, meaning they were subordinates of Empress Huo Yanling.
"Are you sure about what you saw?"
"Yes." Hong Shi nodded.
"Empress, I’ve met several women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain in the past, so I can’t possibly mistake the symbols on the backs of their dresses.
They are indeed subordinates of Empress Huo Yanling, and they seem to have a close relationship with Zhang Fei."
After Hong Shi made that statement, the atmosphere in the room grew noisy as everyone present started to question Zhang Fei’s true identity and his relationship with Empress Huo Yanling.
Huo Jinying looked at her husband, who asked her to contact Long Xiaolan and ask about the truth.
Long Huoyan then asked the man again.
"What are those two women doing in that building?"
"According to witnesses who observed the incident at the building earlier, Zhang Fei cured one of the women of her muteness." Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying were utterly shocked to hear that.
"The woman’s friend told him that an evil cultivator had made her mute by destroying her vocal cords, but he managed to restore her vocal cords, allowing her to speak again.
I don’t know how he did it, but witnesses said that he simply held her hand, and she suddenly regained her voice."
"Husband." Long Huoyan turned to Huo Jinying, who immediately informed him of Long Xiaolan’s information.
"The names of those two women are Huo Xiaoyu and Huo Fengyin, and they are indeed members of the Blazing Nirvana Domain.
Moreover, Empress Huo Yanling also appeared in that building after everyone left, and she emerged from Zhang Fei’s body."
"What?" Long Huoyan and everyone present were shocked to hear that.
"Did Empress Huo Yanling really come out of Zhang Fei’s body?"
"Xiaolan couldn’t possibly lie to us, husband." Long Huoyan knew that his second daughter was not a liar, but he could hardly believe it.
"After Empress Huo Yanling finished speaking to her two subordinates, she disappeared into Zhang Fei’s body again.
Moreover, Xiaolan said that she felt a strong pressure on her bloodline when she appeared, and she guessed that she was a pure beast with the same bloodline as mine."
"Phoenix or golden crow?"
"Phoenix." Huo Jinying paused for a moment before continuing.
"However, I’m confused by that because Xiaolan said that Empress Huo Yanling’s appearance and departure were marked by a crimson flame, but no phoenix possesses a crimson flame.
I forgot to tell you that Zhang Fei has several other beast bloodlines in his body, and two of them are the phoenix and golden crow bloodlines.
I have both bloodlines in my body, so I can sense them clearly."
"Yes." Long Huoyan nodded at her.
"In fact, I also sensed the fire dragon bloodline in Zhang Fei’s body when I spoke to him last night, and I also sensed other bloodlines from him, but I can’t confirm them all.
If you’re right that he has the phoenix bloodline in his body, he most likely got it from Empress Huo Yanling."
Huo Jinying told him something else.
"Xiaolan also told me that Zhang Fei invited a female alchemist to take care of his shop, and she is a pure fire phoenix."
"Hmm?" Long Huoyan instantly fell into contemplation.
"If you are correct that Empress Huo Yanling is a phoenix, that woman is most likely one of her relatives."

"For now, all of this is still just our guesses, but I think we should secure a favorable relationship with Zhang Fei, which will be very beneficial for our demihuman race." Long Huoyan agreed with Huo Jinying.
"After this, you should go meet Sister Yingwu, and we will send Xiaolan to the Moonlit Passion Sect as our ambassador."
Long Huoyan did not immediately give Huo Jinying an answer, and he thought about the pros and cons first.
He was reluctant to send his second daughter to the sect, but he needed someone to establish a better relationship with Zhang Fei.

Long Huoyan thought about sending Long Lingxun, but he couldn’t possibly do it because there were several demons in the Moonlit Passion Temple, and his presence in the sect would actually bring trouble among them.
Long Huoyan considered sending his second daughter and son-in-law there, but they had a young child, so he couldn’t send them because their child would be disturbed.
Si Yingwu suddenly walked into the room, and the high-ranking officials of the demihuman race hurriedly stood up from their seats.
They bowed their heads, paying their respects to her.
Si Yingwu said nothing to them and immediately approached Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying.
"Husband, I want you to send Xiaolan to the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Why do you want to send our daughter to that sect, Wife?" Long Huoyan asked with a frown.
Si Yingwu let out a soft sigh.
"I understand your concern for our daughter’s safety, but I’m sure Xiaolan will be fine in that sect.

Moreover, she doesn’t harbor hatred for demons like her big brother or the rest of our race, so I feel that she is a suitable person to be our representative, and I want her to gain new experiences there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1453: Huo Jinying’s Warning
paragraphs: After thinking it over, Long Huoyan decided to give in, and he followed his second wife’s wishes. "Alright, I’ll talk to our daughter later, and I’ll give her some things for her protection. I need someone to accompany her there, and I can’t possibly send my son or my other daughter to accompany her."

"His daughter." Huo Jinying pointed at a male demihuman with a half-fox and half-human appearance. "Huli Yun, your daughter, Huli Wanqing, has been close friends with Long Xiaolian for a long time, right? I want you to contact your daughter now and ask her to accompany the second princess to the Moonlit Passion Temple, so you should ask her to prepare now."
"Yes, Empress." Huli Yun contacted her daughter and asked her to prepare. "My daughter will prepare for her departure, and she is eager to accompany Princess Xiaolian."
Huo Jinying nodded in satisfaction. "This way you don’t have to worry about Xiaolan, husband. I’m sure they will be fine there, and Zhang Fei won’t let anything bad happen to them."

"Yes." Long Huoyan spoke to the demihuman race officials. "Since Zhang Fei has a close relationship with Empress Huo Yanling, I forbid anyone from causing trouble in his shop, and I will punish anyone who dares to do so. Now, go and convey my orders to all our citizens."
"Yes, Emperor."
After those people left, Si Yingwu asked her husband and sister. "Does Zhang Fei really have a connection with Empress Huo Yanling? How could he have a relationship with her?"

Huo Jinying explained to Si Yingwu the message she received from Long Xiaolan earlier. "Your daughter met Empress Huo in person, so I’m sure she didn’t give me the wrong information. She left her two subordinates in our domain, and they were assigned to protect Zhang Fei’s shop and his people there."

Si Yingwu nodded in understanding. "I think we should be careful about Zhang Fei’s shop, Husband. We must protect the people who work there, or we will face serious problems if our citizens seek trouble with them, and we won’t be able to handle Empress Huo’s wrath if something happens to them."

"You’re right." Long Huoyan contacted several people and asked them to prevent the citizens of his kingdom from causing trouble with the people at Zhang Fei’s shop. "Wife, I want you to warn our son not to trouble them, or we will lose him if he dares to cause trouble with them."
Huo Jinying agreed with her husband, and she left the throne room to meet their son, mainly because Long Lingxun had shown his dislike for Zhang Fei because of his relationship with the demon races.
Long Huoyan pulled Si Yingwu onto his lap and asked her a question. "Do you really have no problem with our daughter joining the Moonlit Passion Sect, Wife?"

"No." Si Yingwu shook her head slightly. "Xiaolian has shown me many pictures of the sect’s situation, and I can see that people of all races living there have harmonious relationships. That’s why I don’t have to worry about our daughter while she’s there, and she’ll gain many new experiences during her stay. When she returns someday, I’m sure she’ll have matured a lot."

Long Huoyan sighed inwardly because both his wives were the same, and they weren’t the least bit worried about their children’s situation. "Am I being too paranoid as a father? I’m always afraid that something terrible will happen to my children, so I never want them to leave my side. If they’re far away from me, it will be difficult for me to protect them."

"Haha." Si Yingwu kissed her husband and put her arms around his neck. "Sister Jinying and I are also always worried about our children, but we both realize that they are already adults, and we can’t possibly ask them to stay in our domain forever. In the past, our parents also did the same thing with us, and they allowed us to travel to other domains to gain experience, so we want our children to experience that too."

Long Huoyan smiled as he recalled his youthful memories. Those times were the most precious to him, which shaped him into the person he is today. "Being a parent is never easy, right? In the past, I always made my parents worry about me, but I never realized that, and I always did as I pleased when I was young. I’m old now, and I have all of you as my family. I always worried about the safety of you two and our children, which made me realize that I also made my parents worry about me in the past."

"You finally realized it, huh?" Long Huoyan responded to Si Yingwu with a bitter smile. "Just like you, I will always worry about our daughter, but I believe she will be fine at the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"I hope you’re right, Wife." Long Huoyan lowered Si Yingwu from his lap and took her hand. "I hope our daughter will be truly mature in mind when she comes home one day."
Si Yingwu nodded at her. "Our daughter will surprise us at that time."
Long Lingxun closed the book in his hand when Huo Jinying walked into his study. "Why did you come here, Mother? Is there something important?"

"I know you don’t like Zhang Fei because of his views on the demon race, but your father and I want you not to get into trouble with him or the people who work in his shop." Long Lingxun did not say anything and looked at Huo Jinying expressionlessly. "You have to listen to me, Son. If you mess with his people, you will die by his hands, and we won’t be able to save you from him."
Long Lingxun’s eyebrows raised slightly. "Do you really believe that a cultivator at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm, such as Zhang Fei, can defeat and kill me, Mother?"
"You are too naive and arrogant, Son." Huo Jinying said this while shaking her head. "Do you know Zhang Qingxiu’s true identity?"
"Who is she?"

"Are you familiar with the name Qi Qingxiu?" Long Lingxun’s expression turned serious and tense upon hearing the name from Huo Jinying’s mouth. "Judging by your expression, you should already know her true identity, right? Do you think a woman as strong as her will accept a weak cultivator as her husband? If Zhang Fei can subdue a woman as strong as her and take her as his wife, you should already be able to guess his true strength."
"That’s—"

"Listen to me first." Long Lingxun said nothing and let Huo Jinying continue. "Zhang Fei not only succeeded in taking Qi Qingxiu as his wife, but he also had a relationship with a woman who was feared by all the cultivators in this realm. You may have never heard of her name because she died long before you were born, but she is back now, and she is the leader of the Blazing Nirvana Domain, Empress Huo Yanling."
*Bam*
The chair fell with a bang as Long Lingxun abruptly stood up, and he looked at Huo Jinying with trembling eyes. "Are you joking with me, Mother? How—"

"Do you think I’m joking around when talking about such a serious matter?" Long Lingxun swallowed his saliva when Huo Jinying narrowed her eyes at him. "Xiaolan has met Empress Huo in person, and she has a close relationship with Zhang Fei. She sent two of her subordinates to our domain to protect his people, and she is a very cruel woman. She returned to this realm several months ago, and she ordered her subordinates to kill all cultivators who tried to invade her domain while she was away, which ended in the death of thousands of cultivators."

Long Lingxun was truly shocked after hearing that because he had already heard about the actions of the women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain a few months ago, and he knew that they killed many cultivators from all races a few months ago, with their biggest victims being the demon races.

Long Lingxun had never met Empress Huo Yanling in person because she died long before he was born, but he had heard of her name because all cultivators from various races often spoke of her, including the demihuman race.

"I know you don’t like Zhang Fei because of his principles regarding all demon races, but you also can’t forbid others from having relationships with them just because you hate them." Huo Jinying walked to her son’s side and hugged him. "For now, there’s no problem between you two, and I don’t want you looking for trouble with his people in that shop. If you harm them in any way, I am certain that he will take action to protect them, which could result in your death. His cultivation is indeed far below yours, but you have to remember that he managed to subdue Qi Qingxiu, and he also has a relationship with Empress Huo, so you must not underestimate him."

After she said that, Huo Jinying released Long Lingxun from her embrace and left the place, and she wanted him to think about all her words just now. She believed that her son was an adult, so he should be able to consider the downsides of causing trouble with Zhang Fei.
Once he came back to his senses, Long Lingxun picked up the fallen chair and sat on it, seriously thinking about Huo Jinying’s words just now about Zhang Fei.

chapters.title: Chapter 1454: Huli Wanqing
paragraphs: "Mother? Why are you here at this hour?"

"I wanted to talk to you about your husband, Lianyu." Guang Lianyu nodded, and they sat down together. Huo Jinying told her daughter-in-law about Zhang Fei, Qi Qingxiu, Feng Yao, and the people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain. "I’ve told you everything, so I want you to monitor your husband’s movements, and you must notify me if there is even the slightest movement from him. I don’t know what he’s thinking after our conversation, but I’m afraid his hatred for the demons has clouded his mind and heart, which will make him unable to think clearly and harm himself."

Guang Lianyu was truly shocked to hear about the relationship between Zhang Fei, Qi Qingxiu, and Feng Yao. One of the women was the demon god that many cultivators feared, and the other one was much more terrifying, which made a powerful cultivator like Long Wuzhao fearful.

Guang Lianyu knew her husband’s character, so she fully understood her mother-in-law’s worries. If her husband offended Zhang Fei, he would have to face two powerful women by his side, and either of them could easily destroy their demihuman race. "Mother, I will closely monitor my husband’s movements, and I will report to you if he shows any bad behavior that will harm us."

"I know you don’t dare go against your husband, but this matter concerns the future of our race, so I hope you will be brave. If he causes trouble with them, I fear our race will be extinct from this realm." Guang Lianyu nodded seriously to Huo Jinying. "I will also keep an eye on my son, but your father and I are always busy with royal affairs, so we can only rely on you to watch over him closely."
"I understand, Mother."
After they discussed some other things, Huo Jinying left the place to take care of other matters. Meanwhile, Guang Lianyu went to her husband’s place, finding Long Lingxun sitting in silence.

Guang Lianyu could only sigh seeing her husband like that, but she didn’t bother him and let him think about his conversation with their mother earlier. ’Husband, you are the prince of our demihuman race, so you must think things through clearly, lest you bring disaster to our race, and our race will be destroyed because of you.’

Zhang Fei hugged Qi Qingxiu and Jia Yuyan by the waist, and they walked leisurely behind the other four women. Long Xiaolian led them to see many things they had never seen before; even Zhang Chen looked like a country bumpkin.

Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue bought many items for women they had never seen before. They didn’t forget their sisters who were waiting for them in the sect, and they bought many things that would suit all of them.
Qi Qingxiu smiled as she looked at them. "Husband, I never thought that your grandmother had a little girl’s side, and she enjoyed herself so much in this kingdom."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed listening to her talk about his grandmother. "As you already know, my grandmother used to be an ordinary human, and I never took her to other realms. Moreover, there are no demihumans in our world, and this is the first time she has gone to a realm inhabited by demihumans, so you don’t need to be surprised if she acts like that."

Jia Yuyan spoke to him. "If I think about it again, your grandmother changed a lot after she became your wife, Husband. In the past, she always acted mature, and we liked her a lot because she often gave us advice about life. Even though most of us were much older than her, we felt that she was more experienced than us about life, so we always enjoyed listening to her advice. This was the first time I saw her act like a little girl, and she looked no different from the naughty Zhang Lin."

"Lin’er is also her granddaughter, so it’s natural that the two of them have similarities, right?" Jia Yuyan and Qi Qingxiu nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei, and they felt that Zhang Chen was similar to Zhang Lin if she acted like that. "Hu Lili and Hu Yue are moon foxes, and they rarely left the Moon Fox Sub-Realm in the past. Just like the earth, there are no demihumans in the Sky Jade Realm, but there are many natural races there."
Jia Yuyan said again. "The demihuman race is very rare in the Three Mortal Realms, and the Sovereign Heaven Realm does not have their race."

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "The only realm in the Three Mortal Realms where I’ve encountered demihumans is the Wasteland Realm, and I’ve trained on their island in the past. However, I didn’t spend much time in that realm in the past, so I don’t know much about them, and some of them have tried to capture me while I was training on their island."
"Hahaha." Qi Qingxiu laughed at that. "They’re lucky they didn’t meet the current you, as you would kill them if they tried to capture you."
Zhang Fei smiled to himself as he remembered those times. At that time, his cultivation wasn’t as high as it is now, and he was training on the demihuman island with Shang Xinyu and Shang Yaolin.
"Princess Xiaolian!"
Hearing a woman’s loud scream, Zhang Fei and the two women turned their heads to a female demihuman of the fox race who was running quickly from behind them.
Long Xiaolian and the three women also turned their attention to the female demihuman of the fox race while selecting items from one of the merchants.
Long Xiaolian smiled widely after she saw her best friend, and she waved her hand at the woman while calling her. "Wanqing! Come here and accompany us shopping!"

Huli Wanqing’s face was childish but adorable, like a teenage girl. She has wide icy silver eyes with long eyelashes combined with long snow-colored eyebrows. Her lips were thick but a little pale, and her skin was as soft and white as snow.

Huli Wanqing’s figure was slender and tall, but she was built more for agility than strength, covered in a long white dress that perfectly hugged her body. She has a narrow waist, large breasts, and long legs. She has long snow-white hair that cascades down her back. Her fox ears were white and soft, twitching above her head. She has a thick, fluffy, snow-white fox tail swaying behind her hips.

Huli Wanqing ran at top speed towards Long Xiaolian, but her gaze suddenly shifted when she saw Zhang Fei. Her legs accidentally tangled with each other, causing her to fall forward really hard with her face first.
*Bam*
"Ouch! It hurts!" Huli Wanqing rolled on the ground, rubbed her painful face, and screamed very loudly. "Ouch! My face! Argh! My face is getting ugly!"
Long Xiaolian, Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, Hu Yue, and the demihumans in the surrounding area laughed as they watched Huli Wanqing act like that.

Jia Yuyan and Qi Qingxiu shook their heads because Huli Wanqing was too careless, and she fell to the ground face first because she was mesmerized by Zhang Fei’s handsomeness. They looked at his face and exchanged glances with each other before smiling to themselves.
Zhang Fei smiled amusedly and stepped forward, extending his hand to Huli Wanqing. "Are you alright, Miss?" ’Scan her status, Mei.’

Cultivation: 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm

> Light [Perfection Stage]

> Light Core [Middle Rank]
Physique: Fox Demihuman

> Light Spirit
’A snow fox, eh?’
[Are you interested in her, Master?]
’Not really.’
Huli Wanqing looked at Zhang Fei, but her face turned embarrassed after falling due to her carelessness. ’Ugh! He’s handsome! I ended up falling because I was captivated by his good looks!’
"Miss?" Huli Wanqing reached out and took Zhang Fei’s hand, but she was too embarrassed to look at him. ’This woman is shyer than any woman I’ve ever known.’
Zhang Fei pulled Huli Wanqing to her feet and examined her body, making her peek at him. ’Is he a fox beast? Moreover, he has nine tails, and I’ve never met one before.’
"Are you okay, Miss?" Huli Wanqing withdrew her hand and nodded to Zhang Fei. "It’s good that you’re okay."
Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue could see that Huli Wanqing was attracted to Zhang Fei. However, their husband didn’t seem interested in her, especially since his demeanor was so casual.
Long Xiaolian approached her best friend. "Clumsy girl! What are you doing here? I thought you were busy with your cultivation, so I didn’t invite you to walk with us."

"Humph." Huli Wanqing snorted softly. "My father contacted me earlier, and he told me that you were leaving our domain to join a sect in another domain. Moreover, the Empress asked me to accompany you so that you wouldn’t be lonely, so I hurriedly packed and went to look for you."
"Oh." Long Xiaolian nodded in understanding and turned Huli Wanqing to face Zhang Fei. "His name is Zhang Fei, and he is the leader of that sect."
"Eh!?" Huli Wanqing let out a low cry. "Are you really the sect master of the sect we’re both joining?"
"Not really." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "Our Sect Master is Qing Qiu’er, and our Vice Sect Master is You Feiling."

Why are you here at this hour?"
"I wanted to talk to you about your husband, Lianyu." Guang Lianyu nodded, and they sat down together.
Huo Jinying told her daughter-in-law about Zhang Fei, Qi Qingxiu, Feng Yao, and the people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain.
"I’ve told you everything, so I want you to monitor your husband’s movements, and you must notify me if there is even the slightest movement from him.
I don’t know what he’s thinking after our conversation, but I’m afraid his hatred for the demons has clouded his mind and heart, which will make him unable to think clearly and harm himself."
Guang Lianyu was truly shocked to hear about the relationship between Zhang Fei, Qi Qingxiu, and Feng Yao.
One of the women was the demon god that many cultivators feared, and the other one was much more terrifying, which made a powerful cultivator like Long Wuzhao fearful.
Guang Lianyu knew her husband’s character, so she fully understood her mother-in-law’s worries.
If her husband offended Zhang Fei, he would have to face two powerful women by his side, and either of them could easily destroy their demihuman race.
"Mother, I will closely monitor my husband’s movements, and I will report to you if he shows any bad behavior that will harm us."
"I know you don’t dare go against your husband, but this matter concerns the future of our race, so I hope you will be brave.
If he causes trouble with them, I fear our race will be extinct from this realm." Guang Lianyu nodded seriously to Huo Jinying.
"I will also keep an eye on my son, but your father and I are always busy with royal affairs, so we can only rely on you to watch over him closely."
"I understand, Mother."
After they discussed some other things, Huo Jinying left the place to take care of other matters.
Meanwhile, Guang Lianyu went to her husband’s place, finding Long Lingxun sitting in silence.

Guang Lianyu could only sigh seeing her husband like that, but she didn’t bother him and let him think about his conversation with their mother earlier. ’Husband, you are the prince of our demihuman race, so you must think things through clearly, lest you bring disaster to our race, and our race will be destroyed because of you.’
Zhang Fei hugged Qi Qingxiu and Jia Yuyan by the waist, and they walked leisurely behind the other four women.
Long Xiaolian led them to see many things they had never seen before; even Zhang Chen looked like a country bumpkin.
Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue bought many items for women they had never seen before.
They didn’t forget their sisters who were waiting for them in the sect, and they bought many things that would suit all of them.
Qi Qingxiu smiled as she looked at them.
"Husband, I never thought that your grandmother had a little girl’s side, and she enjoyed herself so much in this kingdom."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed listening to her talk about his grandmother.
"As you already know, my grandmother used to be an ordinary human, and I never took her to other realms.
Moreover, there are no demihumans in our world, and this is the first time she has gone to a realm inhabited by demihumans, so you don’t need to be surprised if she acts like that."
Jia Yuyan spoke to him.
"If I think about it again, your grandmother changed a lot after she became your wife, Husband.
In the past, she always acted mature, and we liked her a lot because she often gave us advice about life.
Even though most of us were much older than her, we felt that she was more experienced than us about life, so we always enjoyed listening to her advice.
This was the first time I saw her act like a little girl, and she looked no different from the naughty Zhang Lin."

"Lin’er is also her granddaughter, so it’s natural that the two of them have similarities, right?" Jia Yuyan and Qi Qingxiu nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei, and they felt that Zhang Chen was similar to Zhang Lin if she acted like that.
"Hu Lili and Hu Yue are moon foxes, and they rarely left the Moon Fox Sub-Realm in the past.
Just like the earth, there are no demihumans in the Sky Jade Realm, but there are many natural races there."
Jia Yuyan said again.
"The demihuman race is very rare in the Three Mortal Realms, and the Sovereign Heaven Realm does not have their race."
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"The only realm in the Three Mortal Realms where I’ve encountered demihumans is the Wasteland Realm, and I’ve trained on their island in the past.
However, I didn’t spend much time in that realm in the past, so I don’t know much about them, and some of them have tried to capture me while I was training on their island."
"Hahaha." Qi Qingxiu laughed at that.
"They’re lucky they didn’t meet the current you, as you would kill them if they tried to capture you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1455: Back To The Sect
paragraphs: "Qing Qiu’er? You Feiling?" Huli Wanqing tried to recall the two names in her mind, and she felt like she had heard them both before. "Ahh! They—"
"Shh!" Long Xiaolian hurriedly covered her best friend’s mouth with her hand. "You’re right about them, but we’re in a public place now, so you shouldn’t say anything about them."
Huli Wanqing nodded repeatedly as a sign of understanding, and Long Xiaolian pulled her hand back from her mouth. "Do the Emperor and your mother really not mind if you join that sect?"
"Yes." Long Xiaolian explained some things to her best friend. "My mother has agreed to my wishes, and my father has also agreed; otherwise, your father would not have sent you here."
Huli Wanqing looked at Zhang Fei again, but she hurriedly shifted her gaze. ’Why would a handsome beast like him join that sect? Why didn’t my father say anything about us joining a human sect?’

Zhang Fei smiled amusedly at Huli Wanqing’s antics, but then he turned to his grandmother and the two moon foxes to ask them a question. "Do you three still want to walk around the kingdom and buy other items?"
"No."
Zhang Chen spoke to him. "We’ve already bought many things for all your wives, and I think that’s enough. If you want to return to our domain, we can go back right now."
"Alright." Zhang Fei looked at the two demihuman women. "Are you two ready to go now? If you are ready, I will take you to our domain now."
Long Xiaolian nodded at him. "Since my mother has agreed, I’ve been preparing myself since last night, so we can go now.
"I’m ready too." Huli Wanqing still has some doubts in her heart. "Is there really no problem if we join your sect? Won’t the people there be hostile toward us?"
"Haha." Jia Yuyan laughed at that. "You don’t have to worry about the people there because they won’t be hostile to you, and I’m sure you’ll enjoy yourself there meeting new people."

Huli Wanqing just realized that Jia Yuyan was not a female human but a female fairy. "You are such a beautiful fairy, Big Sis! I’ve met female fairies in the past, but I’ve never met one as beautiful as you."
"Hehe! Thank you." Jia Yuyan hugged Zhang Fei’s arm. "My beauty is thanks to the pills concocted by my husband."
Huli Wanqing finally looked at Zhang Fei. "Are you an alchemist?"
"I am."
"Zhang Fei is an alchemist god." Huli Wanqing’s jaw dropped after Long Xiaolian made that statement. "This clumsy girl is also an alchemist, and her rank is at the Saint Rank."
Zhang Fei looked at Huli Wanqing in surprise. "Why can’t I smell the herbs from your body?"
"This—"

"Her body secretes a strange fluid because of her Snow Fox Bloodline, so other scents cannot stick to her body, including the scent of herbs." After Long Xiaolian made that statement, Zhang Fei observed Huli Wanqing’s body, which caused her to feel embarrassed and awkward. "All the medical experts had examined her body in the past, but they couldn’t find the origin of the strange fluid. When she secretes that fluid, her body becomes very fragrant, like ice flowers.
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Since you two are ready, we will leave this domain now, and I will take you to my sect afterward."
"Are you going to check on your people in your shop first?"
"No need." Zhang Fei led them away, finding a quiet place. "Feng Shanxi is more experienced than I am, so she should know what to do with my shop."
"I see."

After they found an empty place, Zhang Fei opened a gate that connected the domain to the Twin Flames Main Domain, leaving Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian in a daze because they had never seen anything like it before.
Zhang Chen and the others laughed at their reaction, and they pulled the two women into the gate, followed by Qi Qingxiu and Zhang Fei.

Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian were once again stunned after they arrived at the Twin Flames Main Domain, and they didn’t need to go through two realm gates to arrive at the domain. They looked at the area around the domain, which was now filled with forests from all directions.
"Let’s go." Zhang Fei enveloped them with his aura, used his teleportation, and brought them to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian were shocked when they saw Tian Kui and Serpentera. The two ancient beasts had the same cultivation as Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying, but they should be stronger than them because they were pure beasts.

"They are both protectors of this sect." Zhang Fei looked at the two ancient beasts. "Old Kui and Old Snake, the two female demihumans, are Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian, who will be disciples of our sect starting today."
Tian Kui and Serpentera nodded at him. "We understand, Master."

Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian looked at Zhang Fei after Tian Kui and Serpentera addressed him as their master, which was simply unbelievable. The two ancient beasts had already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, so they were far stronger than him, but they acknowledged him as their master.

"You’ve shocked them too many times today, husband." Qi Qingxiu spoke with a smile, glancing at Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian. "They will probably be even more shocked after they enter this sect, especially this fox girl. By the way, I won’t be joining you guys, and I’ll be going to the Celestial Yin Lake to cultivate."

Qi Qingxiu enveloped Jia Yuyan, Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue with her aura before leading them to the back of the mountain, where the Celestial Yin Lake and their residence were located. She intentionally took the four women away to give Zhang Fei a chance with Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian, even though he was only interested in the female snow fox.
"Let’s go; I will show you two areas of this sect, and you can choose any hall according to your interests." Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian followed Zhang Fei, who was leading in front of them.

Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian tensed up as the human disciples looked at them, and they hugged Zhang Fei’s arms from the right and left. Although they had visited other domains in the past, they had never been to human domains before; their experiences were limited to the domains of beasts or natural races, primarily because humans had always looked down on their demihuman race.

However, Huli Wanqing and Long Xiaolian could see that the humans were not looking at them with contempt, and their gazes showed a high level of curiosity, especially since they had never seen the demihuman race before.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and spoke to the two women. "See? They’re not looking down on you guys, and they’re just curious about your race, right? This sect has many members from all races, including the demon race, but we’ve never had members from the demihuman race before. Therefore, it’s natural that they are curious about the presence of the two of you here, and they would probably flock to you if I weren’t with you."
Huli Wanqing turned to Zhang Fei. "Are there really members of the demon races in this sect?"

"Haish." Long Xiaolian shook her head at her best friend’s ignorance. "That woman beside Zhang Fei earlier with a cultivation of the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm was the Seven Emotions Demon God, Qi Qingxiu."

"What?" Huli Wanqing screamed in shock, causing the surrounding disciples to look in her direction. "Are... are you serious about that? Is... is that woman really the Seven Emotions Demon God, Qi Qingxiu?"
"What’s the use of me lying to you?"
Huli Wanqing turned to Zhang Fei, who immediately spoke to her. "She is indeed the Seven Emotions Demon God, Qi Qingxiu, and she is one of my wives."
"One... one of your wives?" Huli Wanqing stuttered in shock. "How... how could a demon god like her be willing to share a husband with so many women?"

"Because I’m strong?" Huli Wanqing rolled her eyes, noticing that Zhang Fei’s cultivation was still at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm, which meant he couldn’t possibly be stronger than a Demon God like Qi Qingxiu. "Haha! I know you won’t believe me, but I wouldn’t have succeeded in conquering her if I were weaker than her, right?"

Huli Wanqing didn’t want to believe it, but Zhang Fei’s words were true. If he didn’t have sufficient strength, he wouldn’t have been able to conquer a woman as powerful as Qi Qingxiu. "How strong are you really? How were you able to subdue her?"
"Hehe." Zhang Fei didn’t use the soul link to borrow the power of the evil beasts in the beast space, but he enveloped the two women with his killing intent for a brief moment.
*Thud*
Huli Wanqing fell to her butt and stared at Zhang Fei in shock, her body trembling violently as his killing intent gave her a terrifying sense of death.

In contrast, Long Xiaolian hugged Zhang Fei’s arm even tighter to keep herself from falling, as her legs went weak after feeling his killing intent. Her face was deathly pale, and her body couldn’t stop trembling from a terrifying sense of death.
Zhang Fei enveloped Long Xiaolian and Huli Wanqing with his light domain, alleviating their fear. "You two should know my strength by now, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1456: Two Women Meet Two Foxes
paragraphs: Zhang Fei led the two women to inspect the first hall while explaining several things to them, especially about the rules that apply in the sect.

Long Xiaolian quickly regained her composure after Zhang Fei used his light domain. However, she was curious about his true strength, as her mother had told her that he was supposed to be powerful, more powerful than Qi Qingxiu. ’Is he really stronger than demon gods? I shouldn’t doubt his strength because he managed to tame two powerful ancient beasts, and they respect him greatly.’

Huli Wanqing stole glances at Zhang Fei because she was curious about him, especially after she experienced his terrifying killing intent. Additionally, she could sense two fox bloodlines within her that were stronger than her own snow fox bloodline. ’What exactly are his two fox bloodlines? Why does my fox bloodline keep trembling in response to his presence?’

"Are you curious about the two fox bloodlines in my body?" Huli Wanqing tilted her head to Zhang Fei, but her expression was full of surprise. "You have the snow fox bloodline in your body, so I know you can sense my two fox bloodlines."

paragraphs: "Tian Qiye."

The atmosphere fell silent after Zhang Fei mentioned that name. Tian Qiye was the current leader of the Winged Race, and she was the strongest woman in the Paradise Realm, so only Feng Yao was above her.

"Hahaha." Nalan Yushu’s roaring laughter broke the silence. "No man from any race would dare dream of getting Tian Qiye, except for you, Husband. She considered her position to be above all men, including her deceased husband. I’ve heard rumors that several male grand elders of her race had taken a liking to her, and they wanted to take her as their wife. However, none of them dared to express their feelings to her, even though her husband has long since passed away."

Tianshi Shengjie nodded in agreement with Nalan Yushu. "I’ve also heard about it in the past, and Tian Liefeng was the main candidate because Tian Qiye trusted him so much. He was the only grand elder who often spent time with her, but their relationship never became reality."

"Tian Liefeng, huh? I saw that man accompany Tian Qiye to the Jiangshen Domain some time ago, but he couldn’t move in front of the Ghost Emperor because he was so frightened of him." Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "He’s indeed strong because he’s a grand elder, but I don’t need to be afraid of him, and I’ll get that woman once my cultivation reaches her level in the future."
"Why do you want Tian Qiye as your wife, Husband?" Luo Yunxiao curiously asked.

Zhang Fei smiled at her. "Do you even need to ask that, Yunxiao? Tian Qiye is a powerful woman, and her cultivation has already reached the Celestial God Realm. Even her Winged Race rank has reached the True Divine, so it’s natural that I want her as one of my wives, right?"

"Yes." Luo Yunxiao nodded in agreement. "You are the sole successor of the ten-tailed fox, and you are destined to stand at the pinnacle of cultivation in the future. Therefore, it is natural that you want a powerful woman to be your wife, and Tian Qiye is one of them."
"We agree!" All of Zhang Fei’s wives responded simultaneously, sincerely hoping that he would be able to win over that woman in the future.

Tianshi Shengjie shook her head when all the women agreed with Zhang Fei. "Tian Qiye would never have imagined that there was a lust demon targeting her to be his wife, and you had even taken one of his subordinates as your woman. Not to mention, two of her male subordinates had also become your loyal followers, and she would have never guessed that they would help you get her. By the time she realized it, it was too late, and she was already in your clutches."

"Haha." Zhang Fei pulled Tianshi Shengjie into his arms and briefly kissed her, causing her to glare at him. "Isn’t that great? That way I won’t have to go to the trouble of subduing Tian Qiye, and I’ll change her mindset after she falls into my hands by fucking her for a few days."

"I thought you were the only man who would dare to even think about having sex with Tian Qiye." Tianshi Shengjie wanted to break free from Zhang Fei’s embrace, but he hugged her tightly. "Hey! Let me go now, and you can have fun with all your wives."
"No." Zhang Fei stroked her cheek. "When will you be willing to be my wife? You’ve lived with us for quite some time now, and you know a lot about us, so you should be ready to become one with them."

Tianshi Shengjie sighed softly and wrapped her arms around his neck. "I’ve told you too many times that I’ve fallen in love with you, but you haven’t managed to win my heart completely. If you want me to be your wife, you must quickly win my heart, and I will gladly become one then."

"Haish." Zhang Fei hissed in disappointment. "If that’s the case, I’ll spend more time with you in the future so I can win your heart sooner. When you become my wife, I’ll enjoy your body to the fullest, and I won’t let you leave me again."
"Is sex the only thing on your mind?"
"I am a lust demon, to be precise, a lust demon overlord, remember?"

Tianshi Shengjie could only sigh after she remembered that, and she immediately spoke to Zhang Fei. "Fine! After you succeed in winning my heart, I will devote myself as your wife, and I will serve you until you are completely satisfied."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed excitedly as he lifted Tianshi Shengjie, and he carried her around in place. "You said it yourself, so you should always remember your words, okay?"

Tianshi Shengjie smiled amusedly at Zhang Fei’s impatient expression. She had actually wanted to be his wife for a long time. However, she wouldn’t give herself to him that easily, and she wanted him to do his best to win her heart first. "You don’t need to worry about that because I will keep my word."
"Good!" Zhang Fei put her down and kissed her again. "Would you like to join us? I’ll take them into the pavilion now, and we’ll be in seclusion for the next week."
"I will enter seclusion with all of you, but I will not join you and your other women; instead, I will train at the training ground with Helian Xun’er and the others."
"Alright."
After that, Zhang Fei brought Tianshi Shengjie, Qi Qingxiu, and all his wives into the training space.
Zhang Fei’s first and second clones also brought all their wives there, but not his fifth clone, who remained in the sect to monitor the situation.
Since Zhang Fei’s fourth clone was in the process of fusing with Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul, his three wives were manually cultivated using his yang qi.

Upon arriving at the training space, Zhang Fei and his two clones brought their wives into the pavilion. Meanwhile, Tianshi Shengjie and Qi Qingxiu joined Helian Xun’er, Ursula, and several others training in the training ground.

Shang Xueli, who was training at the training ground, was shocked to see hundreds of women walking into the pavilion. Although Zhang Fei had told her that he had a large number of wives, she was still shocked to see all of them so close and harmonious. They joked with each other without minding their age difference, and they looked as close as real sisters, making her feel jealous of them.

Unlike them, Shang Xueli’s past was sorrowful because she had to marry a man she never loved, and she lived locked up for years like a puppet. Even though Zhang Fei had freed her and restored her condition to normal, she could never get rid of the memories of the terrible past from her mind.

"If you’re jealous of them, you can start thinking about giving yourself to him, Little Princess." Shang Xueli looked at Qi Qingxiu in shock, and she never expected that a female demon god as powerful as her father would be willing to become the wife of a man with many wives, which would require her to share a husband with so many of them. "I know you doubt my decision, but I never regretted it because I felt so much more alive after becoming his wife. In the past I always felt my choice was the best, but my thoughts changed completely after I became his wife, and my life used to be dull compared to now."
Shang Xueli shook her head. "Zhang Fei has never been interested in me, and I’m just a prisoner in his eyes, so I won’t lower myself to beg him to take me as his woman."
"It’s up to you then." Qi Qingxiu turned to Tianshi Shengjie. "Teach me to use this device, Dragon Princess."
"Alright."
After Tianshi Shengjie taught Qi Qingxiu how to use the device, the two women immediately joined the other women to begin their training.

Inside the pavilion, Zhang Fei’s first and second clones had already brought their respective wives into their rooms. However, they did not immediately engage in dual cultivation; instead, they first practiced dual soul cultivation with their two husbands because their soul power was still significantly lower than his.

Unlike Zhang Fei, who could engage in dual soul cultivation with all of his wives, they could only do so with him. Henceforth, their soul power lagged far behind him, even though they have done it every day for the last few decades.

Zhang Fei transformed into his half-fox form, and he sat amidst his dozens of wives, who surrounded him. He took out the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror and transformed his tails into the same number as his wives, and each of them held one while releasing their souls.

After Zhang Fei’s white lotus merged with the dozens of black lotuses belonging to his dozens of wives, he activated the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror. They began dual soul cultivation without worrying about outside affairs, as time flowed four times faster in the residence than in the outside world.

Zhang Fei’s fifth clone dual soul cultivated with Yan Jinwu, Sima Huiqing, Qing Qiu’er, and You Feiling on the mountain peak of the Moonlit Passion Temple. He entrusted the sect’s security to Tian Kui and Serpentera, mainly because the two demon beasts were strong enough to protect the sect from other cultivators, except those on the level of Long Wuzhao and Tian Qiye.

chapters.title: Chapter 1462: Dong Xuanyin Visit
paragraphs: "You three finally came out."
"Hahaha!" Taotie laughed at that. "Based on your expressions, I’m sure Qi Qingxiu rejected you again, right?"

"Why do you want that woman so much, Qiongqi?" Taowu asked him. "There are so many female evil beasts in our domain, and they are willing to serve you. You should accept them and forget her, or you will just waste your time."

Hundun snorted softly. "Back then, you asked me to accompany you to her domain, and you angered her so much that she used her abilities on us, making my emotions unstable for hundreds of years. Her ability to control the seven emotions is too terrifying, and I don’t want to meet her again."

"Hahaha!" Taotie and Taowu laughed out loud after they heard that, and they still clearly remember the events of that day. They already knew that Qi Qingxiu’s ability to control the seven emotions of that creature was truly terrifying, so they never wanted to meet her again.
"I don’t want any woman but Qi Qingxiu, and I will get her someday." Qiongqi then asked. "What about your subordinate who’s on his way to the Three Mortal Realms? Has he reached that realm yet?"

"He left for the Three Mortal Realms about half a year ago, so he should be there." Taotie contacted his subordinate to inquire about the situation, but he received an unsatisfactory answer. "Hmm? He told me that the exit was sealed, so he couldn’t go out to that realm, and he decided to return to this realm."
Qiongqi, Taowu, and Hundun frowned at that.
"How could the exit from the tunnel be sealed? There’s never been an incident like this in the past, right?" Hundun asked.

Taowu spoke. "All the tunnels connecting this realm to the realm beyond were formed naturally in the past, so I’m sure no cultivator can seal the entrances and exits, including Long Wuzhao and Empress Huo Yanling."

"If our subordinates can’t descend into that realm, we won’t be able to find those items, and our master will be furious if he finds out that we failed to obtain them," Qiongqi spoke solemnly before looking at his three companions. "How about the four of us try going down there through four different tunnels? For now, we have nothing to do in this realm, and we’re just waiting for our master to wake up from his long slumber. That’s why I think it’s fine if we also try going down there, and we’ll examine the seals ourselves."

Taotie, Taowu, and Hundun did not answer Qiongqi directly. They were worried that something catastrophic would happen within their domain if the four of them descended into the Three Mortal Realms at the same time.

Qiongqi spoke to them again. "Even if we descend to the Three Mortal Realms, we can leave our avatars in our domain, and I’m sure no one will dare to cause trouble here, including Long Wuzhao. Additionally, we still have many subordinates with cultivation in the 3-Sun Celestial Realms, and they can protect our domain while we’re gone. If we delay too long, and our master suddenly wakes from his long slumber, we will face severe punishment."

Taotie, Taowu, and Hundun trembled in fear after Qiongqi spoke, particularly because they were well aware of their master’s character. Although their master wouldn’t descend to their realm to meet them, his avatar was enough to kill the four of them, and they wouldn’t be able to do anything against him, as he was a primordial beast.

Taotie immediately spoke. "Alright! The four of us will go to four different tunnels, but we have to leave our avatars in our domain, and we will check whether they are sealed like the one my subordinate went through."
"Let’s go." The four evil beasts immediately summoned their avatars, and they went to several other domains that had tunnels to descend to the Three Mortal Realms.
Dong Xuanyin, who was lying on her coral, immediately opened her eyes after she noticed the departure of the four mythical evil beasts.

"Why did they decide to descend into the Three Mortal Realms themselves and leave their avatars in this domain? Aren’t they afraid that Empress Huo will attack this domain?" Dong Xuanyin turned to Mo Zhejun, who was unconscious. She was forced to knock him unconscious because he continued to scream, even though she had stuffed his mouth with a thick cloth. "I’ve kept this old demon locked up in my place for two weeks, and I think it’s time I hand him over to Zhang Fei. Should I take the old demon to his sect? Or should I call him here to pick up this old demon?"

Dong Xuanyin shuddered as she recalled the incident when Zhang Fei was inside her private place when he inherited Hu Tianlang’s gluttony soul. At that time, he forcibly stuffed his tail into her mouth, and Feng Yao forced her to swallow his yang qi.

Back then, Dong Xuanyin enjoyed Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi because it strengthened her body, even though their cultivation gap was vast, and she also enjoyed sucking his tail. She shivered when she remembered his words that he would claim her as his woman the next time they met, and she didn’t want that to happen.
Dong Xuanyin let out a soft sigh and climbed down from her corral. She then lifted Mo Zhejun with her aura, taking him away from her private place.

A few minutes later, Dong Xuanyin arrived at the Moonlit Passion Sect, but two ancient beasts stopped her. ’Oh? He has two powerful beasts as guardians of his sect, huh?’ "If I remember correctly, you two are the Ancient Abyssal Leviathan Beast and the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast left in this universe, right?"
Tian Kui and Serpentera frowned because Dong Xuanyin could recognize their identities, even though Zhang Fei had disguised their appearance by using his body modification ability.

"Haha." Dong Xuanyin laughed at their reaction. "I know Zhang Fei helped you two disguise your identities using his body modification ability, but I’m no ordinary beast, and I can see through your disguises clearly. By the way, I’m not your enemy, and I can defeat you two easily if I want to. That’s why you guys don’t need to be so wary of me, and I came here to hand this old demon over to him, so please tell him I want to meet him."
"Who exactly are you?" Serpentera asked her.

"Dong Xuanyin." Serpentera and Tian Kui stared at her seriously, but they couldn’t recognize her true identity. "Hey! Hurry up and don’t waste my time! Tell Zhang Fei that I’ve come to hand this old demon over to him!"

Serpentera and Tian Kui suddenly received a voice transmission from Zhang Fei [5], preventing them from fighting Dong Xuanyin. Although their cultivation was at the same level, the female demon was still much stronger than them, and he didn’t want her to beat them both up.
After listening to Zhang Fei’s message [5], Serpentera spoke to Dong Xuanyin. "You can enter the sect now, and our master is waiting for you at the top of the mountain so you can meet him there."
"Hahah." Dong Xuanyin laughed and took Mo Zhejun to the mountain peak.
"Who exactly is that woman? How does she know our disguises and our true identities?" Asked Tian Kui.

Serpentera shook his head as he looked at Dong Xuanyin from a distance. "Just like you, I couldn’t recognize the identity of that female beast, and she seemed to be using something to hide her identity. Our master said that she was no ordinary beast, and she had the ability to see things that no one else could see. The most important thing is that she is not our enemy, but we must still be wary of her, especially her abilities."

"Yes." Tian Kui turned to him. "Do you think the four perils have discovered our return to this realm? If they find us here, I’m sure they’ll attack us and destroy this sect. Our master does possess greater power than cultivators of his level, and he has many powerful allies, but I’m not sure he can take on all four of them at once."

"I’m worried about that too." Serpentera replied with a serious expression. "I don’t know yet whether the four perils already know that we’ve returned to this realm, especially since he hasn’t said anything to me. However, I do know that our master has previously visited their domain, and the female beast just now is one of its inhabitants."
Tian Kui sighed. "I hope the four perils are unaware of our return and our presence in the sect, as that would bring trouble to our master."

Dong Xuanyin did not fly hurriedly towards the mountain peak, and she observed everything in the sect, especially the halls. She knew that the Moonlit Passion Temple was a dual cultivation sect, but she never knew that Zhang Fei [5] had already transformed it into a universal sect with many halls dedicated to various fields.

Dong Xuanyin remembered for sure that Zhang Fei [5] had only ascended to the Paradise Realm a few years ago, and she was amazed that he could bring changes to the sect in such a short time, especially since the sect had existed for quite a long time in that domain. "Moreover, he managed to recruit many outstanding people in their respective fields, and they were very useful in helping the sect’s disciples become experts."

paragraphs: "Unfortunately, I can’t tell you about that because I was born this way from the start, and people will never be able to sense my demon aura when I’m in my human form." Zhang Fei’s answer disappointed Xiao Jingyi, but she didn’t force him to reveal his secret, even though she was much stronger than him. "So, you hate the winged race because they killed your parents, right? Who killed them?"

"A male grand elder named Tian Liefeng." Zhang Fei knew that man because he accompanied Tian Qiye to the Jiangshen Domain. "Actually, my late father, Tian Yunchang, was his cousin. He killed my father because he was different from them, and he fell in love with my late mother. My grandfather said that he was Tian Qiye’s close confidant, and that woman had a deep hatred for the demon race, so I’m sure she ordered him to kill my father."
"How did you survive?"

Xiao Jingyi sighed softly. "My late parents knew that the winged race would hunt them to the ends of the universe because their relationship was a disgrace to their race, and they would do anything to kill them. They entrusted me to my maternal grandfather when I was little, and I learned of their deaths from him."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin. "Why didn’t your late parents stay with you there? If they had stayed with you there, the winged race wouldn’t have been able to touch them, and they might still be alive today."

"You’re wrong about that," Xiao Jingyi replied with a heavy sigh. "Although my demon race doesn’t hate me because of my demon bloodline, they do hate my late father. That’s why he and my mother left the demon domain, and they moved from one domain to another to avoid the pursuit of the winged race. Unfortunately, they ended up falling into the hands of those people, and they killed both of them."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and asked her again. "Why did you go to the human domain and disguise yourself as a human? Wouldn’t it be better for you to stay in the demon domain? Once you reach the Celestial God Realm and your demon rank reaches the demon god level, you can go find them and avenge your parents’ deaths."

"Do you think I want to hide in this domain?" Zhang Fei put on a curious look after Xiao Jingyi asked. "There were some problems in my home domain, so I was forced to flee that place and hide here. Luckily, my grandfather gave me this necklace, or I would have had serious problems with both of my identities."
Zhang Fei could guess without having to ask her. "Are you thinking of returning to the demon domain? I can help you go to one of the demon domains, and no one will dare to bother you there."
"What—"
"Big Sis Xiao, my husband is Nalan Shizhe’s son-in-law, and Qi Qingxiu is one of his wives." Yang Lu’er suddenly spoke from a distance.

Xiao Jingyi’s eyes widened and her jaw dropped, and she stared at Zhang Fei with a shocked expression. As a demon, she naturally knows both demon gods, but she finds it difficult to believe that he is Nalan Shizhe’s son-in-law and Qi Qingxiu’s husband.
Zhang Fei immediately opened a portal to the training space, asking Nalan Wangzi and Qi Qingxiu, who were training inside, to come out.
Xiao Jingyi was even more shocked after the two women came out, especially when she saw Qi Qingxiu. "De—Demon God Qingxiu!"
"Hmm?" Qi Qingxiu looked at her. "Oh? You have the Eternal Night Demon Bloodline in your body, eh? However, you are not a pure demon, and you—"

"She is half the winged race." Nalan Wangzi and Qi Qingxiu looked at Zhang Fei, who immediately told them Xiao Jingyi’s true identity. "Her real name is Ye Jingyi, and she used the surname Xiao as her human disguise."
Nalan Wangzi nodded in understanding and looked at Xiao Jingyi again. "Why don’t you bring her to our sect, Husband? She is stronger than me, so she would be a valuable addition to our sect."

"She needs strength, and she also needs demon qi to increase her demon rank, which means our sect is not a suitable place for her." Zhang Fei explained to them about Xaio Jingyi’s personal matters, including her grudge against the winged race. "If she wants to take revenge on them, she must increase her cultivation and demon rank, and the demon realm is more suitable for her. However, she had problems in the Eternal Night Demon Domain in the past, which forced her to leave and hide in this domain."

"Haha." Qi Qingxiu laughed at that. "Hey, husband! Ye Mingran has already decided to be on your side, and Ye Futian is your grandmaster, remember? If you talk to them, I’m sure they will protect this woman, so I think there’s no problem if she returns to the Eternal Night Demon Domain."
Once again, Xiao Jingyi was shocked listening to their conversation, especially because Zhang Fei also knew Ye Mingran and Ye Futian. "Do... do you really know Demon God Mingran?"
