chapters.title: Chapter 1467: Talk With Four Demons
paragraphs: Inside the residence, Xiao Jingyi was extremely tense as two demon gods sat before her. Furthermore, Qi Qingxiu, who was Zhang Fei’s wife, did not behave like a demon god; instead, she acted like a proper wife.
"Miss Jingyi, are you willing to stay in Qingxiu’s domain?"
Xiao Jingyi looked at Zhang Fei. "Why are you so eager to help me? After all, we just met today, and we didn’t know each other before."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at her question. "As the saying goes, the enemy of your enemy is your friend. We both have the same enemy, the Winged Race, so I want to help you to become stronger to face them. However, not all of them are bad people, and I have a relationship with those people."
"For example?"

"Tian Yizu, Tian Huangjin, Tian Zhiling, Tian Huotian, Tian Wei, Tian You’an, and Tian Xuanyin." Xiao Jingyi was surprised to hear that Zhang Fei had favorable relations with several grand elders of the Winged Race. "I don’t know how to tell you about them, but they are people from that race who are on my side, at least for now."
"For now?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Even though they are on my side now, it doesn’t mean they will be forever. After all, we can’t know the hearts of living beings, right? They are on my side now, but they might betray me in the future, so I will always be wary of them."
"Does that mean you suspect me too?"

Zhang Fei looked at Ye Mingran and smiled at her. "I may be younger than you, but I’ve faced many things in the past, and betrayal was one of them. Long before I became a cultivator, my lover betrayed me and collaborated with my big brother to frame me. My feelings at that time were painful after I found out the truth, and their betrayal taught me many things. I may seem trusting to everyone, but I assure you that I always keep an eye on everyone, and I will immediately eliminate anyone once I detect any intention of betrayal from any of them."
"You’re so cautious, huh?" Ye Mingran glanced at Qi Qingxiu before asking another question. "What would you do if any of your wives betrayed you?"

"Does that question need to be asked?" Zhang Fei glanced at Qi Qingxiu, who was curious about his answer. "My feelings and love for all my wives are unquestionable, and I love them wholeheartedly. Even though I love them, my love for them will never blind my mind, and I will give them their worst nightmare if they dare to betray me, no matter who they are. In the past, I killed my biological brother, Zhang He, and my ex-lover, Chen Xing, so you should not doubt my words."
Ye Mingran and Xiao Jingyi were completely shocked by Zhang Fei’s answer, and they didn’t expect him to have the heart to kill his biological brother. "Don’t you have a problem with that, Qingxiu?"

"Why should I mind that?" Qi Qingxiu answered Ye Mingran casually. "Like my husband, I will kill anyone who dares to betray me and harm the people around me, regardless of who they are. Therefore, I will support him if he wants to kill any of his wives or family members who have bad intentions towards him, and I will help him if he can’t bear to do it himself."

Nalan Wangzi shook her head slightly when Ye Mingran looked at her. "Just like Aunt Qingxiu, I will support my husband’s decision regarding them, Aunt Mingran. If they have to die, it is due to their mistakes, and they must take responsibility for those mistakes."

"Phew." Ye Mingran sighed to herself because Zhang Fei and the two women were truly extreme. If she were in that position, she wouldn’t necessarily dare to make such a decision. Even though she was a demon god, she would never have the heart to kill her family members, and she would probably spare them and simply banish them from her domain. "Since there’s nothing more we need to discuss, I’ll return to my domain now because I still have some matters to attend to."

"Haha." Qi Qingxiu laughed after Ye Mingran left in a hurry. "Mingran is a demon god like me, but her character is the opposite of yours, Husband. If she were to encounter such a situation, I’m sure she wouldn’t kill that person, and she would definitely spare him or her."

"Not everyone can think like you, including demon gods, Husband." Nalan Wangzi turned to Zhang Fei. "My mother was in a similar position when her little brother betrayed her and collaborated with Mo Shentian, but she didn’t kill him and banished him from our domain. Even so, he still died at the hands of that demon god, and my mother quite regretted his death."
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow after hearing that. "Does my mother-in-law still hold a deep grudge against Mo Shentian?"

"Hehe." Nalan Wangzi giggled. "Even if Mo Shentian didn’t kill my uncle, my mother would still hate him because he forced her to marry me off to Mo Taizi. To my mother, the three of us are everything to her, so she was really angry about that. Even though they were both demon gods, she couldn’t fight him because he was much stronger than her, and he could bend reality. She was worried that our demon race would become extinct, so she was forced to follow his wishes and marry me off to her son. Fortunately, you were present in this realm, and you saved me from that situation; otherwise, I would have ended up like Shang Xueli."

Xiao Jingyi, who had been listening to their conversation in silence, was shocked again after Nalan Wangzi mentioned that matter. ’Did he really fight Mo Shentian and his Celestial Demon Race before? How did he manage to return safely? My grandfather once told me that the Celestial Demon God is the strongest among the ten demon gods, and the others are helpless before him.’

"You’re wrong; I’ve never fought Mo Shentian before." Xiao Jingyi turned to Zhang Fei in confusion, wondering how he could have read her mind. "I don’t like to fight head-on without knowing my chances of winning, so I will use other means to destroy my enemies if I can’t do it myself. So, do you want to move to Qingxiu’s demon domain? Even though you can’t leave her palace, you can increase your strength faster there, especially your demon rank."

Xiao Jingyi refused with a shake of her head. "I want to become strong and take revenge on Tian Liefeng, but I can’t leave this city, at least not yet. I’ve lived here for too long, and I’m quite close to the residents of this city, so I can’t leave them all of a sudden."

Qi Qingxiu wanted to talk to Xiao Jingyi and persuade her, but Zhang Fei immediately stopped her. "If that’s your decision, I will respect it, and I won’t force you to train in that domain. If you’re ready someday, you can tell my two wives at my alchemy shop, and I’ll send you to that domain."
"Thank you."

After sending Nalan Wangzi and Qi Qingxiu into the training room to continue their training using the gravity feature, Zhang Fei and Xiao Jingyi returned to the alchemy shop while chatting on the way there.

Although the city wasn’t as large as other cities, Zhang Fei really liked it because it was truly peaceful, and no other cultivators tried to cause trouble there. He thought of letting Huang Rong and Yang Lu’er manage their shop for a while before asking them to return to the Moonlit Passion Temple, and he would help them to increase their soul power once they were there. However, he needed someone to watch over his shop if he asked the two women to return to the sect, but he didn’t have a good choice for now.

When they arrived at the alchemy shop, Zhang Fei and Xiao Jingyi did not go inside; instead, they jumped onto the roof of the building in front of it to watch the customers, who were busy choosing pills inside the shop.

Zhang Fei checked on Mu Lingshu, Lin Dong’er, Cheng Wenjie, Tasha, and several others who were enjoying themselves in the city. He could see that they were not disturbed at all, and they were enjoying themselves by buying many traditional foods from the city, especially the female demon wolf.
Xiao Jingyi tilted her head and asked him. "How did you get so many wives? You even got Demon God Qingxiu and the two princesses of the Soul-Devouring Race as your wives."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed as he used despicable methods to get Qi Qingxiu and Nalan Yushu as his wives. As for Nalan Wangzi, she seduced him first because she didn’t want to marry Mo Taizi, and he just went with the flow. "I got to know the three of them by chance, and I used a little underhanded method on two of them. As you already know, I’m a lust demon, and they aren’t immune to abilities related to lust."

Xiao Jingyi knew that, but she felt that Zhang Fei used other means to get them as his wives, especially Qi Qingxiu. After all, she was a powerful demon god, and she felt that he would not succeed in conquering her just by relying on his lust demon abilities.

chapters.title: Chapter 1468: Shang Fengxue
paragraphs: "Have you decided to help Zhang Fei? It’s been three weeks since he came to us, but he still hasn’t come to see us again to this day."

Xie Yao shook her head at Xie Yan. "I don’t think he’ll come to us before we make a decision, Yan’er. I’ve been thinking about his offer for the past three weeks, but I’m unsure whether joining him is our best option or not. Moreover, he gave us such a tough condition, and we can’t possibly fulfill his request to infiltrate Qian Yan’s domain. She was afraid that Shang Zhanluo would find out about Shang Fengxue’s departure to the sect, and she was worried that he would be furious if he found out about it. She knew that Feng Yao was protecting the sect, and she was afraid that he would fight her later, which she believed would be his defeat.
Shang Luohu looked at the two lust demon gods. "Are you two sure you won’t accept Zhang Fei’s offer?"

"We are tempted and interested in his offer, but we haven’t decided whether to accept it or not. If we accept, it would mean fulfilling his request to go to Qian Yan’s domain to gather some information, which would be too dangerous for us." Xie Yan answered her.

Xie Yao hugged his partner’s waist. "His offer is tempting, but it won’t be of any use if we die at Qian Yan’s hands, right? By the way, we’ll be returning to our domain now, but please inform us whether your sister-in-law managed to catch Zhang Fei’s attention or not."
"Alright."

After the two lust demon gods left, Shang Zhui appeared beside Shang Luohu and asked her. "Why did you decide to send Princess Fengxue to Zhang Fei’s place, Empress? What if my Emperor finds out about the affair and is furious because of your decision?"
"Sigh." Shang Luohu released a soft sigh. "Did you know that the Celestial Demon Realm closed their realm, Zhui?"

Shang Zhui nodded. "They activated their barrier around three weeks ago, and no one was able to enter and exit the domain after that. I feel Mo Shentian’s decision is truly unusual because he has always been confident in his abilities, and no other demon race has ever dared to invade his domain, including the Heavenly Fiend Demon, Sha Mo."

"Yes." Shang Luohu got up from her chair and walked to the balcony of the palace, followed by Shang Zhui behind her. "After they activated their barrier, I tried going to the Celestial Demon Domain, but I couldn’t enter there with my current cultivation level. I tried contacting Mo Shentian and Mo Zainan, and I told them that I wanted to visit my daughter. They didn’t answer my messages, so I was forced to return to our domain."
"Do you think that something happened to the Celestial Demon Race, Empress?"
Shang Luohu nodded slightly. "I’m sure something has happened in the Celestial Demon Race, and my gut tells me it has something to do with Zhang Fei."
"Zhang Fei?"

"For now, that’s just my guess, but my guesses are never wrong." Shang Luohu faced him and asked a question. "Have you heard the news about the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, the Eternal Night Demon Race, and the Seven Emotions Demon Race?"
"I heard that those three demon races have sent their representatives to join the Moonlit Passion Temple."

"That’s right." Shang Luohu nodded at him. "I’m sure the other demon races have heard about their movements as well, but they haven’t made any moves yet. Besides the four demon races, I sense that there’s been a change in the Nine Nether Demon Race, but I can’t be sure about it because the Jiu Mozu still holds sway over that race. However, I heard that Jiu Moze has returned, and he has started to get involved again in the affairs of that race."
"That’s weird." Shang Zhui thought about several possibilities in his mind. "Jiu Moze has long abandoned the affairs of their demon race, and Jiu Mozu is in full control of the race."

"However, Jiu Moze suddenly reappeared and interfered in the affairs of the race, and the race has been passive since his return. Somehow, I feel that their situations have something to do with Zhang Fei." Shang Luohu shifted her gaze forward again. "Furthermore, I also heard a rumor that Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha have also joined the Moonlight Passion Temple, which is impossible with Mo Shentian’s character."

Shang Zhui contacted Tian Shuixian to confirm everything, but his son didn’t provide too many details. His son only informed him that members of the four demon races, including the two princesses of the Celestial Demon Race, had joined the Moonlit Passion Temple. "Empress, Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha have indeed joined the sect, and they joined there on the same day that Mo Shentian closed his domain with the barrier."

"So that’s true, huh? Since Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha really joined Zhang Fei’s sect, I’m sure of my suspicions that he is the mastermind behind the change in the Celestial Demon Race." Shang Luohu paused for a while. "I don’t know how he managed to do that, but I suspect that Mo Shentian isn’t in his domain right now; otherwise, he wouldn’t have managed to do that, mainly because the Celestial Demon God is simply too powerful for the current him."
"Perhaps Empress Huo Yanling is assisting Zhang Fei in taking action against the Celestial Demon Race."

Shang Luohu agreed with him. "With his current cultivation, Zhang Fei would never be able to do all of those things himself, and he needed the help of others to carry out all his actions. The story would be different if Empress Huo helped him do all of that, and no one would be able to stop him if that were true."
"So, you decided to send Princess Fengxue to Zhang Fei because of this, Empress?"

"More or less." Shang Luohu turned to him again. "Back then, I didn’t understand where Zhang Fei’s confidence came from to save my daughter from the Celestial Demon Race, and he was also able to retrieve her hair and pieces of her dress. The answer is clear now, and he has already taken action against that demon race without anyone else, including Mo Shentian, being aware of it. What do you think will happen if my husband chooses to become his enemy? That kid already has a lot of support behind him, including Empress Huo."
"My emperor will die if he has to face all of them, especially Empress Huo."

"Not even the Four Perils and Long Wuzhao dare to fight Empress Huo, and she has long declared that the Moonlit Passion Temple and the Twin Flames Main Domain are under her protection. If my husband antagonizes Zhang Fei and chooses to become his enemy, I’m sure he will die, and our demon race will fall under his control." Shang Luohu let out a soft sigh. "Judging from her previous expression, Shang Fengxue was not interested in him, but she was interested in his strength and abilities, so I let her go to that sect to see for herself the situation there."

Shang Zhui nodded in understanding. "However, you’ve forgotten that Zhang Fei is a lust demon, Empress. Even if Princess Fengxue has no interest in him, she might change her mind if she’s affected by his abilities, and she might even fall into his arms."

"I know." However, Shang Luohu had different thoughts than Shang Zhui, and she believed that Shang Fengxue would not fall into Zhang Fei’s arms. "Let’s wait for the outcome of their meeting, and I will explain everything to my husband if my sister-in-law falls into his arms."

Shang Zhui could only sigh in his heart, and he was worried that Shang Luohu’s decision to send Shang Fengxue to the Moonlit Passion Temple would backfire on them, which would incur Shang Zhanluo’s wrath. If that were to happen, a battle would ensue between their Asura Demon Race and Zhang Fei, and they would surely lose badly with so many powerful cultivators standing behind him.
Shang Luohu understood her worries. "Don’t worry, Zhui. I’m sure everything will turn out well, and it might even lead our race to a better future."

"I hope so, Empress." Shang Zhui replied with a heavy sigh. "If the outcome is different from your expectations, our Asura Demon Race will likely be destroyed, and we will likely fall under Zhang Fei’s control."
"I know."
Meanwhile, Shang Fengxue had arrived at the Twin Flames Main Domain, and she was truly shocked by the changes in the domain, just like the cultivators who had gone there before her.

Shang Fengxue ignored the changes to the domain and flew to the floating plateau, which was the location of the Moonlit Passion Temple. Upon reaching the outermost perimeter of the sect, she immediately stopped flying when she saw Tian Kui and Serpentera, who had appeared to stop her. "Eh? I didn’t expect this sect to have two powerful sects as its guardians, and you two are as strong as my brother."
"What brings you to this sect, Asura Demon?" Tian Kui asked.

"Zhang Fei." The two beasts raised their eyebrows at Shang Fengxue. "I didn’t come to this sect to cause trouble, and I only wanted to meet him for a sparring match. I previously heard about him from my sister-in-law, and I’ve watched his fight with the three guardians of our demon race, which made me curious about him and his fighting abilities. That’s why I came here to challenge him to a sparring match, so I hope you two will allow me to enter this sect to meet him."
’The Asura demon race are truly fighting maniacs.’ The two beasts thought to themselves. "Our master—"

"So, you decided to send Princess Fengxue to Zhang Fei because of this, Empress?"
"More or less." Shang Luohu turned to him again.
"Back then, I didn’t understand where Zhang Fei’s confidence came from to save my daughter from the Celestial Demon Race, and he was also able to retrieve her hair and pieces of her dress.
The answer is clear now, and he has already taken action against that demon race without anyone else, including Mo Shentian, being aware of it.
What do you think will happen if my husband chooses to become his enemy?
That kid already has a lot of support behind him, including Empress Huo."
"My emperor will die if he has to face all of them, especially Empress Huo."
"Not even the Four Perils and Long Wuzhao dare to fight Empress Huo, and she has long declared that the Moonlit Passion Temple and the Twin Flames Main Domain are under her protection.
If my husband antagonizes Zhang Fei and chooses to become his enemy, I’m sure he will die, and our demon race will fall under his control." Shang Luohu let out a soft sigh.

"Judging from her previous expression, Shang Fengxue was not interested in him, but she was interested in his strength and abilities, so I let her go to that sect to see for herself the situation there."
Shang Zhui nodded in understanding.
"However, you’ve forgotten that Zhang Fei is a lust demon, Empress.
Even if Princess Fengxue has no interest in him, she might change her mind if she’s affected by his abilities, and she might even fall into his arms."
"I know." However, Shang Luohu had different thoughts than Shang Zhui, and she believed that Shang Fengxue would not fall into Zhang Fei’s arms.
"Let’s wait for the outcome of their meeting, and I will explain everything to my husband if my sister-in-law falls into his arms."

Shang Zhui could only sigh in his heart, and he was worried that Shang Luohu’s decision to send Shang Fengxue to the Moonlit Passion Temple would backfire on them, which would incur Shang Zhanluo’s wrath.
If that were to happen, a battle would ensue between their Asura Demon Race and Zhang Fei, and they would surely lose badly with so many powerful cultivators standing behind him.
Shang Luohu understood her worries.
"Don’t worry, Zhui.
I’m sure everything will turn out well, and it might even lead our race to a better future."
"I hope so, Empress." Shang Zhui replied with a heavy sigh.
"If the outcome is different from your expectations, our Asura Demon Race will likely be destroyed, and we will likely fall under Zhang Fei’s control."
"I know."
Meanwhile, Shang Fengxue had arrived at the Twin Flames Main Domain, and she was truly shocked by the changes in the domain, just like the cultivators who had gone there before her.
Shang Fengxue ignored the changes to the domain and flew to the floating plateau, which was the location of the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Upon reaching the outermost perimeter of the sect, she immediately stopped flying when she saw Tian Kui and Serpentera, who had appeared to stop her.
"Eh?
I didn’t expect this sect to have two powerful sects as its guardians, and you two are as strong as my brother."
"What brings you to this sect, Asura Demon?" Tian Kui asked.
"Zhang Fei." The two beasts raised their eyebrows at Shang Fengxue.
"I didn’t come to this sect to cause trouble, and I only wanted to meet him for a sparring match.
I previously heard about him from my sister-in-law, and I’ve watched his fight with the three guardians of our demon race, which made me curious about him and his fighting abilities.
That’s why I came here to challenge him to a sparring match, so I hope you two will allow me to enter this sect to meet him."
’The Asura demon race are truly fighting maniacs.’ The two beasts thought to themselves.
"Our master—"
*Swoosh*
"Shang Fengxue, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1470: Zhang Fei - Shang Fengxue
paragraphs: Shang Fengxue’s expression turned serious as soon as Zhang Fei [5] appeared before her, and she could sense his cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm, but she couldn’t sense his presence. "Zhang Fei, right? How do you know my name when I haven’t told your two guardians about it?"

"It’s not difficult for me to recognize your identity." Shang Fengxue eyed Zhang Fei [5] suspiciously, especially since she didn’t know that his fourth clone was monitoring the Asura Demon Palace while calming his bloodlust. "I know you are Shang Zhanluo’s little sister, and your cultivation has already reached the 2-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm. I know you came here after Shang Luohu showed you some things about me, especially regarding my fight with three of your four demon race guardians."
Shang Fengxue did not reply to him and observed him with extreme seriousness. "Did you leave anything in our domain to keep an eye on us?"
"You can say it like that." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Tian Kui and Serpentera, who nodded in understanding and disappeared from the scene. "Follow me."
"Alright."

Shang Fengxue was amazed when Zhang Fei [5] led her into the Moonlit Passion Temple. Like other cultivators in the Paradise Realm, she knew that the sect used to be a dual cultivation sect, but it had transformed and become a universal sect. She could also sense the presence of all races there, and she had never seen any other place where all races were gathered in one place. "Were you the one who turned this sect into a universal one?"

"I couldn’t possibly change this sect by myself, and all the members helped me make it happen." Shang Fengxue looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "In the past, people looked down on this sect because it was a dual cultivation sect, and we worked together to change it for the better."
Shang Fengxue nodded in understanding and asked another question. "Are you really a lust demon? Do the members of this sect know your identity? How did you convince them to accept you?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at her questions. "Do you even need to ask that? You can already sense the presence of several demons from several races in this sect, so you shouldn’t need to doubt that the people of this sect already know my identity. The majority of them have been with me since the Three Mortal Realms, and I was the one who brought them to this realm several years ago. As for the cultivators of this realm, they never cared about demons, and they wanted change, so they could accept me easily."
Shang Fengxue checked the surrounding area with her senses before speaking again. "If I think about it again, this sect is the only place in this realm where all races can gather in peace."

"I’m not concerned about the differences of all races, and I only want a peaceful life. As long as they have the same dreams as me, I will accept them into this sect, and they can live here safely and comfortably without hostility." Zhang Fei [5] looked at her. "Honestly, I have already offered your sister-in-law for your demon race to join us, but she can’t make a decision without your big brother, so I have to wait for him to come out of her seclusion."

"My big brother will never be willing to join you." Zhang Fei [5] was not surprised by Shang Fengxue’s answer. "Just like Mo Shentian, my big brother has always dreamed of becoming the leader of all the demon races, so I’m sure that he will never submit to anyone else, let alone join a human sect. All races now inhabit this sect, and my big brother has issues with some races, particularly the winged race."
"How about you?"

Shang Fengxue shook her head at him. "I’m different from my big brother, and I don’t have as big an ambition as him. I’ve never been hostile to the other races, even though some of them truly hate me because I’m a demon. For me, I just want to be strong so I can protect myself, and I can only become strong by fighting with cultivators who are much stronger than me. That’s why I decided to come to this sect after my sister-in-law told me about you, and I want to spar with you because I believe you are stronger than the four guardians of our race."

"How can you be so sure that I’m stronger than them?" Zhang Fei [5] asked her with a smile. "Since Shang Luohu already showed you my fight with three of your race’s four guardians some time ago, you should know that I’m not as strong as you imagine."

"Humph!" Shang Fengxue snorted at him. "You managed to defeat Shang Xijiao and draw with Shang Nanshui, but I noticed that you were still holding back when you fought with Shang Beixuan. If you hadn’t held yourself back then, I’m sure you would have defeated him, and I’m sure that you could have defeated Shang Dongzhu as well."

"Hehehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "You’re overpraising me, you know? I managed to defeat Shang Xijiao, but the fact is I couldn’t defeat Shang Nanshui and Shang Beixuan. Shang Dongzhu is much stronger than both of them, so I’m not confident I can defeat him."
"I will never believe your words, and I want to prove your abilities by fighting against you."

Zhang Fei [5] looked at Shang Fengxue with an amused smile because she was so confident that she could defeat the four asura guardians, even though she hadn’t watched their past matches in person, and she had seen everything from Shang Luohu’s memories. "Alright, I’ll spar with you, but I hope you won’t be disappointed if my fighting skills don’t meet your expectations."

"I’ll be disappointed if you don’t fight me for real." Shang Fengxue looked at him. "I will fight you for real, and I will use all my fighting skills to fight you in our sparring match. If you don’t use all your strength to face me, you will definitely die by my hands."
’This woman is a maniac fighter like Jian Kuang.’ Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "I don’t want to die because I have many wives by my side, so I will fight you with all my strength."
"Good." Shang Fengxue became excited after his statement, and she eagerly anticipated starting their sparring match.

Soon, they arrived at the training area, and several people who sensed Shang Fengxue’s presence were already waiting there, such as Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, Han Ling, and several others.
Some of Zhang Fei’s wives were also present, such as Luo Yunxiao, Xu Ling’er, Zhang Chen, and several others.

Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng caught Shang Fengxue’s attention. She had never met the three men before, but she had heard of them, and they were some of the best rogue cultivators in Paradise Realm.

Shang Fengxue glanced at Zhang Fei [5]. ’How did he gather these people in this sect? The three of them are rogue cultivators who never wanted to have any relationship with anyone in the past. Yet, they are here now, and they seem to respect him very much.’
"Who is this woman, Kid? Why does her aura feel familiar to me?" Jian Kuang asked.
Su Shentian observed Shang Fengxue because he felt like he had seen her before, but he couldn’t remember exactly where and when they had met.

"If I’m not mistaken, that woman is the princess of the Asura Demon Race." Jian Kuang and Su Shentian turned their heads to Zhuxian Sheng. "I can’t remember when and where I saw her, but I’m sure my guess about her identity was not wrong. If I recall correctly, she should be Shang Zhanluo’s sister."
"Oh?" Jian Kuang and Su Shentian immediately returned their gazes to Shang Fengxue. "I’ve heard that Shang Zhanluo’s sister is a fighting maniac, but I’ve never met her in person."
"Doesn’t that mean she’s the same as you, Old Jian?" Su Shentian asked this question while observing Shang Fengxue. "You’re the sword maniac, and she’s a fighting maniac."

"Hahaha." Jian Kuang laughed upon hearing that. "I wanted to test her fighting skills, but she seems obsessed with knowing that kid’s fighting abilities, so I’ll let them have a sparring match first."

Zhang Fei [5] brought Shang Fengxue over to them. "Her name is Shang Fengxue, and she is Shang Zhanluo’s sister. She came to our sect specifically to challenge me to a sparring match, especially after she heard from Shang Luohu about my fight with some asura guardians some time ago."
"I see." Jian Kuang nodded in understanding. "Alright, you two can spar now, and I’ll spar with her after you guys are done."
Su Shentian immediately spoke to Shang Fengxue. "You mustn’t hold back when you two spar, or he will defeat you easily."
"Oh?" Shang Fengxue glanced at Zhang Fei [5] before asking them. "Is his fighting ability as extraordinary as I imagined?"

"Hahaha." Jian Kuang laughed at her question. "The three of us have sparred with him too many times, and you should know our reputation, but we’ve never managed to defeat him. If you underestimate him too much, you won’t be able to move in front of him, and he will defeat you."
"Don’t listen to them; they’re just making things up." Zhang Fei [5] walked to the center of the arena and took out a sword. "Let’s spar now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1471: Zhang Fei Vs Shang Fengxue
paragraphs: *Clang... Clang...*
The sound of metals clashing with each other was heard in the training ground as they attacked each other, but Zhang Fei [5] was pushed back several steps by the force of Shang Fengxue’s attack.

Although she seemed to have the upper hand, Shang Fengxue was surprised that Zhang Fei [5] was still standing after blocking her attack, and he was only pushed back several steps, even though she had used her full strength in the previous attack.

"As I expected, your physical strength is far greater than that of cultivators at your level; otherwise, you wouldn’t have been able to block my attack." Shang Fengxue attacked Zhang Fei [5] again and used her full strength.

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t dare underestimate Shang Fengxue’s strengthl, and he felt that her strength was superior to that of the four asura guardians, even though he had never fought Shang Dongzhu before. However, he felt that his speed was too slow compared to theirs, and all of his wives were much faster than him. "You are too focused on your strength, and your speed is too slow."
*Clang... Clang...*
Since Shang Fengxue’s strength was superior to his due to the difference in their cultivation, Zhang Fei [5] increased his speed to parry and counterattack her.

Just as Zhang Fei [5] expected, Shang Fengxue started to have difficulty attacking him because she couldn’t keep up with his speed. Even so, she always managed to block his attacks solely by relying on her fighting instincts, leaving him unable to land a single hit on her.

Jian Kuang crossed his arms in front of his chest with his fists clenched into fists, and his eyes moved to follow the movements of the two. Although Shang Fengxue’s speed was slower than Zhang Fei [5]’s, she was still much faster than the average cultivator, and her fighting instincts amazed him.

Su Shentian also said nothing as his eyes continued to move to follow the two’s movements, and he was quite impressed by Shang Fengxue’s ability to block all of Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks, even though she couldn’t keep up with his speed.
While watching the two fight, Zhuxian Sheng felt the blood within his body boil, and he wanted to experience the power of Shang Fengxue’s attacks through a spar with her.

Meanwhile, Luo Yunxiao and several other women wore serious expressions, and they focused on studying Shang Fengxue’s movements and fighting style, which were entirely different from their husband’s. If their husband relied more on his speed and accuracy in his attacks, she relied more on her raw attack power.

Long Xiaolian and Jun Qingling had never seen Zhang Fei [5] fight with their eyes, but the case was different for Shang Yuelan, who had fought with him before. He even broke her beloved sword at that time, which made her depressed.

Shang Yuelan knew Zhang Fei [5]’s speed was exceptional, but she was truly shocked to see that it was much faster than during their previous encounter, which made her realize he had been holding back in that fight. Even Shang Fengxue, much stronger than him in terms of cultivation, could only rely on her instincts to block all his attacks.

Even though she could block all of Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks, Shang Fengxue was frustrated because she couldn’t attack him back, let alone land a hit on his body. Furthermore, his speed was getting faster with each passing second, which made it increasingly difficult to predict his attacks. ’Tch! My guess was right that he was indeed holding back when he fought three of my race’s four guardians.’

’She is indeed a maniac fighter, and her battle instincts are sharper than those of the four asura guardians! Even though she can’t follow my movements, she can still thwart all my attacks just by relying on her instincts.’ Zhang Fei [5] smiled and decided to increase his speed even further, and he attacked Shang Fengxue with greater precision.

Shang Fengxue was shocked when Zhang Fei [5] did that, and she didn’t expect that he could still increase his speed even further. His attack speed was significantly faster than before, and his accuracy in targeting her improved, making it increasingly difficult for her to defend against all his attacks.

After he fought with the four asura guardians in the Asura Demon Domain that time, Zhang Fei [5] realized that his fighting skills were still minimal. Since then, he has often trained with Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng to further hone his fighting skills.

Zhang Fei [5] could have defeated Shang Fengxue earlier if he had borrowed the power of the remaining evil beasts in his beast space, but he didn’t do that because he wanted to use their sparring sessions to improve himself.

Shang Fengxue was completely frustrated with the change in their sparring, and she thought about using her little strength to turn the situation around. However, her pride as a fighter prevented her from doing so, especially since Zhang Fei [5] was still much weaker than her in terms of cultivation.

"Gah!" Shang Fengxue was pushed back after Zhang Fei [5] struck her abdomen, and he immediately moved in front of her, pressing his sword to her neck. "Your speed is too fast for me, and I can’t keep up with your movements at all."

Zhang Fei [5] drew back his sword and put it away again. "Your main mistake is that you focused too much on the power of your attacks, but you neglected your speed. In real combat, attack power is important, but it’s useless if we can’t attack our enemy because of the difference in our speed. Unlike you, I’ve honed my speed for years, but I haven’t forgotten the power of my attacks, so the two are evenly matched for me."

"You’re right." Shang Fengxue kept her weapon. "In my asura demon race, everyone focuses on our physical strength, except for a few people. Additionally, we too often rely on our Bloodline Awakening Technique, which increases the speed and power of our attacks several times."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "In the past, I also relied too much on my strengthening techniques to increase my attack power, but everything changed after I faced a powerful cultivator. I almost died at that person’s hands that time, so I started to change my fighting habits, and I no longer rely on my strengthening techniques, like when I fought your asura guardians."
"So, I guessed right that you were holding back in a fight, huh?"

"No." Zhang Fei [5] denied with a shake of his head. "I never hold back my strength in actual combat, but I don’t want to rely on my strengthening technique because that power isn’t my true strength. Although I still use it sometimes when I’m facing stronger enemies, I rarely use it anymore, and I prioritize using my true strength like in our fight just now."
Shang Fengxue nodded in understanding. "Can you show me your strengthening technique?
"Sure."

Shang Fengxue instantly froze in shock at her spot after Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link to borrow the power of one of the evil mythical beasts, especially since her cultivation became on par with her big brother, Shang Zhanluo. "Unbelievable! Your cultivation has directly reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable!"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] deactivated the soul link immediately. "Unfortunately, this strength is not my true strength, and I only borrow other people’s strength to improve mine. That’s why I don’t want to rely on my techniques anymore, and I want to use my strength to fight the enemies that come my way. If I keep using my techniques to fight my enemies, I will really die when I meet an enemy that is too strong, like the person I met that time."
"Who is that person?"

"I don’t know that person’s identity, but I know she’s much stronger than all the demon gods, including your father." Zhang Fei [5] didn’t want to reveal Yuan Xiajie’s identity to her. "I continued honing my fighting skills and increasing my strength because I want to face her again in the future, and I will defeat her then."
"A woman, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Shang Fengxue. "Is that woman much stronger than Empress Huo?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly. "There isn’t a single cultivator from the Paradise Realm who is stronger than Feng Yao, and I can say for certain that she is the strongest in the entire universe."

Shang Fengxue had no doubts about it because all the demon gods were also afraid of Feng Yao, including her father, Shang Zhanluo. However, she was curious about the identity of the woman mentioned by Zhang Fei [5] earlier, and she wanted to meet her for a sparring match. Unfortunately, his expression clearly showed that he did not want to say anything about the woman’s identity, so she did not insist on asking him about it either.

"If you still want to spar with me, you can stay in this sect for a while, and we will welcome you." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Jian Kuang and the others. "Moreover, they also want to spar with you, so you should stay in this sect for a few days and spar with them."

Shang Fengxue agreed with that. "I wasn’t satisfied with our sparring, and I’d like to spar with you again another time. Furthermore, I have no business in my domain, so I’ll be staying in the sect for a while."

sentences.text: *Clang...
Clang...*
The sound of metals clashing with each other was heard in the training ground as they attacked each other, but Zhang Fei [5] was pushed back several steps by the force of Shang Fengxue’s attack.

Although she seemed to have the upper hand, Shang Fengxue was surprised that Zhang Fei [5] was still standing after blocking her attack, and he was only pushed back several steps, even though she had used her full strength in the previous attack.

"As I expected, your physical strength is far greater than that of cultivators at your level; otherwise, you wouldn’t have been able to block my attack." Shang Fengxue attacked Zhang Fei [5] again and used her full strength.

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t dare underestimate Shang Fengxue’s strengthl, and he felt that her strength was superior to that of the four asura guardians, even though he had never fought Shang Dongzhu before.
However, he felt that his speed was too slow compared to theirs, and all of his wives were much faster than him.
"You are too focused on your strength, and your speed is too slow."
*Clang...
Clang...*
Since Shang Fengxue’s strength was superior to his due to the difference in their cultivation, Zhang Fei [5] increased his speed to parry and counterattack her.
Just as Zhang Fei [5] expected, Shang Fengxue started to have difficulty attacking him because she couldn’t keep up with his speed.
Even so, she always managed to block his attacks solely by relying on her fighting instincts, leaving him unable to land a single hit on her.
Jian Kuang crossed his arms in front of his chest with his fists clenched into fists, and his eyes moved to follow the movements of the two.
Although Shang Fengxue’s speed was slower than Zhang Fei [5]’s, she was still much faster than the average cultivator, and her fighting instincts amazed him.

Su Shentian also said nothing as his eyes continued to move to follow the two’s movements, and he was quite impressed by Shang Fengxue’s ability to block all of Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks, even though she couldn’t keep up with his speed.
While watching the two fight, Zhuxian Sheng felt the blood within his body boil, and he wanted to experience the power of Shang Fengxue’s attacks through a spar with her.
Meanwhile, Luo Yunxiao and several other women wore serious expressions, and they focused on studying Shang Fengxue’s movements and fighting style, which were entirely different from their husband’s.
If their husband relied more on his speed and accuracy in his attacks, she relied more on her raw attack power.
Long Xiaolian and Jun Qingling had never seen Zhang Fei [5] fight with their eyes, but the case was different for Shang Yuelan, who had fought with him before.
He even broke her beloved sword at that time, which made her depressed.

Shang Yuelan knew Zhang Fei [5]’s speed was exceptional, but she was truly shocked to see that it was much faster than during their previous encounter, which made her realize he had been holding back in that fight.
Even Shang Fengxue, much stronger than him in terms of cultivation, could only rely on her instincts to block all his attacks.
Even though she could block all of Zhang Fei [5]’s attacks, Shang Fengxue was frustrated because she couldn’t attack him back, let alone land a hit on his body.
Furthermore, his speed was getting faster with each passing second, which made it increasingly difficult to predict his attacks. ’Tch!
My guess was right that he was indeed holding back when he fought three of my race’s four guardians.’
’She is indeed a maniac fighter, and her battle instincts are sharper than those of the four asura guardians!

Even though she can’t follow my movements, she can still thwart all my attacks just by relying on her instincts.’ Zhang Fei [5] smiled and decided to increase his speed even further, and he attacked Shang Fengxue with greater precision.
Shang Fengxue was shocked when Zhang Fei [5] did that, and she didn’t expect that he could still increase his speed even further.
His attack speed was significantly faster than before, and his accuracy in targeting her improved, making it increasingly difficult for her to defend against all his attacks.
After he fought with the four asura guardians in the Asura Demon Domain that time, Zhang Fei [5] realized that his fighting skills were still minimal.
Since then, he has often trained with Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng to further hone his fighting skills.

Zhang Fei [5] could have defeated Shang Fengxue earlier if he had borrowed the power of the remaining evil beasts in his beast space, but he didn’t do that because he wanted to use their sparring sessions to improve himself.
Shang Fengxue was completely frustrated with the change in their sparring, and she thought about using her little strength to turn the situation around.
However, her pride as a fighter prevented her from doing so, especially since Zhang Fei [5] was still much weaker than her in terms of cultivation.
"Gah!" Shang Fengxue was pushed back after Zhang Fei [5] struck her abdomen, and he immediately moved in front of her, pressing his sword to her neck.
"Your speed is too fast for me, and I can’t keep up with your movements at all."
Zhang Fei [5] drew back his sword and put it away again.
"Your main mistake is that you focused too much on the power of your attacks, but you neglected your speed.
In real combat, attack power is important, but it’s useless if we can’t attack our enemy because of the difference in our speed.
Unlike you, I’ve honed my speed for years, but I haven’t forgotten the power of my attacks, so the two are evenly matched for me."
"You’re right." Shang Fengxue kept her weapon.
"In my asura demon race, everyone focuses on our physical strength, except for a few people.
Additionally, we too often rely on our Bloodline Awakening Technique, which increases the speed and power of our attacks several times."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"In the past, I also relied too much on my strengthening techniques to increase my attack power, but everything changed after I faced a powerful cultivator.
I almost died at that person’s hands that time, so I started to change my fighting habits, and I no longer rely on my strengthening techniques, like when I fought your asura guardians."
"So, I guessed right that you were holding back in a fight, huh?"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] denied with a shake of his head.
"I never hold back my strength in actual combat, but I don’t want to rely on my strengthening technique because that power isn’t my true strength.
Although I still use it sometimes when I’m facing stronger enemies, I rarely use it anymore, and I prioritize using my true strength like in our fight just now."
Shang Fengxue nodded in understanding.
"Can you show me your strengthening technique?
"Sure."

Shang Fengxue instantly froze in shock at her spot after Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link to borrow the power of one of the evil mythical beasts, especially since her cultivation became on par with her big brother, Shang Zhanluo.
"Unbelievable!
Your cultivation has directly reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable!"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] deactivated the soul link immediately.
"Unfortunately, this strength is not my true strength, and I only borrow other people’s strength to improve mine.
That’s why I don’t want to rely on my techniques anymore, and I want to use my strength to fight the enemies that come my way.
If I keep using my techniques to fight my enemies, I will really die when I meet an enemy that is too strong, like the person I met that time."
"Who is that person?"
"I don’t know that person’s identity, but I know she’s much stronger than all the demon gods, including your father." Zhang Fei [5] didn’t want to reveal Yuan Xiajie’s identity to her.
"I continued honing my fighting skills and increasing my strength because I want to face her again in the future, and I will defeat her then."
"A woman, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Shang Fengxue.
"Is that woman much stronger than Empress Huo?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly.
"There isn’t a single cultivator from the Paradise Realm who is stronger than Feng Yao, and I can say for certain that she is the strongest in the entire universe."
Shang Fengxue had no doubts about it because all the demon gods were also afraid of Feng Yao, including her father, Shang Zhanluo.
However, she was curious about the identity of the woman mentioned by Zhang Fei [5] earlier, and she wanted to meet her for a sparring match.
Unfortunately, his expression clearly showed that he did not want to say anything about the woman’s identity, so she did not insist on asking him about it either.
"If you still want to spar with me, you can stay in this sect for a while, and we will welcome you." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Jian Kuang and the others.
"Moreover, they also want to spar with you, so you should stay in this sect for a few days and spar with them."
Shang Fengxue agreed with that.
"I wasn’t satisfied with our sparring, and I’d like to spar with you again another time.
Furthermore, I have no business in my domain, so I’ll be staying in the sect for a while."

chapters.title: Chapter 1472: Search The Best Location
paragraphs: After he finished his spar with Shang Fengxue, Zhang Fei [5] left the training ground, and he went to some other areas of the Moonlit Passion Temple to check on some things.

Meanwhile, Shang Fengxue remained at the training ground and continued her sparring with the three men who were impatient to fight her. Although she had never met them before, she had heard their names, so she was pleased that they wanted to spar with her.

For the first time, Shang Fengxue sparred with Jian Kuang. Unlike when she sparred with Zhang Fei [5] previously, she used her Bloodline Awakening Technique when she fought the sword maniac, mainly because he was much stronger than her.

Luo Yunxiao and the other women did not return to their residence in the back mountain area because their husband was in another domain, and they wanted to become more skilled in fighting by watching the sparring between Shang Fengxue and the three men. Even though they had sparred with each other for decades during their time in seclusion, they felt that their fighting abilities were far inferior to hers because she was an Asura Demon who constantly thrived on battle.

Long Xiaolian, Jun Qingling, and Shang Yuelan were also eager to fight Shang Fengxue to hone their fighting skills. Unfortunately, they still had to wait a long time before they could spar with her, especially since she had to fight the three men first.
On the way, Zhang Fei [5] met the four women who had come to look for him. They were the four leaders of the Hidden Moon Sect: Nong Qinwei, Yun Chang, Dongfang Yuechan, and Lan Xuening.

The four women had specifically waited for Zhang Fei [5] to discuss the Hidden Moon Sect’s move to that domain, especially since the natural races had already finished constructing new buildings for their new sect. "Since the buildings for our sect are now complete, and our disciples have also finished preparing for their move, we will bring them to the domain as soon as possible. This way, we can operate as usual again, and we will begin accepting assassination missions again."

"I think that’s good." Zhang Fei [5] wanted some of his demon fox group members to join the Hidden Moon Sect, but he dropped the idea because they didn’t want to join the sect, and they wanted to operate separately from them. "In that case, you should bring your sect members here as soon as possible, and they can start training at the Celestial Yin Lake in my sect to improve themselves."

Lan Xuening directly spoke to him. "We and our members are not dual cultivators, but I hope you can share your yang qi with us, and we also need dual cultivation techniques to cultivate your yang qi."

Without hesitation, Zhang Fei [5] handed over quite a lot of his yang qi to Lan Xuening because he had his real body and five clones, so his stock would never be lacking, and he also imparted the Sun-Moon Harmony Sutra into her mind. "Even though it is not my original technique, it is still useful for all of you to cultivate my yang qi. As for my original technique, I only share it with all my wives, and I never share it with outsiders."

Lan Xuening and the other three women also knew about the matter, and they had no problem if Zhang Fei [5] was unwilling to share his original technique with them. After they discussed some other matters, they immediately left the Moonlit Passion Temple, and they headed to their old sect in the Empyrean Domain to pick up all their members.
Afterwards, Zhang Fei [5] went to the array hall to meet Duanmu Luolan and Liao Yunxiao, asking the two women about their preparations for setting up arrays in their domain.
"Preparations for the Sect Guardian Formation Array are complete, and we can install it soon." Duanmu Luolan said.

Liao Hanxue then spoke to him. "As for the arrays in this domain, we still have to wait a few days for them to be completed, and we will install them afterward. After that, not many cultivators will be able to invade this domain, and they will have to face powerful illusions to enter it. If they force themselves into this domain, the illusions will mislead them and attack their mental state. However, those formation arrays probably won’t work against powerful cultivators, like Long Wuzhao."

Zhang Fei [5] himself had already taken this matter into account, mainly because they were cultivators who stood at the peak of cultivation, like Tian Qiye, Long Wuzhao, and several others. At the very least, those formations could protect their domain from cultivators below their level, and those closest to him would be safe to stay there.
"Do you still need other formations for this sect?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment before making a decision. "This sect is indeed protected by the void barrier, but some cultivators, such as Tian Qiye, can still break through with their strength. Therefore, we will add some other formations to strengthen our defenses, such as the mist formation and others."

Liao Hanxue nodded in agreement with him. "I have several such formations, and I already have the materials to create them, so we will install them after we install all the formations for this domain."

"I think it’s good." Zhang Fei [5] then took out the Peak Grade Qi Veins, which shocked Liao Hanxue. "I’ve been keeping them for so long because I still haven’t decided where I should install them, but I think I should install them in this sect to improve the quality and quantity of qi here."
Liao Hanxue was truly shocked to see the Peak Grade Qi Veins because they were created naturally in the ground, and it was impossible to obtain them in intact condition.

Liao Hanxue wanted to ask Zhang Fei [5], but Duanmu Luolan immediately stopped her because it would just waste time. She knew that her husband would not reveal the origin of the Peak Grade Qi Veins to anyone, including them.

Liao Hanxue nodded in understanding, took the Peak Grade Qi Veins from Zhang Fei [5], and observed them. "Their quality is top-notch! If these Peak Grade Qi Veins are planted in this sect, both the quality and quantity of Qi will increase significantly, enabling all cultivators here to cultivate faster."
"I guess so." Zhang Fei then asked her, "Where do you think the right location is to implant these veins?"

Liao Hanxue thought for a moment before giving her an answer. "You should implant them right in the center of this floating plateau, and they will gradually spread throughout the area on their own. Once they have spread throughout the area, no other area in any domain will be able to rival the quality and richness of the qi here, and this sect will become the only place with the richest qi in the paradise realm."
"The center of the floating plateau, huh?"
"Yes." Lian Hanxue returned the Peak Grade Qi Veins to him. "I wanted to help you, but I’m still busy with these formation arrays, so you’ll have to do it yourself."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] immediately stored the Peak Grade Qi Veins and left the array hall.

Lian Hanxue turned to Duanmu Luolan. "Where exactly did your husband get those veins? From their condition, I believe they’re new qi veins that have never been used before, so I’m sure he didn’t take them from somewhere else. If he took them from anywhere else, no matter how careful he was in doing so, they would be defective in some way."

"Sigh." Duanmu Luolan couldn’t help but sigh. "Sister Hanxue, we are all his wives, and he has always been open with us about some things, but there are some things he has kept hidden from us until today. We have asked him about them several times, but he is unwilling to tell us the truth."
"Is it true that none of you know his secrets?"

"Yes." Duanmu Luolan nodded at her. "He hid everything from everyone, including his grandmother, two sisters, and his mother. We’ve tried to lure him into revealing his secrets to us, but he never budges and keeps everything to himself."
Liao Hanxue nodded in understanding. "Forget it! I think we should speed things up, and we will set up those formation arrays in this domain and sect."
"Alright."
Zhang Fei [5] was already at the very center of the floating plateau, and he asked Mei to scan the area before he implanted the Peak Grade Qi Veins there.
"What are you doing here, husband?"
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Qing Qiu’er and showed her the Peak Grade Qi Veins. "I will implant them in our sect."

Just like Liao Hanxue, Qing Qiu’er was also shocked to see such perfect Peak Grade Qi Veins in Zhang Fei [5]’s hand. However, she didn’t ask him about their origins because she was sure he wouldn’t tell her the truth. "Are you really going to plant them here, husband?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "At first, I was hesitant to plant them in this sect, and I wanted to find a better place to plant them, like the Ancient Realm. However, Feng Yao told me that I don’t need to think about that realm because the qi in both realms is equal, but the situation in this Paradise Realm is much better, so I decided to plant them in our sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 1473: Planting The Qi Veins
paragraphs: After Mei found a suitable place, Zhang Fei [5] dug and implanted the Peak Grade Qi Veins within it. Although the results wouldn’t be immediately felt by everyone in the sect, he was confident that the quality and quantity of qi there would improve significantly, which would benefit everyone living there.
"Hmm?" Qing Qiu’er scanned the surrounding area of the sect. "How long will the effects take to start after you implant these veins?"

Zhang Fei [5] hugged her waist. "Those veins need time to fuse with this floating plateau, and the qi here will increase significantly once they are perfectly fused, so we only need to be patient to see the results in the future. When they are perfectly fused with this floating plateau, the qi here will increase several times, and everyone who lives here will be able to feel their benefits for their cultivation."

"After they produce their effects, I am sure that all of our sect members will greatly enjoy the results, and we will become even stronger in the future." Qing Qiu’er turned to him. "What are your next plans after this?"

Zhang Fei [5] observed everyone in the sect thoughtfully. "My fourth clone has almost finished absorbing Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul, so I don’t need to hold back any longer. I plan to go to the Celestial Moon Domain to search for some people who ascended to this realm through the Moon Tower, and I’ll bring them here if they’re interested in joining us. If they want to stay in the Celestial Moon Sect, I won’t force them to join us. Besides, Tian Junfeng and Shangguan Lizhi are probably still challenging the tower, and I’ll try to talk to the tower guardian to let them ascend here so they can reunite with their families soon."

"I see." Qing Qiu’er wasn’t surprised by her husband’s decision because he always thought about all of his wives’ families. "However, you must remember that the Celestial Moon Domain and Celestial Moon Sect only accept female cultivators, so you can’t possibly go there by yourself. Besides, those male cultivators who come from the upper realm won’t be accepted by either of them, and they might go to other domains to join other sects."

"I know that." Zhang Fei [5] looked in another direction. "I will ask Yuan Tianling and Yuan Tianhua to contact them, and I will send some of my clones to pick them up after they get the news from the members of their families."
Qing Qiu’er nodded at him. "You should go meet them now, and I will wait for you at the top of the mountain."
"Why did you come here, Zhang Fei?"
Zhang Fei [5] explained to Yuan Tianhua the purpose of his visit. "I want you to contact your parents now and ask for their location, and I will arrange a time to pick them up."

"Alright." Yuan Tianhua herself really missed her parents because they had ascended to the Paradise Realm much earlier than her. "Zhang Fei, my parents did not join the Celestial Moon Sect, but they lived in the outer area of the Celestial Moon Domain. Are you going to go pick them up today?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her. "I’m going to that domain in about two weeks, and I’ll let you know when I’m ready to go there, so I’ll take you there to look for your parents. Then, what about the others? Are they also in that domain?"

"Yes." Yuan Tianhua told him directly. "Some of them decided to join the Celestial Moon Sect, such as Aunt Beihuang Fan and Aunt Nalan Qingge. Meanwhile, the rest of them decided to go to other domains, but my parents don’t know where they are because they lost contact with them, such as Uncle Yuan Tiancheng and a few others."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Since Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge have joined the Celestial Moon Sect, it’s impossible to force them to join us, so we’ll go to that domain specifically to pick up your parents, and you guys can reunite afterward. In that case, I will return to the top of the mountain now, and I will inform you when I am ready to go to that domain."
"Thank you." After Zhang Fei [5] left, Yuan Tianhua hurried to the people from the Yuan Clan to inform them.

Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived at the residence and was sitting with Yuan Tianling, informing her that he was going to the Celestial Moon Domain to pick up Yuan Tianhua’s parents. "What about the others, husband? Are you also going to bring them to this sect?"

"Beihuang Fan and Nalan Qingge have already joined the Celestial Moon Sect, so I can’t force them to join us, or we’ll get in trouble with the people from that sect." Yuan Tianling nodded understandingly at Zhang Fei [5]. "As for Yuan Tiancheng and the others, Tianhua doesn’t know their whereabouts because they’ve lost contact with her parents."

Yuan Tianling raised an eyebrow at that. "That’s really unusual, Husband. Our Tian Clan has never done something like that before, and communication between all our clan members has always been smooth. I’ll go to the residence area now, and I’ll talk to Yuan Tianxie and the others, so you don’t have to waste your time taking care of this matter."
"Alright."

Thereafter, they parted ways: Yuan Tianling went to meet the members of the Yuan Clan, while Zhang Fei went to the mountaintop to meet his four wives, where they engaged in dual soul cultivation together.

In the Azure Cloud Domain, Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction as he watched his shop fill up with customers, and he even had to restock some of his sold-out pills. Next to him, Xiao Jingyi was also pleased that her townspeople could get the best pills at a more affordable price than they would in larger cities. "Since this shop is running smoothly and the customers are orderly, I will take some of my wives to some other domains to check out our shops there."

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "As you already know, I have more than a hundred wives by my side, and I opened my shops to support their needs. Zhang Fei chose that city as their main shop because it wasn’t the main city in the domain, and there were no alchemy shops there, meaning his shop had no competition. Furthermore, he didn’t manage the shop himself; his two wives did. Therefore, he sought a location that would be safe for them and also offer a promising opportunity to sell pills.

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "I chose this city because it’s not huge, but it has a large population. Most of them are wealthy cultivators, and they are willing to spend many jewels to buy my pills."
"Husband, you still want to check out our shop, right?" Zhang Fei nodded to Lin Dong’er. "In that case, we’ll go take a stroll around this city and buy some traditional goods here."
"Alright." Lin Dong’er immediately led her sisters to another area, but Chang Wenjie didn’t join them. She chose to accompany Zhang Fei to their alchemy shop. "Why don’t you join them, Wenjie?"

Chang Wenjie shook her head slightly and placed her head on his shoulder. "I was buying many things in town earlier, so I think I’ve had enough, and I’ll keep your company here. Aren’t you going inside our shop to meet Sister Chen and Sister Ling, Husband?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1474: Sealed Their Domain
paragraphs: "What happened, wife? Have you heard from our daughter?"

"Yes." Huo Jinying sat beside Long Huoyan and recounted her daughter’s activities at the Moonlit Passion Temple. "After a week, our daughter finally contacted me, and she told me a lot about the sect. She really liked the atmosphere in the sect, and everyone there treated her well. Additionally, she acquired a master in swordsmanship named Han Ling, a human from the Three Mortal Realms. Although his cultivation was much lower than hers, he possessed extraordinary skills in swordsmanship, and Zhang Fei was his disciple."

"Oh?" Long Huoyan was surprised to hear that, but he was truly satisfied after knowing that his daughter enjoyed herself at the Moonlit Passion Temple. "Has she also found a master in the body cultivation path?"

Huo Jinying shook her head and informed him. "The Moonlit Passion Temple has the Body Hall, but our daughter is still focused on training under Han Ling. After she finishes training with him, she will try to go to that hall. However, she has already conducted research on the hall, and she informed me that the cultivators supervising it are Zhang Fei’s wife and in-laws. They also come from the Three Mortal Realms, but they are highly skilled in the body cultivation path."
"Zhang Fei has so many wives, and the sect is like his residence."

"Zhang Fei has more than a hundred wives." Long Huoyan choked after hearing Huo Jinying’s statement. "All his wives also live in the sect, but not all of them take care of it, and they live in their residence behind the mountain."
"What about Huli Wanqing?"

"Huli Wanqing joined the alchemist hall, and she learned alchemy under the guidance of a female alchemist god, Lin Jingxia."Huo Jinying told her husband about the activities of the two women. "Just like our daughter, she also enjoyed her time in the sect, and she started to befriend many other disciples, including demons."
"Don’t the people in the sect hate our daughter and Huli Wanqing?" Long Huoyan was worried because the other races had never liked their demihuman race.

Huo Jinying smiled and hugged her husband. "You don’t need to worry about them, Husband. They told me that all races there were treated the same, including the demon race. They met the two princesses of the Celestial Demon Race there, but they were no different from women from other races, and they were not like other demons."
"I see." Long Huoyan nodded in understanding. "I think it’s good for them, but you also have to warn them to be careful of everyone there, especially the demons."
"Haha." Huo Jinying laughed at her husband’s worry. "Naturally, I have reminded them to take care of themselves, and they should understand the situation because they are grown women."

"Have you told Si Yingwu about this matter?" Huo Jinying nodded at Long Huoyan and told him about her conversation with her sister earlier. "I think I should arrange a time to go to the sect so I can see the situation there for myself."
"Sister Yingwu and I also want to see the situation in the sect firsthand, so we’ll accompany you if you really want to go there."
Long Huoyan hugged her. "I will arrange a time as soon as possible, and the three of us will go there soon."

Chang Wenjie kept smiling as Zhang Fei accompanied her for a walk, and she hadn’t had such a relaxing time since they ascended to the Paradise Realm. For the past few decades, they have always focused on their cultivation and training, and they have also always dual cultivated with him to improve their cultivation.
They spent time together walking around the domain while talking about many things, especially about their future. "Do you really want to have children with us in the future, husband?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and hugged her waist. "All of you always ask the same questions, you know? I want to have children with all of you, but I don’t want to have any right now, and I’ll impregnate all of you once our lives are truly calm and without danger. To be honest, I can’t wait to have children, but I’m not sure if I can protect all of you for now, so I don’t want to take the risk. When our lives are truly safe and there is no more danger threatening us, I will definitely impregnate all of you, so I hope you can be patient and wait for that day to come."
"Okay, I’ll be patient for now, but you have to get pregnant when everything calms down, okay?"
Zhang Fei looked at her. "I promise I’ll get you pregnant once everything calms down."
After they had walked around for a while and it was getting late, Zhang Fei took Chang Wenjie back to their alchemy shop, where all his other wives were waiting for them.
Fang Chen and Zhou Ling were excited as they informed Zhang Fei about their shop’s sales results on the opening day, which far exceeded their expectations. "What about the other shops, Husband?"

"So far, I just checked Huang Rong’s shop and this one, and I will go to the other domain to check tomorrow." Zhang Fei hugged Fang Chen and Zhou Ling, kissing them in turn. "Thank you both for your hard work over the past two weeks, and the opening of our shop went smoothly because of your hard work."
"Hehe." Zhou Ling giggled. "You’re our husband, and we don’t have the ability to help you in battle. Thus, we will always help you in areas we are proficient at, like managing this shop."
Fang Chen asked him. "What about all our shops on Earth, husband?"

"They’re still operating smoothly to this day, and I’ve sent one of my clones there several times to check on them. After all, the flow of time on Earth is too slow compared to this Paradise Realm, but the flow of time in the cultivation realms isn’t as slow there." Both women nodded understandingly to Zhang Fei. "After this shop has been operating smoothly for a few days, you two can hand it over to someone you trust, and I’ll take you guys back into seclusion. After all, your cultivation has long since stabilized, so I’ll focus on helping you all improve yours again."
Fang Chen and Zhou Ling felt excited after hearing that, and they couldn’t wait to become stronger so they could protect themselves better without having to rely on Zhang Fei all the time.
After they talked a lot, Zhang Fei decided to stay in the domain, and he helped all his wives to increase their soul power by dual soul cultivating with them.

Hun Lingwu was truly frustrated after visiting many domains over the past week to seek help from others in attacking the Moonlit Passion Temple, but none of them were willing to help him because they were afraid of Feng Yao and the people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain.

They had heard about the actions of the women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain some time ago, and they also knew that Feng Yao had announced that the Moonlit Passion Temple was under her protection. Whoever dared to disturb and attack the sect, they would face her wrath, and she would destroy them all.

Hun Lingwu himself did not dare to face Feng Yao and the women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, mainly because they were too powerful. That’s why he tried to ask for help from other cultivators to attack the Moonlit Passion Temple, but unfortunately, the results were not as he had hoped because they were not willing to help him.

Hun Lingwu considered several other solutions to attack the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he felt that none of them were good, and he was afraid that he would suffer the same fate as the people from the Stygian Dusk Domain if he decided to fight Feng Yao and her subordinates. In the end, he decided to hold back and wait for the right time, but the hatred in his heart continued to grow, especially his hatred for Zhang Fei.

After all the beasts that were previously in other domains returned to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Long Wuzhao and the higher-ups of the beast race decided to seal the domain so that no one could enter or exit, except for them and Zhang Fei.

Their actions made the natural races of the Divine Origin Main Domain wonder about their decision for sealing the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, especially since Long Wuzhao did not inform them beforehand. Some of them tried to contact the Dragon Emperor, but he gave them no clear answer, mainly because he couldn’t tell them about the Ancient Desolation Domain.

Long Wuzhao’s decision reached Tian Qiye, who wondered about the reasons behind his sealing of the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. After all, Tian Yaoqin hadn’t told her about the Ancient Desolation Domain because she was afraid her leader would punish her if she knew about her relationship with Zhang Fei.
