chapters.title: Chapter 1475: Lotus Expanse Domain
paragraphs: [Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Lotus Expanse Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

Unlike the previous two domains, the Lotus Expanse Domain was filled with open land, and there were only a few cities within it. The residents’ primary livelihoods are farming, raising and selling tame beasts, and hunting wild beasts.

The strongest cultivator in the Lotus Expanse Domain had achieved the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, which is the same level as the strongest cultivator in the Twilight Domain. However, no powerful cultivators from other domains tried to invade it, mainly because the higher-ups would protect the residents of that domain.

Although there were only a few cities in the Lotus Expanse Domain, the economy of the domain’s residents was not low, but not as high as that of the residents in the Sky Pillar Domain or the Heavenlight Main Domain.
Zhang Fei chose the domain for that reason, and he didn’t need to waste time fighting with powerful cultivators from the Paradise Realm.
"This domain is gorgeous, husband." Lin Dong’er said as she surveyed the areas.

Tasha agreed with her. "Nature in this domain thrives, and the air is also comfortable compared to other domains, including the Twin Flames Main Domain. I want to live here, but that’s impossible because everyone gathers in our sect."

"Why is it impossible?" Zhang Fei pulled Tasha into his arms and gave her a gentle kiss. "If you like this domain, I’ll ask Hong Yao to find a residence here. When we’re free, I’ll take you here, and you can enjoy nature here."
"Really, husband? Can we live in this domain?"

Zhang Fei patted her head. "Yunxiao has an island in the Thousand River Domain, and I already have plans for it. If you want to stay in this domain, I have no problem with that, but we will only stay here when we are free. Once your cultivation has reached the peak, you can stay here whenever you want."
"Hehe." Tasha giggled and hugged him. "I like this domain, and I will bring my father to live here in the future."
"Good." Zhang Fei turned to his other wives. "Do you guys also have the desire to live in other domains in the future?"
Mu Lingshu shook her head at him. "You are my husband, so I will live wherever you live."
"I am the same as Lingshu, and I will continue to stay by your side." Chang Wenjie said.

"Me too!" Lin Dong’er said. "By the way, I hope my father and the others are willing to move to this realm, husband. That way we can gather together here, and we don’t have to be apart again like now."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Honestly, I can bring everyone to our sect, but I’m not sure they’ll be willing to move to this realm, especially since the difference in their cultivation bases is too great. However, I’ll go find them and try to talk to them once our situation has stabilized, and I’ll bring them here if they’re willing to move."
"I know! Let’s meet Sister Hong Yao and the others."
When they arrived in front of the shop, they saw that there were already many potential buyers queuing in front of the door because there were no alchemy shops in that domain.
Some time later, Qiu Mei, Ren Xia, and Hong Yao opened the door and asked the buyers to enter in an orderly manner, assisted by several employees they had chosen beforehand.
Even though the domain looked safe and peaceful, Zhang Fei would never leave his three wives unprotected, and he sent one of his evil mythical beasts to protect them.

Hong Yao noticed their presence, but she didn’t greet them because Zhang Fei didn’t want the people of the realm to know that he was the owner, and he left all the affairs of their shop in the domain to his three wives.

Just like in the Azure Cloud Domain and the Twilight Domain, basic pills and healing pills were the best sellers in the store. Other pills also sold well, but their numbers were still lower than the basic and healing pills.
Zhang Fei asked Mu Lingshu and the others to go for a walk in the city, but he did not join them and lay on the roof of the building while monitoring the customers inside the shop.

[What are your next plans, Master? Taotie and the others are on their way to the Three Mortal Realms, and they won’t be back anytime soon. Mo Shentian is also the same as them, and I’m sure he hasn’t reached the exit of the tunnel yet. Shang Zhanluo is also still in seclusion since he met Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul, and we don’t know when he will come out.]

Zhang Fei folded his hands behind his head and lay on the roof, thinking about many things. "After I absorb Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul, I have to absorb his greed and envy souls before I can absorb his wrath soul. Unfortunately, both of them are hidden in the Ancient Realm, and my strength isn’t enough to go there yet. Moreover, there’s a possibility that the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast will notice my presence in that realm, and I’m not ready to face either of them."

[Unfortunately, I don’t have clear information about the Primordial Genesis Beast and the Primordial Nihility Beast, Master. They should be as strong as Feng Yao, and you will die if you fight with them with your current strength.]

"Yeah." Although Zhang Fei was always confident in his abilities and advantages, he always believed that there was a sky above the sky, which made him cautious and unwilling to underestimate the two primordial beasts. "Currently, five demon races are already on my side, and Mo Zainan has also taken over control of the Celestial Demon Race. I only have to subdue the other four, but it’s not a simple matter because every one of them is strong, especially the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God."

[Shang Zhanluo is a powerful demon god, and he still has his Bloodline Awakening Technique. I’m not sure you can face him for now, even if you borrow the power of the nine evil mythical beasts by your side. We do not have exact information about the strength of the Heavenly Fiend Demon, Sha Mo, and the Torture Demon God, Ku Shenzu. Moreover, the latter is still supported by the previous Torture Demon God, and we don’t know anything about that person. We already have information about the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon, Qian Yan, but his eye abilities are too dangerous.]

"That’s why I don’t want to deal with Qian Yan for now, and I want to use the two lust demon gods to monitor him and find Ju Yingzhi’s family. Unfortunately, they don’t seem to dare to infiltrate his domain either, so I have to think of something to infiltrate there and save her family." Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh and opened the system’s quest. "Do I have to meet all the beasts, natural races, and demons to complete the three quests, Mei?"

[I think so, Master. You still have to subdue the four demon races to complete the quest: Build up a deep relationship with demon races. I think the natural races are the same, and you’ve never visited them, except for the Fairy Race. As for the quest to build up a deep relationship with beast races, I think you can ask Long Wuzhao to help you meet all the beast races, and he should be willing to help you persuade them.]

"I’m not in a rush with them, and I’d rather focus on the four demon races, especially since they’re more dangerous." Zhang Fei looked at another quest. "Although You Feiling and the others have been actively recruiting disciples, the number of new disciples joining the sect hasn’t even reached a thousand yet."
[220 disciples, to be exact, Master.]

Zhang Fei was too lazy to personally recruit new disciples, as it was a waste of his time, and he preferred to leave it to the elders of his sect to recruit them. "There are still four quests in the Asura Demon Domain, four quests in the Celestial Demon Domain, and two quests in the Jiangshen Domain."

[Hehe.] Mei chuckled. [You still can’t defeat the four Asura Guardians, let alone defeat Shang Zhanluo. I’m sure the Asura Demon Race Treasure is in his hands, so you have to defeat him to seize it. The Celestial Demon Guardian should be with Mo Shentian now, so you should wait for him to return to this realm, and you can solve everything at once at that time.]

Zhang Fei could only sigh upon hearing that, as his strength was still far from enough to fight Mo Shentian and Shang Zhanluo. Even if he were to seclude himself for another hundred years, he wouldn’t necessarily be able to defeat the two of them. "To obtain the Spirit Willow Tree’s treasure, I have to wait for the tree to return first, and I don’t know how long it will take for it to return. After the tree returns, it can help me fight the Ghost Emperor, so I will wait until the time comes."
[The Ghost Emperor was too powerful, Master. Even Tian Qiye was defeated by him, so you’ll have to wait for the Spirit Willow Tree to return since you can’t lure him to another domain.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1476: Invite Two Demon Gods
paragraphs: Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh. "Tian Qiye, huh? I’m curious about her true strength, and I want to try fighting her. She’s powerful, but I’m sure her strength won’t surpass Long Wuzhao and the other dragons."
[Why don’t you wait for her to visit the Moonlit Passion Temple, Master? I think she won’t have any problem if you challenge her to a training spar, and we can gauge her exact strength then.]

"To be honest, I’ve been thinking about that, and I’ll try talking to her and asking her to spar with me then." Zhang Fei raised his right hand and clenched his fist. "I can face strong enemies now, but I’ll have to rely on the soul link to borrow the power of the evil beasts to defeat them. However, their strength won’t be enough to help me defeat Tian Qiye, especially since her strength is on a whole different level. I still need to defeat the five demon gods, and I believe their strength should surpass hers; otherwise, she would have already attacked them."

[Master, you have four demon gods by your side, so I think you can ask them to spar with you using their full strength. Although they aren’t as strong as Mo Shentian and the others, I’m sure you can become stronger with their help.]

Zhang Fei agreed with Mei, but he still had some considerations about asking them to train with him. After all, they were demon gods, and they couldn’t leave their domains for too long; otherwise, the other demon gods would attack their domains. He could help them monitor their domains using various means, but he would be in trouble if the other demon gods attacked them.
*Swoosh*
Zhang Fei turned to Feng Yao, who had just appeared by his side. "Do you want to ask them to accompany you to practice?"
"Can you help me protect their domains?"

"I can." Feng Yao nodded at him. "Wu Mian’s strength will be useless to you as long as he doesn’t use his real body, so you don’t need to invite him to train you. Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu aren’t that formidable either, and they manage to stand toe-to-toe with the other demon gods because of their ability to borrow the power of their subordinates. Without that ability, they’re no match for the other demon gods, so you don’t need to bring them with you. On the contrary, Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran are powerful because they’re true demon gods, so you can ask them to be your sparring partners, and I will protect their domains while they train you."

Zhang Fei seriously considered Feng Yao’s offer because Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, and Qi Qingxiu were the strongest to be his sparring partners. "I’ll talk to them both after this, and I’ll enter seclusion again later."

"Your cultivation has completely stabilized, but you need too much qi to break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm." Feng Yao turned to him and examined his body. "If my calculations are correct, it will take you at least ten years to break through to that stage with your current number of women, but I think it doesn’t matter because the time in your training space is four times faster than in the outside world."

Zhang Fei had already considered this issue because his cultivation was becoming increasingly difficult to improve after his last breakthrough, particularly since he required a vast amount of qi to break through to the next stage. Even though the number of women on his side reached over a hundred, the majority of them had cultivations below his, which meant that the amount of Yin Qi in their bodies was not as strong as before.
Zhang Fei thought about increasing the number of women by his side again, but not many women caught his attention, and only a handful of them could do so, such as Nalan Shizhe and Tian Qiye.

"Aren’t you interested in my subordinates?" Zhang Fei turned to Feng Yao. "Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, Huo Hao’er, Huo Xiaoyu, and Huo Fengyin should be attractive, right? Don’t you have any interest in them?"

"Did you deliberately send them with the intention of making me take them as my women?" Feng Yao neither agreed nor disagreed with Zhang Fei’s question. "They are beautiful and stronger than me, but I have no interest in them. Compared to them, I’m more interested in you, and I can’t wait to take you as my wife, but unfortunately, my dream will never come true."

"Hehe." Feng Yao chuckled. "Why are you so pessimistic? I told you that I would give myself to you if you managed to surpass me, and you could do whatever you wanted to me at that time. Therefore, you must try harder to increase your strength, or you will never succeed in getting me."

Zhang Fei did not say anything to answer Feng Yao, and he returned his gaze forward while thinking deeply. As a lust demon, he was always confident that he could get any woman he wanted, but not her, mainly because she was different from other women.
Feng Yao lay by Zhang Fei’s side with her body slightly above him, and she caressed his face while looking at him with a relaxed smile, but a second later their lips were pressed against each other.
Zhang Fei wanted to hug Feng Yao so badly, but he didn’t do that. His lips moved according to her guidance, and they kissed for a while before she separated their lips.
Feng Yao teased him. "Your reaction was really cute, you know? You have over a hundred women by your side, but sometimes I feel like you’re no different from a virgin."

"You’re a virgin yourself, remember? Moreover, you’ve been a virgin for several lifetimes, so you don’t need to mock me." Feng Yao simply smiled and entered Zhang Fei’s body again. "Will you protect their domain while they train with me?"
’Yes! Thus, you should go to them and ask them to train you, and they won’t have to worry about their domains.’
"Okay, I’ll meet them later."
After that, Zhang Fei waited a while until the number of customers in the shop had dwindled significantly, and then he went in to meet his three wives.

Since Tasha wanted to stay in the domain during her spare time, Zhang Fei asked Hong Yao and the others to look for a residence there, preferably one close to their shop. That way, his three wives wouldn’t have to sleep in the shop, and they could rest more peacefully in their residence later.

After speaking with Qiu Mei, Ren Xia, and Hong Yao for a while, Zhang Fei sent Tasha and the others back to the Moonlit Passion Temple. Afterward, he went to the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain to meet Nalan Shizhe.

Upon arriving at the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain, Zhang Fei immediately explained his plan to his mother-in-law to bring her into seclusion, which surprised Nalan Shizhe. "I know you’re thinking about your demon race, but you don’t need to worry about them. My brother-in-law should be able to take care of them, and Feng Yao will protect them while you’re gone, so I’m sure nothing will happen to them."
"Will Empress Huo really protect my demon race?" Nalan Shizhe asked doubtfully.
"She—"

"I will protect them." Feng Yao spoke as she emerged from Zhang Fei’s body. "For now, you just need to focus on helping him become stronger by being his sparring partner because he will have to face powerful opponents in the future, and I will protect your demon race during your absence. I’m sure no other demon race will dare invade this domain while I’m here, so you can rest assured that your sons and subordinates will be safe under my protection."

Since Feng Yao had already stated that she would protect her demon race, Nalan Shizhe decided to agree and contacted her son to inform him of several important matters, mainly because she was uncertain about how long she would be away from their domain.

After Nalan Shizhe finished taking care of some matters in her domain, Zhang Fei took her away from the Soul-Devouring Domain. They didn’t immediately return to the Moonlit Passion Sect, but instead, they went to the Eternal Night Demon Domain to meet Ye Mingran.

Ye Mingran, who was speaking with some demons, was slightly surprised by the sudden arrival of Zhang Fei and Nalan Shizhe. After dismissing her subordinates, she asked them. "Why did you come to my domain together?"
"My son-in-law wants to discuss something with you, so we came together to meet you."

Ye Mingran looked at Zhang Fei, who immediately explained to her the reason for their visit. "I know you’re worried about your demon race, but my grandmaster can protect them. Moreover, he won’t be alone in protecting them, and Feng Yao will be helping him, so you don’t need to worry about them."

Ye Mingran did not doubt Feng Yao’s ability to protect her demon race, but she didn’t directly give Zhang Fei the answer. She knew that his abilities were much deeper than they appeared on the outside, and she was truly curious to know how he could improve them so much, especially at his young age.

"Alright, I’ll help you improve yourself." Ye Mingran then contacted Ye Futian and informed him that she would be entering seclusion with Zhang Fei, and she informed him that Feng Yao would be helping him maintain security in their domain. "Let’s go now."

My brother-in-law should be able to take care of them, and Feng Yao will protect them while you’re gone, so I’m sure nothing will happen to them."
"Will Empress Huo really protect my demon race?" Nalan Shizhe asked doubtfully.
"She—"
"I will protect them." Feng Yao spoke as she emerged from Zhang Fei’s body.

"For now, you just need to focus on helping him become stronger by being his sparring partner because he will have to face powerful opponents in the future, and I will protect your demon race during your absence.
I’m sure no other demon race will dare invade this domain while I’m here, so you can rest assured that your sons and subordinates will be safe under my protection."

Since Feng Yao had already stated that she would protect her demon race, Nalan Shizhe decided to agree and contacted her son to inform him of several important matters, mainly because she was uncertain about how long she would be away from their domain.
After Nalan Shizhe finished taking care of some matters in her domain, Zhang Fei took her away from the Soul-Devouring Domain.
They didn’t immediately return to the Moonlit Passion Sect, but instead, they went to the Eternal Night Demon Domain to meet Ye Mingran.
Ye Mingran, who was speaking with some demons, was slightly surprised by the sudden arrival of Zhang Fei and Nalan Shizhe.
After dismissing her subordinates, she asked them.
"Why did you come to my domain together?"
"My son-in-law wants to discuss something with you, so we came together to meet you."
Ye Mingran looked at Zhang Fei, who immediately explained to her the reason for their visit.
"I know you’re worried about your demon race, but my grandmaster can protect them.
Moreover, he won’t be alone in protecting them, and Feng Yao will be helping him, so you don’t need to worry about them."
Ye Mingran did not doubt Feng Yao’s ability to protect her demon race, but she didn’t directly give Zhang Fei the answer.
She knew that his abilities were much deeper than they appeared on the outside, and she was truly curious to know how he could improve them so much, especially at his young age.

"Alright, I’ll help you improve yourself." Ye Mingran then contacted Ye Futian and informed him that she would be entering seclusion with Zhang Fei, and she informed him that Feng Yao would be helping him maintain security in their domain.
"Let’s go now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1477: Spar With Three Demon Gods
paragraphs: Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe watched in shock as several women, including Qi Qingxiu, struggled to stand up from the floor. They exchanged glances for a moment before turning to Zhang Fei. "They’re training in heavier gravity."
"Heavier gravity?"

"The device in the middle can adjust the gravity weight in this place from two times to a thousand times heavier." Zhang Fei’s answer shocked Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe. "Right now, I have adapted perfectly to 128 times heavier gravity, but I haven’t started training at 256 times heavier gravity because my body isn’t ready for it. Qingxiu has only been training here for a month, but she has already adapted to 8 times heavier gravity."

Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe looked at Zhang Fei as if he were a freak, and they finally understood why his speed was incredible. They suddenly saw his two clones enter the training space with so many women, a total of more than one hundred.

Nalan Shizhe was not surprised to see them because she had already heard about Zhang Fei’s number of women from her two daughters, but Ye Mingran was shocked to see so many of them, especially when she saw his two clones.
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at her expression. "Actually, I have five clones, but one is in the Asura Demon Domain, and I left the other at the Moonlit Passion Temple to guard."
"Then, where is the fifth?"
"There." Zhang Fei pointed at the pavilion. "My third clone is helping his two wives to improve their cultivation and soul power, mainly because both of them are lagging behind my other wives."

Ye Mingran nodded slightly as she watched Zhang Fei’s two clones and their wives enter the pavilion. "I didn’t expect that you had more than a hundred wives, and you shared them with your five clones."

"Haha." Nalan Yushu laughed as she approached them. "Aunt Mingran, our husband actually doesn’t need to share us with his clones, and our numbers won’t be enough to satisfy his lust, but we’ll wait too long to have sex with him if he doesn’t share us with them. You may not believe me, but you will understand his strength in bed if you have sex with him once."
Ye Mingran simply shook her head and turned to Nalan Shizhe. "Your second daughter is becoming a pervert now, Shizhe."
"Can’t help it, right?" Nalan Shizhe couldn’t help but sigh because her second daughter always talked about sex every time they met. "So, are we going to train here?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei asked Nalan Yushu to follow his sisters, and he led the two demon gods to another area. "The time flow in this place is four times faster than the outside world, so I will use my real body and my clones to train with you two. This place is unique, and you both do not need to worry about it being damaged, so you can use your maximum strength without concern."
Ye Mingran was still hesitant about it. "I know you’re strong, and I don’t dare underestimate you, but are you sure you want us to use our full strength to train you?"

"That’s true." Nalan Shizhe looked at Zhang Fei. "Son, you’ve already witnessed me using almost all my strength when I faced that soul beast, and I’m afraid I’ll injure you if I use all my strength to train you."

"You two look down on him too much." Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe turned to Qi Qingxiu, who had finished her training and was walking towards them. "Even though his cultivation is still at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm, his speed and physique have already surpassed demon gods like us. He has long mastered eight body techniques, and he is a mythical beast, so his physique is much stronger than any cultivator in this Paradise Realm. He might be overwhelmed by you two if you use your full strength, but I’m sure he will adapt to the situation quickly, and you will be the ones struggling to face him later. Moreover, he will face many things in the future, including Tian Qiye, so he must increase his strength even more."

Ye Mingran looked at Zhang Fei again in thought, but she suddenly activated her power and attacked him. However, he swiftly dodged her attack and moved away from her, but she quickly chased after him and attacked him again.
This time, Zhang Fei did not avoid Ye Mingran’s attacks; instead, he parried them and tried to attack her back.

After all, Ye Mingran was a demon god and one of the most experienced demon cultivators in the Paradise Realm, and she was able to easily break Zhang Fei’s counterattack. She realized that her speed couldn’t match his, and she increased her strength again by half.
Without his soul link, Zhang Fei was unable to deal with Yi Mingran’s attacks, just like when he fought with Shang Beixuan, forcing him to use his clone illusion steps as a distraction.

However, Yi Mingran was not fooled by Zhang Fei’s actions, and she followed his real body and attacked him faster. She refrained from using her demon abilities, and she only used physical attacks to attack him.

’She hasn’t trained in my training space yet, but her speed is already so fast that it surpasses the asura guardians, including Shang Beixuan.’ Zhang Fei’s blood was boiling with excitement, especially since he rarely fought with cultivators as strong as her. He had faced Jia Zizhen some time ago, but he felt that the former fairy king was too weak compared to the female demon god. ’Damn! She could still increase her speed, and her attacks got stronger every time she attacked me!’

Zhang Fei tried to avoid Ye Mingran, but the female demon god kept following him and continuously attacking him. Even though he wasn’t using his maximum speed, she was truly impressive to be able to follow him and attack him, especially since not many cultivators could keep up with his speed.

Nalan Shizhe, who was watching their fight from a distance, was impressed by Zhang Fei’s speed. Although she had seen him fight evil souls in the Wailing Soul Forest before, his speed was far faster than he showed at that time; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to dodge Ye Mingran’s attack.

Nalan Shizhe wanted to join forces with Ye Mingran to fight Zhang Fei, but she chose to hold herself back because she was sure that her son-in-law would not be able to face both of them at once, even though his speed was much faster than general cultivators.

Qi Qingxiu was also itching to attack Zhang Fei because she had never sparred with him before, and his sparring with Ye Mingran made her itch to test his fighting skills. However, she refrained from doing so and watched the two chase each other like cat and mouse, dodging each other’s attacks.

Tianshi Shengjie, Helian Xun’er, and several women who were focused on practicing using the gravity feature decided to stop. They sat in their spots and regulated their breath, but their gazes were focused on Zhang Fei and Ye Mingran, who were fighting in midair.

They knew Zhang Fei was extremely fast, but they didn’t expect Ye Mingran to be able to keep up with him and attack him. Every time he increased his speed, the female demon god did the same, keeping their distance close.

Moreover, they could see that Ye Mingran was still holding back, and she hadn’t used any of her demon abilities. If she decided to use her demon abilities, they were sure Zhang Fei would be even more overwhelmed, and he would likely lose to her.
Qi Qingxiu and Nalan Shizhe turned to Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2], who were walking towards them, and the two demon gods immediately exerted their strength before attacking his two clones.
Zhang Fei [1] directly faced Qi Qingxiu, and Feltia [2] faced Nalan Shizhe. The four of them fought in another area of the training space so their fight wouldn’t disturb his real body and Ye Mingran.
Although Qi Qingxiu’s speed was not as fast as Zhang Fei [1]’s, her demon abilities were quite terrifying and made it quite difficult for him to control himself.

On the contrary, Nalan Shizhe’s speed was not inferior to Ye Mingran’s, and her demon abilities were quite terrifying. Every time Feltia [2] got too close to her, he felt that she was absorbing his soul power, forcing him to fight her using long-range attacks.

Tianshi Shengjie clenched her fists tightly as she watched the three groups fight. She always felt that she was strong because she was born as a Celestial Dragon, but their spar made her realize that she was just a frog in a well. She was sure she would lose badly if she fought Zhang Fei, and she would probably die if she had to fight any of the three female demon gods. ’I always felt that my strength was quite high because of my physique as a dragon, but I was nothing compared to them.’

Helian Xun’er had been watching Zhang Fei since he first challenged the Star Tower years ago, and his cultivation had only just broken through to the Earth Realm at that time. She knew that his strength and speed far surpassed the average cultivator, so she wasn’t surprised to see him spar with the three female demon gods. However, their spar sparked something within her, and she became unwilling to lose to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1478: Shang Luohu - Shang Fengxue
paragraphs: Ursula and the other women were also amazed to see Zhang Fei and his two clones fighting with the three female demon gods, but they realized that Qi Qingxiu and the other two had not yet used their true strength; otherwise, he and his two clones would have lost long ago, especially those who fought Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe.

Ursula was once one of the most influential demons in the Diyu Realm, but she felt like a frog in a well when she witnessed the power of the three female demon gods. She knew Qi Qingxiu was much stronger than her, but she didn’t expect Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe to be even stronger. ’If my demon rank can reach the demon god rank and my cultivation reaches the Celestial Venerable Realm like the three of them, I’m sure that I will be stronger than them. Unfortunately, my cultivation is still at the Ten Mortal Realms, and it is still far from the Seven Divine Realms, let alone the Five Celestial Realms. For now, I have to focus on my cultivation, and I will ask Zhang Fei to help me.’
Tianshi Shengjie and the others watched the three spars for some time, and they continued their training again afterward because their spars stirred something deep in their hearts.

After sparring with the people for two full days, Shang Fengxue decided to stop and look for Zhang Fei, but Jian Kuang informed her that he had entered seclusion. "I still want to spar with the three of you, but I have to return to my domain now; otherwise, my big brother will look for me if he can’t find me there, and he will wreak havoc in the sect if he knows I’m here."

"Alright." Jian Kuang nodded understandingly at her. "If you want to spar with Zhang Fei again, I will ask him to contact you after he comes out of his seclusion, but I’m sure that won’t happen any time soon."
"Please tell Zhang Fei to contact me after he comes out of his seclusion." After saying that, Shang Fengxue immediately left the training ground and flew away from the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Zhuxian Sheng immediately spoke to the others. "She’s different from her ambitious big brother, right? Compared to Shang Zhanluo, his sister has no ambition to become a ruler, and she only wants to become a powerful demon cultivator to protect herself."

"Haha." Su Shentian laughed and patted his shoulder. "Shang Zhanluo is actually the same as us, and he wants to protect his Asura Demon Race, especially after what happened to his daughter. After all, the demon race is different from ours, and he must become a ruler among them if he wants to protect his family and his race; otherwise, a similar incident will happen to his race again."

Zhuxian Sheng shook his head at that. "I’m not familiar with matters within all the demon races, so I can’t say anything about them. However, I know that some demon races are extremely evil, and the Asura Demon Race is one of them. Although not all members of that race are evil, the majority of them are, and I will kill any of them who have malicious intentions."
"Let’s not talk about them, and we must continue to train our disciples." Jian Kuang immediately dismissed all the disciples on the training ground and led his three friends back to the Sword Hall.
Shang Fengxue had already arrived at the Asura Demon Domain and was speaking with her sister-in-law, Shang Luohu.

The Asura Empress already knew about the existence of several demons from several races in the Moonlit Passion Temple, so she was not surprised to hear that, but she was surprised to hear of Jian Kuang and the other two’s presence there.

Shang Luohu already knew that the two princesses of the Celestial Demon Race were in the Moonlit Passion Sect, but she previously still doubted it because she had not seen them with her own eyes. However, she was sure about it now, and her sister-in-law’s explanation confirmed her previous suspicions that Zhang Fei was the mastermind behind that demon race’s decision to seal their domain. "Did you meet Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha in the sect?"

"No." Shang Fengxue answered with a shake of her head. "Ever since I arrived at the sect, I only sparred with them, and I didn’t go anywhere to check. However, Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha were truly in the sect, and the people there did not mind their presence among them. I don’t know how you will persuade my big brother, but in my opinion, joining Zhang Fei is our best choice."

"You’re right." Shang Luohu agreed with that, but she sighed afterward because there was no way her husband would agree to their demon race cooperating with a human. "For now, we can only wait for your big brother to come out of his seclusion, and the two of us will speak to him then. However, we must not pressure him to join Zhang Fei, as this would make him angry with us, especially after he learned about his relationship with Hu Tianlang some time ago."
"Oh?" Shang Fengxue was surprised by that because Shang Luohu didn’t tell her about it beforehand. "Does Zhang Fei really meet the legendary ten-tailed fox?"

Shang Luohu created a qi screen that displayed events occurring in the underground area of the blood forest, particularly when Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul appeared before them. "As you can see, it’s one of the ten-tailed fox’s souls—to be precise, his bloodlust soul. Zhang Fei didn’t confirm it directly, but that soul has confirmed that he’s underground—to be precise, one of his clones."
"Hmm?" Shang Fengxue looked at the qi screen. "Is Zhang Fei’s clone really in there now?"

"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded. "I forbid you from going in there, Fengxue. Even though it’s just his soul, Hu Tianlang is powerful. Even your big brother is afraid of him, and he decided to go into seclusion after their meeting. Additionally, I forbid you from speaking to your brother about the decision of several demon races to join Zhang Fei, especially the two princesses of the Celestial Demon Race. If your big brother finds out about them, he’ll think that Mo Shentian isn’t in his domain, and he’ll raise the flag of war with them."

Shang Fengxue wasn’t stupid, and she knew the risks if her big brother found out about Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha’s presence in the Moonlit Passion Sect. If that happened, Shang Zhanluo wouldn’t just consider attacking the Celestial Demon Race, but he would also attack the sect to capture the two princesses. "Don’t worry, I won’t say anything to my big brother, or we will face a big war. Zhang Fei has extensive relations with various races, and some of them are too powerful, so our demon race will be destroyed if we find trouble with him."

"I don’t know yet how far Zhang Fei’s relationship with those people goes, but the strongest person behind him is Empress Huo Yanling." Shang Fengxue wasn’t surprised to hear that name from Shang Luohu’s mouth. "If your big brother seeks trouble with the Moonlit Passion Temple, she will send people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain to invade our domain. Although most of them are female humans, we cannot underestimate their strength because some of them have already reached the 3-Star Celestial Venerable Realm, but she still keeps them from going out in public. If she gets angry, she will send them to us to destroy us, just like what they did to other people a few months ago. Even if your big brother uses our Bloodline Awakening Technique, he will never be able to defeat her, and he will die in her hands."

Shang Fengxue let out a soft sigh after her sister-in-law said that. She had actually wanted to test Feng Yao’s abilities in combat, but she felt she wasn’t her match. Even if she used the Bloodline Awakening Technique against her, she had no confidence in being able to match her, let alone win.
"Are you going to the Moonlit Passion Temple again?"

Shang Fengxue shook her head at her sister-in-law. "I’ve sparred with Jian Kuang, Zhuxian Sheng, and Su Shentian before. I admit they’re powerful, as their reputations suggest, but I still feel that Zhang Fei is far stronger than them; otherwise, they wouldn’t be willing to help him train the disciples from his sect. Unfortunately, he just entered seclusion, and I don’t know when he’ll come out, so I’ll go to the sect again after he emerges from his seclusion."

Shang Luohu looked at her sister-in-law and observed her expression seriously. She felt that Shang Fengxue had already started to become obsessed with Zhang Fei, even though they had only known each other for a few days. However, she didn’t see any romance in her sister-in-law’s gaze, only an overwhelming desire to spar with him. "Do you think he can beat your big brother?"

"Zhang Fei can’t defeat my big brother right now, especially if he uses our Bloodline Awakening Technique. However, I’m sure he’ll be able to defeat my big brother in the future, and he’ll also defeat the other demon gods. When he succeeds in doing so, he will stand at the pinnacle of the cultivation world, and all cultivators in this realm will respect him." Shang Fengxue rose from her seat. "Since he’s in seclusion, I’ll train with the four guardians so I won’t lose to him."

However, I know that some demon races are extremely evil, and the Asura Demon Race is one of them.
Although not all members of that race are evil, the majority of them are, and I will kill any of them who have malicious intentions."
"Let’s not talk about them, and we must continue to train our disciples." Jian Kuang immediately dismissed all the disciples on the training ground and led his three friends back to the Sword Hall.
Shang Fengxue had already arrived at the Asura Demon Domain and was speaking with her sister-in-law, Shang Luohu.

The Asura Empress already knew about the existence of several demons from several races in the Moonlit Passion Temple, so she was not surprised to hear that, but she was surprised to hear of Jian Kuang and the other two’s presence there.
Shang Luohu already knew that the two princesses of the Celestial Demon Race were in the Moonlit Passion Sect, but she previously still doubted it because she had not seen them with her own eyes.
However, she was sure about it now, and her sister-in-law’s explanation confirmed her previous suspicions that Zhang Fei was the mastermind behind that demon race’s decision to seal their domain.
"Did you meet Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha in the sect?"
"No." Shang Fengxue answered with a shake of her head.
"Ever since I arrived at the sect, I only sparred with them, and I didn’t go anywhere to check.
However, Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha were truly in the sect, and the people there did not mind their presence among them.
I don’t know how you will persuade my big brother, but in my opinion, joining Zhang Fei is our best choice."
"You’re right." Shang Luohu agreed with that, but she sighed afterward because there was no way her husband would agree to their demon race cooperating with a human.
"For now, we can only wait for your big brother to come out of his seclusion, and the two of us will speak to him then.
However, we must not pressure him to join Zhang Fei, as this would make him angry with us, especially after he learned about his relationship with Hu Tianlang some time ago."
"Oh?" Shang Fengxue was surprised by that because Shang Luohu didn’t tell her about it beforehand.
"Does Zhang Fei really meet the legendary ten-tailed fox?"
Shang Luohu created a qi screen that displayed events occurring in the underground area of the blood forest, particularly when Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul appeared before them.
"As you can see, it’s one of the ten-tailed fox’s souls—to be precise, his bloodlust soul.
Zhang Fei didn’t confirm it directly, but that soul has confirmed that he’s underground—to be precise, one of his clones."
"Hmm?" Shang Fengxue looked at the qi screen.
"Is Zhang Fei’s clone really in there now?"
"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded.
"I forbid you from going in there, Fengxue.
Even though it’s just his soul, Hu Tianlang is powerful.
Even your big brother is afraid of him, and he decided to go into seclusion after their meeting.
Additionally, I forbid you from speaking to your brother about the decision of several demon races to join Zhang Fei, especially the two princesses of the Celestial Demon Race.
If your big brother finds out about them, he’ll think that Mo Shentian isn’t in his domain, and he’ll raise the flag of war with them."
Shang Fengxue wasn’t stupid, and she knew the risks if her big brother found out about Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha’s presence in the Moonlit Passion Sect.
If that happened, Shang Zhanluo wouldn’t just consider attacking the Celestial Demon Race, but he would also attack the sect to capture the two princesses.
"Don’t worry, I won’t say anything to my big brother, or we will face a big war.
Zhang Fei has extensive relations with various races, and some of them are too powerful, so our demon race will be destroyed if we find trouble with him."

"I don’t know yet how far Zhang Fei’s relationship with those people goes, but the strongest person behind him is Empress Huo Yanling." Shang Fengxue wasn’t surprised to hear that name from Shang Luohu’s mouth.
"If your big brother seeks trouble with the Moonlit Passion Temple, she will send people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain to invade our domain.

Although most of them are female humans, we cannot underestimate their strength because some of them have already reached the 3-Star Celestial Venerable Realm, but she still keeps them from going out in public.
If she gets angry, she will send them to us to destroy us, just like what they did to other people a few months ago.
Even if your big brother uses our Bloodline Awakening Technique, he will never be able to defeat her, and he will die in her hands."
Shang Fengxue let out a soft sigh after her sister-in-law said that.
She had actually wanted to test Feng Yao’s abilities in combat, but she felt she wasn’t her match.
Even if she used the Bloodline Awakening Technique against her, she had no confidence in being able to match her, let alone win.
"Are you going to the Moonlit Passion Temple again?"
Shang Fengxue shook her head at her sister-in-law.
"I’ve sparred with Jian Kuang, Zhuxian Sheng, and Su Shentian before.
I admit they’re powerful, as their reputations suggest, but I still feel that Zhang Fei is far stronger than them; otherwise, they wouldn’t be willing to help him train the disciples from his sect.
Unfortunately, he just entered seclusion, and I don’t know when he’ll come out, so I’ll go to the sect again after he emerges from his seclusion."
Shang Luohu looked at her sister-in-law and observed her expression seriously.
She felt that Shang Fengxue had already started to become obsessed with Zhang Fei, even though they had only known each other for a few days.
However, she didn’t see any romance in her sister-in-law’s gaze, only an overwhelming desire to spar with him.
"Do you think he can beat your big brother?"
"Zhang Fei can’t defeat my big brother right now, especially if he uses our Bloodline Awakening Technique.
However, I’m sure he’ll be able to defeat my big brother in the future, and he’ll also defeat the other demon gods.
When he succeeds in doing so, he will stand at the pinnacle of the cultivation world, and all cultivators in this realm will respect him." Shang Fengxue rose from her seat.
"Since he’s in seclusion, I’ll train with the four guardians so I won’t lose to him."

chapters.title: Chapter 1479: Bully Zhang Fei
paragraphs: Shan Zhui appeared behind Shang Luohu. "What do you think of Fengxue’s opinion of Zhang Fei?"

"Honestly, I agree with Princess Fengxue’s opinion, Empress." Shang Luohu turned back to Shang Zhui. "Based on Zhang Fei’s battle with the four guardians, I believe he already used his true strength at that time. However, he is no ordinary person, and he should still have many cards up his sleeve to defeat the four of them; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to pull the three female gods to his side. Moreover, he had already done something to the Celestial Demon Race without everyone realizing it, and it was proven by the presence of Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha in the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"What do you think Zhang Fei has done to the Celestial Demon Race? Do you think my daughter is in his hands now?"

Shang Zhui shook his head at her. "I’m not sure what that kid has done to the Celestial Demon Race, especially since we can’t enter their domain to check. However, Princess Xueli might already be in his hands, and he wants to use her as a bargaining chip to pressure my emperor to side with him."
"Have you asked your son about my daughter’s whereabouts in their sect?"

"I asked my son about that after the two lust demon gods came to see us, but he never saw Princess Xueli there." Shang Luohu thought deeply after Shang Zhui said that, and she was sure that her daughter was in Zhang Fei’s hands now because he had her hair and dress. "Perhaps that kid hid her somewhere no one knows, including my son."
Shang Luohu agreed with him. "I think we should see Zhang Fei again, Zhui. Unfortunately, he has entered seclusion, and we don’t know when he will emerge from it, so we can only wait for now."
"If you want to see that kid again, I will ask my son to inform me once he emerges from his seclusion."

"Do it, Zhui." Shang Luohu looked off into the distance. "I’m sure my daughter isn’t in the Celestial Demon Domain right now, but she’s been in Zhang Fei’s hands for a long time, so I must meet him to find out the truth."
"Yes, Empress." Shang Zhui immediately contacted Tian Shuixiang and conveyed Shang Luohu’s wish to meet Zhang Fei. "What do you think of Princess Fengxue? Is she interested in that kid?"
"From the start, I already had a feeling that my sister-in-law would never be interested in Zhang Fei, but she was interested in his real combat abilities."
Shang Zhui nodded slightly. "In that case, I’ll go now, and my son will inform me once that kid comes out of his seclusion."
"Okay."
After they chased and attacked each other for some time, Zhang Fei decided to increase his speed again, leaving Ye Mingran behind and unable to attack him anymore.
However, Ye Mingran decided to use her demon abilities, and the area around them became pitch black and trapped Zhang Fei in darkness, making it impossible for him to see their surroundings.

"This is her domain, eh?" Zhang Fei used his light element to dispel Ye Mingran’s darkness, but his efforts were unsuccessful. "She is indeed worthy of being the Eternal Night Demon God! Her darkness is too scary, and my light element is useless in it."

Zhang Fei looked for another way by opening the system map, but the map couldn’t show Ye Mingran’s location as if she blended perfectly with her darkness. He tried to use the demon-piercing eye that he mimicked from Jiu Yaoming while in the Wailing Soul Forest some time ago, but he couldn’t find her either.
"Gah!" Zhang Fei bounced and rolled in midair after a powerful attack hit his chest. "Damn it! I couldn’t see her attack just now, and it really hurt."

"The darkness of night is the nature of my demon race, and your light elements will be useless in my Eternal Night Domain." Zhang Fei’s ears twitched as he tried to detect Ye Mingran’s movements, but he heard nothing in the darkness. "My domain not only absorbs all light, but it also absorbs all sound, so you won’t be able to pinpoint my exact location."

"Gah!" Zhang Fei was thrown back once again, and he rubbed his painful chest because Ye Mingran’s attack just now was stronger than the previous one. "How am I supposed to detect her movements if I can’t see or hear them?"

Zhang Fei suddenly had an idea, and he immediately used his plant generation ability that he mimicked from Milia long ago to create many trees in the darkness. Then, he used his tree control ability that he mimicked from Janette long ago to accelerate their growth, and he also used his plant manipulation ability that he mimicked from Lillea to control them.

Ye Mingran naturally knew that the three demon abilities belonged to the Dryad Race, but she didn’t expect that Zhang Fei could use them. "Interesting! I’ve underestimated you all this time, and I’ve never met a demon who can use the abilities of other demon races as your own."

"Haha! If I had known your Eternal Night Domain was this dark, I would have mimicked it long ago." Zhang Fei then used the forest manipulation ability that he mimicked from Cassia when he first went to the Diyu Realm, forming a dense forest in the darkness.

"Do you know that all your actions are useless?" Before Zhang Fei could say anything, all the trees and forest he had created earlier died rapidly, leaving him stunned. "My Eternal Night Domain not only covers the senses of living beings, but it can also destroy all life within it. If you don’t believe me, I will make you experience it yourself."
Zhang Fei frowned at that, but he was shocked when his skin became wrinkled quickly. "How is this possible? How can your darkness have this kind of effect?"

"Haha." Yi Mingran’s laughter echoed in the darkness. "My darkness is not an ordinary one, okay? Eternal night means eternal darkness, and my darkness can absorb all elements of life. If I absorb all the elements of life in your body, you will die, and your body will become like a dried corpse."

Zhang Fei shuddered upon hearing this, and he felt that he had greatly underestimated Ye Mingran’s abilities. Although he had faced and defeated numerous demons in the past, he had never encountered one with abilities like hers.
"As long as you can’t find my true body, you won’t be able to free yourself from my Eternal Night Domain, and I can kill you at any time if I’m your enemy."
"Gah!" Just as Zhang Fei was thinking of a way to break the effects of the Eternal Night Domain, Ye Mingran attacked him with even greater force, making his expression look pained.
Ye Mingran didn’t give Zhang Fei a chance to think, and she attacked him repeatedly to prevent him from finding a way to free himself from her Eternal Night Domain.

Even though his speed surpassed Ye Mingran’s, Zhang Fei couldn’t dodge all of her attacks while he was in her Eternal Night Domain, and all of them landed perfectly on various parts of his body, causing him to feel pain all over.

Zhang Fei decided to use his enhanced condition ability to strengthen all aspects of his body, especially since Ye Mingran’s attack was truly heavy and the impact caused him to feel a lot of pain. He had thought about using his demonic force manipulation ability, but he immediately abandoned his intention because she was a powerful demon god, and his abilities would not work on her.

"Gah!" Zhang Fei was annoyed because he was being bullied by Ye Mingran, and he decided to use his devouring ability, but it was also useless because he couldn’t touch her. He tried to use demon corruption, but her darkness dispelled it instantly. Even his demon king’s roar had no impact on her, as if she were invincible in her darkness.

"I didn’t expect you to have so many demon abilities, even though you are a lust demon, and you mimicked them from other demon races." Ye Mingran spoke as she attacked Zhang Fei faster, as she was afraid that she would lose if she gave him a chance to think, so she decided to suppress him as closely as possible. "Unfortunately, your efforts are in vain if you use them against me inside my domain, especially since my domain will immediately dispel them."

Zhang Fei couldn’t believe he couldn’t use his demon abilities to attack Ye Mingran, and he used several others, such as the Demon Claw, the Hellflame Incantation, the Abyssal Lightning Tribulation, the Nine Nether Fiends Summoning, and more. Unfortunately, her darkness swallowed all his abilities, causing them to quickly disappear.

Seeing Zhang Fei helpless and continuously being beaten by Ye Mingran, Mei finally spoke to him. [Master, she is invincible while she is inside the Eternal Night Domain, but I think you can use your lust abilities on her. After all, your lust abilities are not offensive abilities, and they will affect one’s inner body, so you can try using them to defeat her.]

Zhang Fei wanted to use his lust demon abilities on Ye Mingran, and he was confident they would have a significant impact on her. However, the purpose of his training was to improve his combat abilities, and he would never improve if he continued to rely on them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1480: Seal Zhang Fei’s Clone
paragraphs: While his real body was overwhelmed when facing Ye Mingran, Feltia [2] also felt overwhelmed when facing Nalan Shizhe. Although the female demon god didn’t use a domain or anything like that, he felt his soul strength diminishing everytime he attacked her, which was due to the devouring field surrounding her.
Feltia [2] retreated away from Nalan Shizhe when he felt his soul power decrease significantly; otherwise, he would be further weakened if she devoured more of his soul power.

Nalan Shizhe spoke to him. "Son, you won’t be able to get close to me, and my soul-devouring field will instantly devour your soul power whenever you’re within its range. If you want to fight me, you must use long-range attacks, but you can’t use just any technique to attack me."
"Did you get your devouring field after you became a demon god, mother-in-law?"

"Yes." Nalan Shizhe nodded at Feltia [2] before activating her soul-devouring domain. Her red eyes turned grey, and a giant transparent mouth appeared, enveloping her body. "You’ve seen my soul-devouring domain, right? I can combine it with the soul-devouring demonic seal, and it will seal your soul into eternal darkness. You are strong for a demon of your level, but you are not truly strong yet, and you will never be able to free your soul from my seal."
"I see." Feltia [2] looked at Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain and soul-devouring field. "Can you enlarge the area of both of them?"

"I can enlarge the area of the soul-devouring field at will, and it will cover your entire training space." Nalan Shizhe demonstrated the expansion of the area to Feltia [2], but she still restricted it to avoid impacting the women who were training there. "My soul-devouring domain is different from other domains, and it has a fixed area of this size. However, my domain is also different from the others, and it can move at will to trap my enemies. By doing this, I can utilize my soul-devouring demonic seal to trap my enemies’ souls, and no one has ever succeeded in breaking free from it."

Feltia [2] was curious about the effects of Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain and soul-devouring demonic seal, and he considered experimenting with both. His soul power had been difficult to increase for a long time, despite his routine of dual soul cultivation with all his wives, and he believed he needed something to stimulate its growth, such as emptying his soul power.

Feltia [2] thought that Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain and soul-devouring demonic seal should be able to help him with that, but he was also worried that her abilities would drain his soul power completely, and he would die without it.

"What are you thinking about?" Feltia [2] sighed softly and told Nalan Shizhe about his thoughts, causing her to frown. "It’s true that I can release you from my seal, but you should know that my seal will drain your soul power rapidly. I know your soul power is very high because your soul cultivation level is one level below mine, but I’m not sure if you will be able to handle the situation. If something untoward happens in there, you will die from exhaustion of your soul power."

"I know that." Feltia [2] clenched his right fist. "However, I feel like my soul power has reached its limit, and I need to find another way to increase it. Although my soul power can’t break through to the immortal soul level, it should be able to break through to the perfection stage of the diving soul level, and I will become much stronger if that’s true. Therefore, I want you to use your soul-devouring demonic seal to seal me, and you can release me after ten minutes to see the results."

Nalan Shizhe frowned at Feltia [2] because his wish was too risky, mainly because she herself didn’t know for sure how fast her soul-devouring domain would devour his soul power. If the absorption rate was too rapid, he would die from running out of his soul power, and her two daughters would blame her for their husband’s death.

Noticing the hesitation on Nalan Shizhe’s face, Feltia [2] decided to call Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi to meet with them, hoping that they could persuade their mother to use the soul-devouring domain and the soul-devouring demonic seal on him.
Nalan Shizhe raised an eyebrow as her two daughters appeared between them. "Did your husband ask you two to persuade me to use my abilities on him?"

"Hehe." Nalan Yushu giggled, approached her mother, and hugged her arm. "Mother, I know you care about our husband’s safety, but you don’t know him well. I can tell you that he likes to take risks to improve himself, and he always manages to return safely, so you don’t need to worry about him."

Nalan Wangzi also spoke to her. "Mother, our husband will still have to face many powerful cultivators in the future, including Mo Shentian. Therefore, he needs a lot of help to improve himself, so I think you can use your demon abilities on him. You already know that our husband is not an ordinary living being, and he has three different identities in one body, which no one else has. Moreover, you can monitor him at all times, and you can pull him out of there if you feel that he is unable to face the situation."

Nalan Shizhe knew that Feltia [2] was different from all other living creatures, but she felt that his idea was awful, and it couldn’t be done because it was too risky. She wanted to help her son-in-law, but she didn’t want to cause her two daughters to become widows if he died.

"Mother, you don’t have to think too complicatedly, okay?" Nalan Yushu pointed at Feltia [2]. "His body is his second clone, so he won’t die just because he entered your seal. If he isn’t strong enough to face the situation inside, you can get him out of there, or he just needs to cancel his clone, so I’m sure he’ll be fine."

"Yushu is right, Mother." Nalan Wangzi turned to Feltia [2]. "Our husband wouldn’t be so stupid as to go in there using his real body, and I think it wouldn’t be a problem if he used his clone to test the effects of your demon abilities."
Nalan Shizhe herself just remembered that Feltia [2] was a clone of her son-in-law, and Zhang Fei was busy receiving beatings from Ye Mingran. "Can you cancel your clone if I seal it?"

"I don’t know." Nalan Shizhe responded to Feltia [2] with a frown. "Honestly, I can cancel my clone from anywhere, but I’ve never been in a sealed situation, so I can’t be sure about that. However, you don’t need to worry about that because I still have my real body and four other clones, so I’m sure I won’t run out of soul power in there because some of my wives will help me by dual soul cultivating with my other three clones."

Nalan Shizhe still had doubts about it because she didn’t understand how Zhang Fei’s real body and his five clones worked, and she doubted if they could maintain his soul power while he was inside her seal.
"Mother."

Nalan Shizhe looked at her two daughters, who were still trying to convince her. After thinking it over carefully, she decided to comply with their request by directing her soul-devouring domain toward Feltia [2], enveloping him with it.

Feltia [2] felt his soul power being rapidly sucked away by Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain, but he was lucky because her other three clones were dual soul cultivating with their partners. Moreover, some of them did it with the support of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror; otherwise, his soul power will experience a rapid decline.

Nalan Shizhe spoke to him. "I will use the soul-devouring demonic seal on you, and you will be immediately sucked into it, just like the soul creature was back then. If you are unable to handle the situation inside, you must inform me using either your real body or another clone, and I will rescue you from that place."
"Alright." Feltia [2] answered with a joyful expression.

"Get ready." After Feltia [2] nodded, Nalan Shizhe activated her soul-devouring demonic seal, and her soul-devouring domain disappeared along with him. She looked at her two daughters and spoke to them. "Your husband took too great a risk by going in there, and something inside absorbed his soul power."

"Hehe." Nalan Yushu chuckled and pointed at Zhang Fei [1], who was fighting Qi Qingxiu in another area. "Look at him, Mother. Aren’t your worries unfounded? His other clone is in stable condition and can fight normally, so the situation inside isn’t as bad as you think, and his second clone can handle the situation inside."
Nalan Wangzi also spoke to her mother. "If you look closely, the soul power of his other clone hasn’t decreased at all, so I think he’ll be fine even if he stays inside for a long time."

"Hmm?" Nalan Shizhe looked at Zhang Fei [1] and Qi Qingxiu, who were fighting using physical strength. After all, her abilities to control seven emotions were useless to affect him, so she resorted to physical attacks to accompany him in training. "How can he maintain his soul power in there?"
Nalan Yushu pulled her mother. "Follow me! You can see for yourself my husband’s activities inside the pavilion, and you’ll be shocked when you see him."

Although the female demon god didn’t use a domain or anything like that, he felt his soul strength diminishing everytime he attacked her, which was due to the devouring field surrounding her.
Feltia [2] retreated away from Nalan Shizhe when he felt his soul power decrease significantly; otherwise, he would be further weakened if she devoured more of his soul power.
Nalan Shizhe spoke to him.
"Son, you won’t be able to get close to me, and my soul-devouring field will instantly devour your soul power whenever you’re within its range.
If you want to fight me, you must use long-range attacks, but you can’t use just any technique to attack me."
"Did you get your devouring field after you became a demon god, mother-in-law?"
"Yes." Nalan Shizhe nodded at Feltia [2] before activating her soul-devouring domain.
Her red eyes turned grey, and a giant transparent mouth appeared, enveloping her body.
"You’ve seen my soul-devouring domain, right?
I can combine it with the soul-devouring demonic seal, and it will seal your soul into eternal darkness.
You are strong for a demon of your level, but you are not truly strong yet, and you will never be able to free your soul from my seal."
"I see." Feltia [2] looked at Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain and soul-devouring field.
"Can you enlarge the area of both of them?"

"I can enlarge the area of the soul-devouring field at will, and it will cover your entire training space." Nalan Shizhe demonstrated the expansion of the area to Feltia [2], but she still restricted it to avoid impacting the women who were training there.
"My soul-devouring domain is different from other domains, and it has a fixed area of this size.
However, my domain is also different from the others, and it can move at will to trap my enemies.
By doing this, I can utilize my soul-devouring demonic seal to trap my enemies’ souls, and no one has ever succeeded in breaking free from it."
Feltia [2] was curious about the effects of Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain and soul-devouring demonic seal, and he considered experimenting with both.

His soul power had been difficult to increase for a long time, despite his routine of dual soul cultivation with all his wives, and he believed he needed something to stimulate its growth, such as emptying his soul power.

Feltia [2] thought that Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain and soul-devouring demonic seal should be able to help him with that, but he was also worried that her abilities would drain his soul power completely, and he would die without it.
"What are you thinking about?" Feltia [2] sighed softly and told Nalan Shizhe about his thoughts, causing her to frown.
"It’s true that I can release you from my seal, but you should know that my seal will drain your soul power rapidly.
I know your soul power is very high because your soul cultivation level is one level below mine, but I’m not sure if you will be able to handle the situation.
If something untoward happens in there, you will die from exhaustion of your soul power."
"I know that." Feltia [2] clenched his right fist.
"However, I feel like my soul power has reached its limit, and I need to find another way to increase it.

Although my soul power can’t break through to the immortal soul level, it should be able to break through to the perfection stage of the diving soul level, and I will become much stronger if that’s true.
Therefore, I want you to use your soul-devouring demonic seal to seal me, and you can release me after ten minutes to see the results."
Nalan Shizhe frowned at Feltia [2] because his wish was too risky, mainly because she herself didn’t know for sure how fast her soul-devouring domain would devour his soul power.
If the absorption rate was too rapid, he would die from running out of his soul power, and her two daughters would blame her for their husband’s death.

Noticing the hesitation on Nalan Shizhe’s face, Feltia [2] decided to call Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi to meet with them, hoping that they could persuade their mother to use the soul-devouring domain and the soul-devouring demonic seal on him.
Nalan Shizhe raised an eyebrow as her two daughters appeared between them.
"Did your husband ask you two to persuade me to use my abilities on him?"
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu giggled, approached her mother, and hugged her arm.
"Mother, I know you care about our husband’s safety, but you don’t know him well.
I can tell you that he likes to take risks to improve himself, and he always manages to return safely, so you don’t need to worry about him."
Nalan Wangzi also spoke to her.
"Mother, our husband will still have to face many powerful cultivators in the future, including Mo Shentian.
Therefore, he needs a lot of help to improve himself, so I think you can use your demon abilities on him.
You already know that our husband is not an ordinary living being, and he has three different identities in one body, which no one else has.
Moreover, you can monitor him at all times, and you can pull him out of there if you feel that he is unable to face the situation."
Nalan Shizhe knew that Feltia [2] was different from all other living creatures, but she felt that his idea was awful, and it couldn’t be done because it was too risky.
She wanted to help her son-in-law, but she didn’t want to cause her two daughters to become widows if he died.
"Mother, you don’t have to think too complicatedly, okay?" Nalan Yushu pointed at Feltia [2].
"His body is his second clone, so he won’t die just because he entered your seal.
If he isn’t strong enough to face the situation inside, you can get him out of there, or he just needs to cancel his clone, so I’m sure he’ll be fine."
"Yushu is right, Mother." Nalan Wangzi turned to Feltia [2].
"Our husband wouldn’t be so stupid as to go in there using his real body, and I think it wouldn’t be a problem if he used his clone to test the effects of your demon abilities."
Nalan Shizhe herself just remembered that Feltia [2] was a clone of her son-in-law, and Zhang Fei was busy receiving beatings from Ye Mingran.
"Can you cancel your clone if I seal it?"
"I don’t know." Nalan Shizhe responded to Feltia [2] with a frown.
"Honestly, I can cancel my clone from anywhere, but I’ve never been in a sealed situation, so I can’t be sure about that.

However, you don’t need to worry about that because I still have my real body and four other clones, so I’m sure I won’t run out of soul power in there because some of my wives will help me by dual soul cultivating with my other three clones."

Nalan Shizhe still had doubts about it because she didn’t understand how Zhang Fei’s real body and his five clones worked, and she doubted if they could maintain his soul power while he was inside her seal.
"Mother."
Nalan Shizhe looked at her two daughters, who were still trying to convince her.
After thinking it over carefully, she decided to comply with their request by directing her soul-devouring domain toward Feltia [2], enveloping him with it.
Feltia [2] felt his soul power being rapidly sucked away by Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain, but he was lucky because her other three clones were dual soul cultivating with their partners.
Moreover, some of them did it with the support of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror; otherwise, his soul power will experience a rapid decline.

chapters.title: Chapter 1481: Within The Seal
paragraphs: Nalan Shizhe was shocked when she saw Zhang Xiaolong [3] in the middle of a crowd of women, where he was in his half-fox form and had deliberately transformed his tails to match the total number of his wives.

Nalan Shizhe looked up at Zhang Xiaolong [3], with a giant black and white lotus revolving above them. She could see that the lotus was channeling his yang qi and soul power into the bodies and souls of all the women, and their yin qi and soul powers were flowing into his body and soul.

Nalan Shizhe finally understood the origin of Zhang Fei’s confidence in entering her soul-devouring domain and asking her to seal his soul in it, mainly because so many women helped him with their soul power to strengthen his.
Nalan Yushu smiled mischievously as she touched her mother’s forehead, imparting the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art, the Origin Soul Art, and the Lotus Ascension Art to her.
Nalan Shizhe raised an eyebrow and looked at her second daughter, who immediately explained the three soul techniques to her. "Create a soul world inside our souls?"

"Yes." Nalan Yushu nodded and pointed to all her sisters. "We’ve formed our soul seas just like you, but we haven’t succeeded in forming our soul world because it requires too much qi and time because we only dual soul cultivated with our husband. Unlike us, he has already formed his soul world because he has more than a hundred wives, and it is already fully developed with several living creatures in it, but most of them are beasts and plants."

Nalan Shizhe looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the others. "I formed my soul sea a long time ago, but I didn’t know it could evolve into a soul world. Where did my son-in-law get the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art?"

"No one knows about it, Mother." Nalan Shizhe looked at Nalan Wangzi. "All of us are his wives, but our husband still keeps many secrets to himself. He hasn’t wanted to tell us for safety’s sake, and many people would hunt us down if they knew about his secrets. He got the Origin Soul Art from his master in soul cultivation, and he got the Lotus Ascension Art from Qing Qiu’er. You can learn the first two techniques to increase your soul power, but you cannot yet learn the Lotus Ascension Art because it is a dual soul cultivation technique specifically for couples."

"I—" Nalan Shizhe was shocked when a white fox tail suddenly coiled around her waist, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] pulled her towards them before forcing her soul out of her body. Before she could protest, she could feel that his soul power and Yang Qi were flowing into her body and soul, and she felt another sensation when he helped her learn the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art and the Origin Soul Art. ’How could he do that?’

Nalan Shizhe felt uncomfortable with the situation because she was Zhang Fei’s mother-in-law, but she couldn’t possibly stop Zhang Xiaolong [3], as their souls were linked to all the women, and she feared that her actions would harm their souls.

Nalan Shizhe let out a soft sigh in her heart, and she closed her eyes while channeling her soul power and Yin Qi into Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s body and soul according to his instructions. Although she was initially reluctant to do so with him, she immediately felt the effects of his Yang Qi and soul power, especially on her soul.

Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Yushu exchanged glances and smiled at each other, and they hurriedly joined them. Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s two tails directly coiled around their waists, pulled their souls out of their bodies, and began their dual soul cultivation.

At the training ground, Qi Qingxiu decided to stop fighting Zhang Fei [1] because she couldn’t use her demon abilities against him, and she wasn’t a demon fighter like Ye Mingran or Nalan Shizhe. Even though she was a demon god like them, her abilities were related to control, and she couldn’t do anything without them.

Zhang Fei [1] could only shake his head as he watched Qi Qingxiu return to practicing using the gravity feature, and he looked into the darkness not far from his location, where his real body continued to be pummeled by Ye Mingran.

Zhang Fei [1] considered assisting his real body in fighting Ye Mingran, but he abandoned it and went back to the pavilion, where he aided his third clone in dual soul cultivation with all those women.

Meanwhile, Feltia [2] was being sealed within Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain, and he could feel his soul power being continuously drained by her domain. Fortunately, his first and third clones’ dual soul cultivated with all his women; otherwise, his soul power would have been depleted long ago.

Feltia [2] looked around, but all he could see was pitch-black darkness. He could see the souls sealed inside wandering in various directions, and he also saw the soul creature that Nalan Shizhe had sealed some time ago.

Feltia [2] smiled with joy after finding them because he purposely asked Nalan Shizhe to seal him into her soul-devouring domain for that, and he wanted to absorb all the souls sealed in it, especially the soul creature from last time.

"Hahaha!" Feltia [2] laughed after seeing them because their souls had weakened after being sealed for so long inside Nalan Shizhe’s soul-devouring domain, and he immediately transformed into his lust demon form before using his Devouring Art and Demon Absorbing Ability to absorb them, starting with the soul creature from last time because it was the strongest among all the souls. "Instead of you being trapped here until you die, I will use the power of your souls to improve mine."

"Roar!" The soul creature let out an angry roar as Feltia [2]’s tail coiled around its body and absorbed it, and it attempted to attack him, but it was no longer as powerful as their previous encounter.

"Heh!" Feltia [2] smirked, beat the soul creature, and continued to absorb its soul into his own. "You were indeed strong when we met half a year ago, but you have weakened significantly after being sealed in this place for so long, so you are no longer my opponent."
"Roar!" The soul creature tried to break free, but Feltia [2]’s other eight tails immediately bound it tightly, preventing it from escaping from him.
"Stop struggling and give me your soul!" Feltia [2] used his two demon abilities to absorb creatures’ souls faster.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was utterly frustrated because he hadn’t found a way to overcome Ye Mingran’s Eternal Night Domain, and the female demon god continued to bully him with invisible attacks. Even though he had used his enhanced condition ability, he wouldn’t be able to endure her attacks forever, and his qi would deplete if he continued in this situation.

Zhang Fei continued to find ways to destroy Ye Mingran’s Eternal Night Domain, but none of his techniques were useful because her darkness devoured them all. ’Since I can’t fight her using my normal three forms, I’ll use my fourth form to fight her.’

Ye Mingran, who was watching Zhang Fei from the darkness, was shocked when she felt another aura radiating from his body. She was shocked when he transformed into his Calamity Demon Dragon form, and his loud roar destroyed her Eternal Night Domain.
*Roar*

"What the hell? How could he destroy my domain?" Ye Mingran was shocked by that, and she flew away from Zhang Fei. "I’ve never felt this kind of aura before, and his aura is as powerful as Long Wuzhao’s. His aura is more terrifying than the golden dragon king, and he destroyed my domain with just that."
Zhang Fei opened his eyes and looked at Ye Mingran. "Are you afraid of my Calamity Demon Dragon Form?"
"Calamity Demon Dragon?" Ye Mingran looked at him with raised eyebrows. "I’ve seen and met several dragon races, but I’ve never heard of the dragon race you mentioned."

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "In this universe, there’s only one of my dragon races, so it’s natural that you’ve never heard of it. Actually, the Calamity Demon Dragon is the opposite of the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, just like Yin and Yang. My dragon race was born from Yin, and Long Wuzhao was born from Yang."

"Huh?" Ye Mingran was perplexed to hear that. "Are you saying you are the opposite of Long Wuzhao? Why has no one ever heard of your dragon race in this Paradise Realm? How can you have a fourth identity as a dragon?"

Zhang Fei returned to his human form and explained to Ye Mingran. "I found the dragon on Sky Dragon Island in the Three Mortal Realms, and that realm used to be Long Wuzhao’s home before he ascended to this Paradise Realm. Long story short, he sealed the dragon under a mountain in that realm, but I managed to find his whole body a few years ago. I killed the dragon and used a special method to transform myself into a member of his dragon race, making me the only one of that race in the universe."

Ye Mingran gasped in shock as she stared at Zhang Fei. She knew that living creatures could inherit some traits from beasts and others, but he didn’t just inherit the dragon’s traits; instead, he transformed into the real Calamity Demon Dragon. "How could you do that? Did Long Wuzhao already know about this matter?"
