chapters.title: Chapter 1482: Zhang Fei Vs Ye Mingran
paragraphs: "To protect myself and those around me, I won’t tell you about the origins of my fourth identity." Ye Mingran didn’t think much of it because she decided to join Zhang Fei to protect her demon race, and she was confident he could protect them with his previous three identities. Since she now knew about his fourth identity, she was even more confident in becoming his ally. "Long Wuzhao already knew about my fourth identity because he told me about the former Calamity Demon Dragon, but I didn’t tell him about the process of me getting my fourth identity. By the way, I hope you don’t use your Eternal Night Domain anymore because I would rather not use my fourth identity, and you can use your other abilities to spar with me."

Ye Mingran used her other ability, making Zhang Fei raise an eyebrow when dozens of her clones appeared in front of him. "Unlike your clones, my technique is not a clone technique but an avatar technique, and the number of my avatars is unlimited when I fight in the dark of the night."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei observed one of Ye Mingran’s avatars, and it was quite similar to the Taotie avatar he had encountered in the past, but he felt that the two weren’t exactly the same. "I’ve fought the avatar of one of the evil mythical beasts in the past, and I feel that your avatar is weaker than his."

"Taotie, right?" Zhang Fei nodded to Ye Mingran. "His avatar is at his full power at all times, so his avatar is stronger than mine. As for my avatar, it will reach its full power at night, and its power will be even greater in pitch darkness."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I know you are powerful, but you are stronger than I initially thought, and I can’t measure your strength because we have never fought at full strength."

"Haha." Ye Mingran laughed softly. "I haven’t fought at full strength in a long time, but I dare say with certainty that you will lose if I use my full power, even though I’m not as strong as Mo Shentian and some other demon gods."

"I know." Zhang Fei sighed inwardly because all demon gods were on a whole different level. "I could have done something against Qi Qingxiu, but that happened because she was off guard, and I wouldn’t have been able to do it if I had been on guard like you."

Ye Mingran glanced at Qi Qingxiu, who was struggling to overcome the gravity that was much higher than that in the Paradise Realm. "Qingxiu is the weakest among the ten demon gods, but her abilities to manipulate the seven emotions are so terrifying that even Qiongqi and his three friends have to think twice about fighting against her. Her main mistake is that she often underestimates cultivators who are much weaker than her, which makes her fall under the influence of your abilities."

"She should have learned her lesson, and I’m sure she won’t dare underestimate cultivators weaker than her again." Zhang Fei wanted to use his avatar technique, but he dropped the idea because his avatar was not for fighting but cultivating. "I think that’s enough talk, and we should continue our spar because I have to prepare myself to face the other demon gods, the first of which is Shang Zhanluo."
"Be careful." Ye Mingran canceled most of her avatars, leaving only one behind, which immediately moved to attack Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei tried to block Ye Mingran’s avatar’s attack, but it disappeared before reappearing behind him and punching him in the back, causing him to fly forward.

"Gah!" Zhang Fei quickly stabilized himself, but Ye Mingran had already appeared in front of him with her right leg raised. She struck his shoulder hard, sending him sliding towards the floor quickly. "Shit!"

paragraphs: [Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]
Another day passed quickly. Zhang Fei [5] and three women stood high in the sky to inspect the Twin Flames Main Domain. "What do you think? Are you satisfied with the results?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Liao Hanxue. "I’m satisfied with everything, but my sect still lacks one formation—the time formation array. If you can help me create one, then everything will be perfect. The people in my sect will be able to cultivate faster than other cultivators, and they will become stronger than ordinary cultivators."

"Like I said before, the materials to create the formation array are difficult to obtain. However, I have asked my people to collect those materials, but they won’t be able to gather them anytime soon." Liao Hanxue tilted her head towards him. "Now, all your sect’s preparations have been completed, but there is still one thing missing."

"Disciples." Liao Hanxue nodded to Qing Qiu’er. "There are many races in our sect now, but our new disciples are still too few. I think I will send all the elders to the various domains, and we will start recruiting new disciples again. What do you think about that?"
"Quality is always better than quantity, Qiu’er."

Zhang Fei [5] himself still needed around eight hundred disciples to complete the system’s quest, but he didn’t want to rush to recruit disciples who weren’t serious about their cultivation path because that would just waste his resources. He wanted to recruit those who were serious about their cultivation path, and he would help them as best as he could with items from the system.

"You can order some elders to start recruiting more disciples in other domains, but we will increase our disciple acceptance criteria." The three women turned to Zhang Fei [5] in surprise. "Our sect is no longer the same as it was in the past, and we have changed a lot in the past year and three months. We have the support of many senior cultivators and clans now, so we can’t just accept disciples. I want our sect to be as strong as the Divine Samsara Sect, and I want this domain to be on par with the Sky Pillar Domain, so no other cultivators will look down on us anymore."

Qing Qiu’er also had the same dream as Zhang Fei [5], and she always harbored the hope that the Moonlit Passion Temple would become one of the respected sects in the Paradise Realm, like the Divine Samsara Sect. However, she couldn’t do it all by herself because she was a dual cultivator, and she didn’t have too many resources.

Everything has changed since Qing Qiu’er met Zhang Fei [5] a year and three months ago in the Divine Samsara Sect, and they have worked hard to change the Moonlit Passion Temple for the better. He helped her establish relationships with many well-known clans, such as the Liao, You, Zhang, Qiao, and several other clans. In addition, he also brought the Winged Race, the Fairy Race, the Beast Race, the Demihuman Race, and several demon races into their sect, further strengthening it.

"I think I’ll persuade my family to move our Liao Clan to this domain." They looked at Liao Hanxue. "In the past two and a half months, we’ve been busy assisting your sect with various matters, and we rarely return to our clan, so all clan matters are handled by our other members. Moreover, this domain is now on par with the Sky Pillar Domain in terms of protection, so I think it’s no problem if we move our clan here. However, we don’t have a place here yet, so we have to build everything from scratch, and we will move here once everything is ready."
"Are you sure about that?"

"Yes." Liao Hanxue nodded to Qing Qiu’er. "I’ve been thinking about it for the past week, and I think it’s the best choice. However, I can’t decide everything on my own, and I need to discuss it with my family first. If they agree, I’ll inform you of their decision, and you can order the members of the Giant Race to help us build our residence."
"What about your clan’s shops in the Sky Pillar Domain?"

"Haha." Liao Hanxue laughed softly. "Why should I bother with those shops? Even if we move our clan to this domain, people won’t dare do anything to our shops there, and my clan members will take care of them as usual. Additionally, I’ll try talking to the Qiao and You Clans, but I have to start with my clan members first, and I’m sure the people of both clans will agree if my family agrees to move our Liao Clan here."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "In that case, you can discuss it with your clansmen. I’ll ask Jiu Tan and the others to establish the new Liao Clan in this domain if they agree. As for the other two clans, I’m not sure if the You Clan will agree with you, but the Qiao Clan might agree to move into this domain. If that’s true, I’ll order the natural races to prepare everything, and you can move here once everything is ready."
"What about the Zhang Clan? Are you going to talk to them about this matter?"
"I’ll try talking to Zhang Zetian first, but I’m not sure if he’ll agree."
"I think that’s good, and I hope you can persuade Zhang Zetian."
After they finished talking, Zhang Fei [5] sent Duanmu Luolan to the training space to join the others, and he himself went to the Starfall Martial Domain to meet Zhang Zetian.
After they returned to the sect, Qing Qiu’er returned to the mountain peak, and Liao Hanxue went to talk with her family members, discussing her previous plans.
"What brings you to me in the middle of the night like this, young man?"

Zhang Fei [5] sat down in front of Zhang Zetian and offered to move the Zhang Clan to the Twin Flames Main Domain. He created a qi screen, showed the old man the changes in the domain, and explained them to him.

Zhang Zetian rubbed his long white beard as he paid attention to all the changes in the Twin Flames Main Domain, but he wasn’t surprised by them because the Liao Clan was one of the best clans in formation arrays and other things, and Liao Hanxue had helped Zhang Fei [5] create all those formations.

After he watched and considered everything, Zhang Zetian directly spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Unfortunately, I cannot move my clan to your domain, young man. However, I have no problem opening a branch clan there, and my son and his family will directly take care of it. What do you think about that?"

"I think that’s fine, senior." Zhang Fei [5] immediately made up his mind because he couldn’t possibly force Zhang Zetian to move his clan. "If that’s what you really want, I’ll prepare a residence for your branch clan, and I’ll inform you of the results soon. Once everything is ready, your son and his family can move directly into our domain."

Zhang Zetian immediately stood up from his seat as he lifted Zhang Fei [5] to his feet. "I will speak to my son and his family now so they can prepare for their move, and they will move to your domain once everything is ready."
"Thank you, senior."
After Zhang Fei [5] left, Zhang Zetian immediately left his room and went to see his son, where he discussed the matter.

Zhang Fei [5] had already returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple, but a gate suddenly opened, and Huli Zhishen walked out, followed by a group of people from the snow fox race. However, the people from that race immediately fell as soon as they exited the gate because the gravity in the Ten Mortal Realms was much lighter than in the Paradise Realm, and they had never trained in his Training Space.

Zhang Fei [5] had no intention of bringing members of the snow fox race into his training space because he had no prior connection with them. He brought them to the Paradise Realm because he wanted to increase the number of races in the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Zhang Fei [5] summoned several members of the beast races, such as Feng Xishui, and several others, to assist the members of the snow fox race in going to the beast race area. He asked them to help the people adapt to the gravity in the Paradise Realm so they could move around normally as soon as possible.

Zhang Fei [5] sent Huli Zhishen into the training space to join the others, and he immediately contacted several women who were in other domains, such as Zhong Yan, Huang Rong, and others. He asked them about the people who would manage their shops in those domains, but he got an unexpected answer because Feng Yao sent women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain to handle those shops.
’You don’t need to worry about those shops, and my people are more than enough to take care of them. Thus, you can pick them up, and they can enter seclusion with your real body.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1491: A Few Clans Join In
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] went to the Radiant Starfall Domain to pick up Zhong Yan, but he only found Huo Lanyin there. She told him that Feng Yao asked her to take care of his shop in the domain, or Leng Jianmo would bring trouble to the employees there. "You should often send one of your clones here to compete in alchemy with me."
"Alright."

After he sent Zhong Yan to the training space, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Azure Cloud Domain to pick up Huang Rong and Yang Lu’er. He found Huo Yu’er at her shop in the domain because Feng Yao instructed her to manage it with Xiao Jingyi.

Xiao Jingyi was disappointed that Zhang Fei [5] took Huang Rong and Yang Lu’er away, as they had become quite close in the past month. But she could understand his decision, as their cultivation was still at the Celestial Lord Realm, and they still needed to improve.
"Leave this shop to us; we will protect it while you are in seclusion." Huo Yu’er said.
Zhang Fei [5] sent Huang Rong and Yang Lu’er into the training space, and he went to the next domain—the Twilight Domain.

In the Twilight Domain, Zhang Fei [5] met Huo Hao’er, whom Feng Yao had asked to take care of the shop. "You don’t need to rush out of seclusion, and you can send someone to replenish your stock of pills in this shop."
After he spoke with Huo Hao’er, Zhang Fei [5] sent Fang Chen and Zhou Ling into the training space, and he went to the last domain to pick up his other three wives.

When he arrived at his shop in the Lotus Expanse Domain, Zhang Fei [5] met Huo Xiaoyu there. She told him that Feng Yao had ordered her to take care of his shop while he and his wives were in seclusion, and Huo Fengyin was responsible for protecting the shop in the Heavenly Mistveil Domain. "Leave this shop to me! I will definitely protect and take care of it well, and you only need to replenish the stock of items every few days."
Hong Yao informed Zhang Fei [5] that they had purchased a residence in the domain, so he took the three women to inspect it, which was located near a lake and forest.

Hong Yao deliberately bought the residence because it had beautiful views on both sides, but the price was costly. The residence was in a quiet location, and there were not too many people around, so they will have peace when they live there.
They didn’t spend too long there, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple after he sent Qiu Mei, Ren Xia, and Hong Yao into the training space.

On the mountain peak, Qing Qiu’er was chatting with Liao Hanxue and the two women from the You and Qiao Clans. "Zhang Fei [5], my grandparents have already agreed with my previous idea. However, we will not move our main clan to this domain, and some of our members will stay in this sect with the others."
"Does that mean you will stay here with Senior Zhuxian?"

"Haha." Liao Hanxue laughed and nodded at him. "Sheng and I will stay in this sect, so you don’t need to build a residence for my clan. Moreover, I’ve already discussed this matter with Qing Qiu’er, and we will join this sect as guest elders."
Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Qing Qiu’er, who nodded at him. "In that case, welcome to this sect, and I’m sure it will get bigger with your help."
"Yeah."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to the representatives of the You and Qiao Clans, Tan Yunxi and Wu Xinlan. "What about your two clans?"

"My husband and I have decided to bring our Qiao and Wu Clans to this domain, Zhang Fei. Additionally, the Tang Clan will also join us since they are our in-laws, but we will only move to this domain once our new residence is ready." Wu Xinlan was the first to answer.
Tan Yunxi also spoke to him. "Zhang Fei, we will join you and this sect, but we hope you can help my husband and our descendants remove the hereditary curse from their souls."

"Phew." Zhang Fei [5] sighed softly. "Senior Tan, I have examined the hereditary curse within their souls, but I found that the curse is too powerful for me at this moment. I won’t be able to remove the curse from their souls for now, but I’m confident I can remove it in the future. I hope they can be patient, and I will remove it from their souls when my strength is enough to do so."

Tan Yunxi nodded in understanding. "In that case, we will cooperate with your people to build our new residence, but we will choose a location far away from other cities or the sects so that our activities in forging weapons will not disturb their peace."

chapters.title: Chapter 1492: Tian Qiye’s Visit
paragraphs: "Are we going into seclusion now?"

"Are you impatient to dual cultivate with me?" Qing Qiu’er lightly punched Zhang Fei [5]’s chest, making him smile at her behavior. "I’ll bring the four of you into seclusion soon, but I’m still waiting for a guest."
"Who?"
"Tian Qiye."
Qing Qiu’er furrowed her brows. "Won’t she bring us trouble?"

"Twelve days ago, Tian Yaoqin told me that Tian Qiye asked her to accompany her to our sect, but I don’t know when they’ll be here because her injuries from the Ghost Emperor haven’t fully recovered." Qing Qiu’er recalled the incident, but it had occurred three weeks ago. She found it hard to believe that the woman had not recovered from her injuries because they were only minor. "They might come soon, so I have to move the demons in our sect to another place before they come here."

Qing Qiu’er agreed with that because Tian Qiye hated demon races, and they would experience big trouble if that woman came to their sect and found many demons, especially the presence of Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha, who were the princesses of the Celestial Demon Race.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow and listened to the incoming voice transmission. "Yaoqin just contacted me and told me that Tian Qiye asked her to meet her, and they will likely come to our sect soon, so I will move the demons into my Yin-Yang Space now."

Qing Qiu’er released him from her embrace. "You have to move quickly, or it’ll be too late, and we’ll be in trouble with the Winged Race if Tian Qiye detects their presence in our sect. Oh! Don’t forget about Tian Zhiling; she joined our sect without her permission, and she’ll punish her for that."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] flew down from the mountain peak to gather the demons, who were in the sect.
On the other hand, Qing Qiu’er met with the elders of the sect to discuss several matters with them, especially regarding Tian Qiye’s arrival and her plan to enter seclusion.

Tian Zhiling and all the demons had gathered in front of Zhang Fei [5], who immediately explained to them the plan for Tian Qiye and Tian Yaoqin’s arrival at the Moonlit Passion Sect, causing them to panic.
Qian Ying, Ju Yingzhi, Xin Yanluo, and the female demons who had been following Zhang Fei [5] for a long time didn’t panic because they were sure he had a solution.

Ju Yingzhi immediately gave Zhang Fei [5] an idea, especially since he seemed hesitant to bring them into his private spaces. "What if I take them to hide in my dimensional rift? I’m sure that woman won’t be able to find us, and they won’t have to look into your private spaces either."
Mo Anqi and the demons from the Paradise Realm wondered about that. Tian Zhiling looked at Zhang Fei [5] while wondering in her heart. ’Does he really have private spaces?’
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Ju Yingzhi. "Is it okay if you take them into your dimensional rift?"

"Yes." Ju Yingzhi nodded. "There’s nothing secret or important there, and I’m just using it to hide from the crowd, so I have no problem taking them there. That woman definitely won’t stay in this sect for long, and I’ll take them out after she leaves."

"I think Tian Qiye just wants to see the changes in this sect, so she won’t spend too much time here." Zhang Fei [5] looked at the female demons. "In that case, you can take them into your dimensional rift, and you can bring them back here tomorrow."

Ju Yingzhi immediately opened a portal to her dimensional rift, and Xin Yanluo led the female demons into it. Tian Zhiling seemed hesitant about it because she wasn’t a demon like them, but she ultimately followed them because her presence in the Moonlit Passion Sect would only bring trouble to Zhang Fei [5] and the others.

"Before I take them out tomorrow, I will send Xin Yanluo to you to check whether that woman has left or not, and I will bring them back if she has." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Ju Yingzhi, who immediately disappeared into the dimensional rift.

Zhang Fei [5] breathed a sigh of relief after they left, and he immediately summoned two ancient beasts to meet him. "Old Kui and Old Snake, Tian Qiye will be coming to our sect today, so I will send you two to my beast space; otherwise, she will attack you guys because you belong to the evil beast race."
Serpentera and Tian Kui naturally understood the situation, and they agreed with Zhang Fei [5], who immediately sent them into the beast space.

A crimson flame immediately burst out from Zhang Fei [5]’s body and transformed into Feng Yao. "You have to be careful of that woman because she should be able to sense your demon aura, even if you use your human form."
"Does Tian Qiye really have that kind of ability?" Zhang Fei [5] asked with a raised eyebrow.

Feng Yao nodded slightly. "Tian Qiye’s rank has reached the True Divine Rank, so she’s on par with all demon gods. However, the winged race is a bit more unique, and members of that race will gain the ability to detect demons after reaching that rank. Even if you use another form and suppress your demon aura as deeply and thoroughly as possible, she should still be able to detect it. Although you have some advantages over other demons, you still have to be wary of her."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] naturally didn’t dare to take Feng Yao’s warning lightly because she was much more experienced than him, especially with her identity as the reincarnation of a primordial being. "That woman is indeed strong, but I’m not too afraid of her. If she can truly detect my demon aura, I can hide in my training space, where she will never be able to find me. If that happens, I won’t be able to protect this sect, so I hope you will protect it in my stead."

Feng Yao smiled and pointed to his chest with her index finger. "The sect is fully prepared now, so you can leave sect matters to the elders, and you can focus on your cultivation again. You can send Qing Qiu’er out to check the situation from time to time, and she can discuss with you whatever the disciple needs. You can go out to take care of it if there are any changes or adjustments needed, but you have to return to seclusion again after you have finished taking care of everything. As for the protection, you don’t need to worry about that because I’m sure Tian Qiye already knows that this sect is under my protection, and she wouldn’t dare attack this sect because of it."

"Alright, I’ll leave the protection of this sect to you if I really have to hide from Tian Qiye." Feng Yao simply smiled and disappeared into Zhang Fei [5]’s body again. "Phew! Hopefully that woman won’t bring us any trouble."
After everything was settled, Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to the mountain peak and dual soul cultivated with his four wives while waiting for Tian Qiye to come.
After three weeks of recuperation, Tian Qiye’s injuries finally fully recovered.

In the morning, Tian Qiye summoned the grand elders on her side to meet her. The five grand elders quickly arrived before her, and she gave them several orders. After conveying everything, she got out of bed and spoke to Tian Yaoqin. "We will go to the Moonlit Passion Temple now."
"Alright." Tian Yaoqin nodded.
Tian Liefeng immediately asked, "How about I go with you two, Leader?"
"No need." Tian Qiye declined and walked out, followed by Tian Yaoqin. "That sect is only a small one and a former dual cultivation sect, so I can handle them myself."
Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu sneered inwardly because they were now Zhang Fei’s subordinates, but they said nothing and left the premises, followed by Tian Liefeng, who grumbled to himself.
A few minutes later, the two women from the winged race arrived at the Twin Flames Main Domain, but they were shocked by the numerous formations covering it, including illusion formations.

Tian Qiye tried to spread her senses, but several formations blocked her. "Has this domain been like this for a long time? Moreover, some of these formations are strong enough to hinder my senses, and only a few cultivators are able to create such powerful formations."
"No." Tian Yaoqin replied with a shake of her head. "When we came here three weeks ago, there weren’t any formations in this domain, so they must have installed them recently."
"Do you think Zhang Fei created these formations? He is a rank 10 array master, right?"

Tian Yaoqin nodded at her. "Zhang Fei is indeed a rank 10 array master, but I’m sure he didn’t create these formations himself; I saw the Liao Clan of the Sky Pillar Domain in that sect back then, which makes me believe that they helped him create all these formations."
"I see." Tian Qiye looked at the floating plateau. "Contact Zhang Fei to pick us up. There’s a formation restricting flight ahead of us, so we won’t be able to go to that sect ourselves."
"Alright."
Soon, Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er appeared in front of them, but Tian Qiye’s expression changed upon seeing him. "I smell a demon scent from your body.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1493: Zhang Fei - Tian Qiye
paragraphs: Tian Yaoqin’s heart tightened, and she looked at Zhang Fei [5], waiting for his next move. ’I hope you have a way to avoid fighting her, as you are currently no match for her.’

Qing Qiu’er tensed in response to Tian Qiye’s words, just like Tian Yaoqin. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] remained calm, even though she could smell the demon scent from his body. "What else do you feel from my body?"
"A demon aura." Tian Qiye stretched her hand forward and pressed her index finger against Zhang Fei [5]’s forehead. "Only demons have both, so I’m sure that you are a demon."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] was about to grab Tian Qiye’s finger, but she hurriedly pulled hers back. He took out a device and threw it up, which functioned for recording. "Even though I have a demon scent and a demon aura in my body, that doesn’t mean I am a demon. If you don’t believe my words, you can use your techniques or whatever you have to prove that I am a demon. However, I will record all of our activities, and I will spread the recording to all domains if you can’t prove your accusation to me. This way, all the cultivators in this realm will know that the Winged Race can only accuse others without evidence, and you should know the risks."

Tian Qiye raised an eyebrow as she looked at the device that was already floating above them. She had never seen such a device in the Paradise Realm. Even the cultivators of the Sky Pillar Domain, the most advanced domain, did not have it.

Tian Yaoqin also looked at the device before turning her gaze to Zhang Fei [5], who remained calm when facing Tian Qiye. Even Qing Qiu’er also looked relaxed, and she did not show the slightest worry. ’Can he really handle my leader?’
"So, what about your decision?" Zhang Fei [5] calmly asked.
Zhang Fei [5] wasn’t afraid of Tian Qiye because Mei had already told him that she wouldn’t be able to prove his identity as a demon, even if she could detect his demon aura and demon scent.

Tian Qiye was certain that Zhang Fei [5] was a demon, but she had to think twice about doing such a thing under the recording. If her accusations were proven false, and he spread the recording throughout the domain, her Winged Race would face immense pressure from various races.
Zhang Fei [5] faintly smiled as he asked her again. "Why are you just keeping quiet? Aren’t you sure that I’m a demon? Why don’t you dare to prove it on the record?"

Tian Qiye didn’t answer Zhang Fei [5] and activated her light domain to force him back into his demon form, but unfortunately, she was unaware that the light element had no effect on him because he also had that element.

"Oh? You want to use the light domain to force me to transform into a demon, huh?" Tian Qiye was shocked because Zhang Fei [5] didn’t feel anything. "To be honest, I’m too lazy to bother with such unimportant matters, but since you insist on accusing me of being a demon, I will prove to you and everyone who will watch this recording that I am not a demon as you accuse me of."

Tian Qiye was stunned in shock after Zhang Fei [5] activated his light domain, and a powerful light element appeared above his palm. Her expression made Qing Qiu’er and Tian Yaoqin laugh in their hearts.

’Impossible! How could he use a light element and a light domain with demon aura and demon scent on his body?’ Tian Qiye screamed in her heart as she looked at the light element in Zhang Fei [5]’s hand. ’Moreover, his light element is as strong as mine, and he also strengthened it with his light element law.’

’Phew! Luckily, this woman wasn’t hot-headed, and she didn’t attack me straight away.’ Zhang Fei [5] felt a sense of relief before retracting both of them. "Do you still insist that I’m a demon after seeing what I just did? Have you ever seen a demon who can use the light element and the light domain before?"
"Then, how—"

Zhang Fei [5] waved his hand to stop Tian Qiye. "I don’t care about your hatred for the demon race, but I’m different from you, and I’ve always viewed all races as equal. You may think demons are the most evil creatures, but to me, the Winged Race is far more evil than them."
"Hmm?" Tian Qiye frowned at his words.

"Didn’t your grand elders tell you about the Winged Race in my home realm?" Tian Qiye glanced at Tian Yaoqin before returning her gaze to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately created several qi screens and displayed his old battle with the people from the Tian Realm. "In my home realm, the demon race never attacked us, but the Winged Race attacked us. Fortunately, I was stronger than them, and I managed to stop them; otherwise, they would have succeeded in taking over my world and enslaving us humans."
Zhang Fei [5] removed those qi screens, pulled back his recording device, and hugged Qing Qiu’er’s waist.

"Since you accused me of being a demon without any evidence, we will not accept your presence in our sect. Thus, you can leave this domain because Qiu’er and I still have important matters to attend to." After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] used his teleportation ability to bring Qing Qiu’er back to the sect, and he also sent a voice transmission to Tian Yaoqin.

A blush appeared on Tian Yaoqin’s cheeks after listening to his message, but she quickly calmed herself down because she was afraid that Tian Qiye would notice. "Leader, shall we return to our domain now?"

Tian Qiye did not give Tian Yaoqin an answer, and her eyes focused on staring at the floating plateau in the distance, thinking about Zhang Fei [5]’s true identity. She was sure that he was a demon, but it was difficult for her to prove it because he also had the light element, and she had never met a demon who had that element.

Tian Yaoqin heaved a sigh of relief in her heart because Zhang Fei [5] had three identities—at least that was what he had shown her when they were together for the first time. ’Even though he has shown his light element and light domain, I’m sure that my leader won’t just believe it, and she will definitely find another way to prove that he is a demon.’

"Let’s go back." Tian Qiye flew towards the portal out of the Twin Flames Main Domain, but her eyes repeatedly glanced towards the floating island, with Tian Yaoqin following behind her. ’I have to think of another way to prove his identity as a demon.’

Zhang Fei [5] and Qing Qiu’er stood in the corner of the floating island, looking toward the portal out of the Twin Flames Main Domain. "Previously, I was really worried that Tian Qiye would immediately attack you after she detected your demon scent and demon aura."

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "I was also worried about that before, but fortunately, she isn’t a hot-headed woman, and she still knows how to hold herself back. However, she still suspects that I am a demon, even though I have shown my light element and light domain."
"Do you think that woman will take extreme measures to prove that you are a demon?"

"She might do so in the future, but we don’t need to worry about her. For now, we will enter seclusion, and we won’t be out for a long time." Zhang Fei [5] let out a loud sigh as he summoned both ancient beasts out of his beast space. "Old Kui and Old Snake, I will take all my wives into seclusion again, and this sect is safe because Tian Qiye cannot pass through those formations. Moreover, Feng Yao will protect this sect while I’m away, so you guys don’t need to worry about that woman."
"That’s good!" Tian Kui sighed with relief.
Serpentera directly asked Zhang Fei [5]. "How long will you be in seclusion, Master?"

"I can’t be sure yet, but I’ll probably bring them out after most of my wives break through to the Celestial King Realm, or after my cultivation breaks through to the Celestial Emperor Realm." Zhang Fei [5] turned to the two of them. "One of my clones is still in the Slaughter Blood Domain, so you can contact me anytime, and I’ll return immediately if there’s any danger."
Tian Kui and Serpentera nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei [5]. "The two of us will protect this sect, and we will contact your clone to report to you if there is any danger."

"Yes." After the two ancient beasts left, Zhang Fei [5] spoke to Qing Qiu’er. "You can talk to the elders first and give them some directions, and I’ll go to the Ice Phoenix Domain to check on the three of them."
"Alright."

After Qing Qiu’er left, Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened a portal to the Divine Origin Main Domain. He didn’t enter immediately, but he opened a portal to the training room and brought Jia Yuyan out. "What happened?"
"I got a message from the Ancient Treant Spirit, and he asked me to take you to him."
Zhang Fei [5] took her hand. "Let’s meet him first, and we’ll go to the Phoenix Domain afterward."

chapters.title: Chapter 1494: The Ancient Treant Spirit
paragraphs: Feng Yao stood on the balcony in her palace, but a white-haired man appeared beside her. "Why did you suddenly come here, Hu Tianlang’s wrath soul?"

"Zhang Fei is about to finish absorbing my bloodlust soul." Feng Yao tilted her head to Hu Tianlang. "Once he finishes absorbing it, his task in the Paradise Realm will be complete, but he’s not ready to leave for the Ancient Realm yet."

Feng Yao agreed with him. "I won’t let Zhang Fei go to the Ancient Realm with his current cultivation, and he must break through to the Celestial God Realm first to go there. Otherwise, he will encounter the avatars of the two primordial beasts, and he will die at their hands. If that happens, our efforts will fail miserably, and we will never be able to break free from the shackles of this universe."

"I’ve been dead for a long time, so whether or not he succeeds in breaking the shackles no longer concerns me. On the contrary, your grand plan will fail miserably if he dies, and you will be forever bound to this universe."

"My calculations are never wrong, and Zhang Fei will succeed in helping me free myself from the shackles of this universe." Hu Tianlang stared at Feng Yao without saying anything. "Once I’m free from those shackles, I will leave this universe forever, and he will take my place to protect it and all its inhabitants."
"Are you sure there are other universes besides ours?"

"I’m not sure about that." Feng Yao looked far away. "For now, this matter is just my guess, and I can only prove it after I free myself from those shackles. If other universes really exist, I will go to explore them one by one. If my guess is wrong, I will disappear from this universe for good. However, I don’t have to worry about it, mainly because Zhang Fei will protect it for me."
"You have that much confidence in Zhang Fei, huh?"
"Aren’t we both the same? Otherwise, you wouldn’t sacrifice yourself for something with no clear outcome, right?"
Hu Tianlang did not comment on that. "Zhang Fei will meet the Ancient Treant Spirit, Shu Yuangu, soon."
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded her head slightly. "Shu Yuangu has waited long enough, so it’s time for them to meet, and he will pave the way for him to go to that place."
"Do you think Zhang Fei can get out after he enters that place?"

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed and looked at him again. "Didn’t you go in there and come out again in the past? If you can do it, your sole heir should be able to do it too, right? Moreover, Zhang Fei is much better than you because he’s a lust demon and a Calamity Demon Dragon; he shouldn’t have any trouble getting in and out of that place, but—"
"But that woman won’t stay quiet, and she might try to lock Zhang Fei up in her place."
Feng Yao nodded slightly. "That woman hates you so much because she couldn’t stop you from going in and out of her place in the past, and she might vent her hatred for you onto Zhang Fei."

"Haha." Hu Tianlang laughed while rubbing his white hair. "That woman tried to keep me in that place in the past, but no man in his right mind would be willing to accompany such an ugly woman. Therefore, I ran away from there, and she couldn’t chase me because she couldn’t leave that place. By the way, those two heavenly foxes will soon break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm, so I’ll return to the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain to monitor them. Once those two and Zhang Fei reach the Celestial God Realm, I’ll let the three of them meet for their final battle."

"Alright." After Hu Tianlang left, two twin women appeared behind Feng Yao. "Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi, I want you two to go to the Twin Flames Main Domain, and you guys must protect the Moonlit Passion Temple while Zhang Fei is in seclusion, but there is no need for you to appear before him."
"Yes, Empress."

After the two women disappeared, Huo Ling came out of Feng Yao’s body and sat on her shoulder. "Are you really going to let Zhang Fei enter the Lotus Limbo World in the future, Master? What if that woman locks him in there and he can’t get out again?"

"You’re underestimating Zhang Fei’s abilities when it comes to women, you know?" Huo Ling snorted softly in response to Feng Yao’s comment. "That woman is indeed strong, and Hu Tianlang fears her. She is destined to be one of the women who helps him in the future, so I’m sure she won’t be able to lock him up there, and he can do something to get out of that place. Perhaps, spending a lot of time in that place will be useful for him, and he will become stronger when he leaves. Furthermore, the two primordial beasts cannot enter that place, so he will be safe as long as he stays there."

Huo Ling still couldn’t understand Feng Yao’s confidence in Zhang Fei. "Xu Ling’er is the reincarnation of Tian Huangjin, and she is already by his side. Since Luo Yunxiao inherited Hu Tianlang’s special physique, it is clear that she is the human race’s representative. Tianshi Shengjie and Jia Yuyan are already by his side, and the woman in the Lotus Limbo World will appear soon, but it won’t be easy for him to conquer her. The woman from the demihuman race is the only one missing, but we don’t know her location."
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at her. "I don’t know her current identity or location, but she should show up soon."
"Master, what do you think about other special physique possessors?"

Feng Yao thought for a moment before shaking her head. "For now, I don’t know the whereabouts of the possessors of the Immortal Sacred Physique, the Yin-Yang Devouring Physique, the Universe Tree Physique, the Heavenly Calamity Physique, and the Void Emperor Physique. They should have heard of Zhang Fei’s name, and we just need to wait for them to appear."
After that, Feng Yao walked away from the balcony to take care of other matters, and Huo Ling entered her body again.

Zhang Fei [5] and Jia Yuyan had already arrived at the Floral Mirage Domain, and the female fairy immediately led her husband to the deepest area of the domain. However, they did not go there alone; four other people accompanied them.
Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu accompanied them as they were elders of the Fairy Race, and Zhang Fei [5] also summoned Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang from his soul world.
Soon, they arrived at the deepest part of the Floral Mirage Domain, where a spirit tree stood in the center of the area, with many small creatures flying around it.
The Ancient Treant Spirit was almost similar to the Blood Tree, but it didn’t have the bloody aura like the one in the Blood Forest. "Yuyan, you finally brought the heir of the ten-tailed fox to me."

"Grandpa Shu Yuangu, I wanted to bring my husband to see you from the start, but you told me that I had to wait for your call. After you summoned me, I immediately brought him here so you can talk to him." Jia Yuyan pushed Zhang Fei [5] forward. "His name is Zhang Fei, Grandpa."
Zhang Fei [5] cupped his hand to Shu Yuangu. "Greetings, Senior. If I may ask, why did you ask Yuyan to bring me here?"

"I’ll show you a place, but you can’t go in there now, and you have to evolve into a ten-tailed fox first to be able to enter it." Zhang Fei [5] and the others looked confused, but a hole appeared beneath the Ancient Treant Spirit. However, it only lasted a moment, and Shu Yuangu closed it again. "Can you guess where it is?"
"The Lotus Limbo World."

"Yes." Su Yuangu nodded slightly. "I’ve heard from the Giant Yin-Yang Tree about you, and it asked me to show you the entrance portal to the Lotus Limbo World. Unfortunately, you’re still far from evolving into a ten-tailed fox, so you’ll have to wait a while longer to enter that place. If you force your way in with your current strength, that woman will capture you and imprison you there, and you’ll never be able to get out for the rest of your life."

Naturally, Zhang Fei [5] was aware of his own strength, and Feng Yao had already explained to him a lot about the Lotus Limbo World and the woman who lived within. Moreover, he didn’t know the exact situation inside that place, so he wouldn’t be so crazy as to enter that place with his current strength. "Senior, you already know that my strength isn’t enough to enter that place, so what’s your purpose in showing me the portal now?"

"I don’t know the real reason, but the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus asked me to show you the portal to enter." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow. "If you want a clear answer, you should go to the Ashen Lotus Monastery, and you can ask the two spirits directly."
"What kind of place is the Lotus Limbo World, Zhang Fei?" Beiming Youhuang asked him.
Jia Shengyun, Jia Lingzhu, and Jia Xianzu were also curious about the Lotus Limbo World, especially since they had never heard of such a place before.

Tianshi Shengjie and Jia Yuyan are already by his side, and the woman in the Lotus Limbo World will appear soon, but it won’t be easy for him to conquer her.
The woman from the demihuman race is the only one missing, but we don’t know her location."
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at her.
"I don’t know her current identity or location, but she should show up soon."
"Master, what do you think about other special physique possessors?"
Feng Yao thought for a moment before shaking her head.

"For now, I don’t know the whereabouts of the possessors of the Immortal Sacred Physique, the Yin-Yang Devouring Physique, the Universe Tree Physique, the Heavenly Calamity Physique, and the Void Emperor Physique.
They should have heard of Zhang Fei’s name, and we just need to wait for them to appear."
After that, Feng Yao walked away from the balcony to take care of other matters, and Huo Ling entered her body again.
Zhang Fei [5] and Jia Yuyan had already arrived at the Floral Mirage Domain, and the female fairy immediately led her husband to the deepest area of the domain.
However, they did not go there alone; four other people accompanied them.
Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu accompanied them as they were elders of the Fairy Race, and Zhang Fei [5] also summoned Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang from his soul world.
Soon, they arrived at the deepest part of the Floral Mirage Domain, where a spirit tree stood in the center of the area, with many small creatures flying around it.
The Ancient Treant Spirit was almost similar to the Blood Tree, but it didn’t have the bloody aura like the one in the Blood Forest.
"Yuyan, you finally brought the heir of the ten-tailed fox to me."
"Grandpa Shu Yuangu, I wanted to bring my husband to see you from the start, but you told me that I had to wait for your call.
After you summoned me, I immediately brought him here so you can talk to him." Jia Yuyan pushed Zhang Fei [5] forward.
"His name is Zhang Fei, Grandpa."
Zhang Fei [5] cupped his hand to Shu Yuangu.
"Greetings, Senior.
If I may ask, why did you ask Yuyan to bring me here?"

"I’ll show you a place, but you can’t go in there now, and you have to evolve into a ten-tailed fox first to be able to enter it." Zhang Fei [5] and the others looked confused, but a hole appeared beneath the Ancient Treant Spirit.
However, it only lasted a moment, and Shu Yuangu closed it again.
"Can you guess where it is?"
"The Lotus Limbo World."
"Yes." Su Yuangu nodded slightly.
"I’ve heard from the Giant Yin-Yang Tree about you, and it asked me to show you the entrance portal to the Lotus Limbo World.
Unfortunately, you’re still far from evolving into a ten-tailed fox, so you’ll have to wait a while longer to enter that place.
If you force your way in with your current strength, that woman will capture you and imprison you there, and you’ll never be able to get out for the rest of your life."
Naturally, Zhang Fei [5] was aware of his own strength, and Feng Yao had already explained to him a lot about the Lotus Limbo World and the woman who lived within.
Moreover, he didn’t know the exact situation inside that place, so he wouldn’t be so crazy as to enter that place with his current strength.
"Senior, you already know that my strength isn’t enough to enter that place, so what’s your purpose in showing me the portal now?"
"I don’t know the real reason, but the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus asked me to show you the portal to enter." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow.
"If you want a clear answer, you should go to the Ashen Lotus Monastery, and you can ask the two spirits directly."
"What kind of place is the Lotus Limbo World, Zhang Fei?" Beiming Youhuang asked him.
Jia Shengyun, Jia Lingzhu, and Jia Xianzu were also curious about the Lotus Limbo World, especially since they had never heard of such a place before.

chapters.title: Chapter 1495: Prepare For Seclusion
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen and displayed the Lotus Limbo World, as per the information Feng Yao had given him in the past. "The Lotus Limbo World is a stagnant pocket dimension where the Yin-Yang Lotus controls everything. As you can see for yourself, there is no land inside, and a boundless black lake stretches without boundaries. Countless souls wander above it, and they will devour the soul power of any living creature that enters it. Once you enter that place, you can never leave again, and you will eventually join them. The only living being that has ever managed to enter and exit the place safely is the ten-tailed fox, Hu Tianlang."
"Did Hu Tianlang really enter that place in the past?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at them. "In the past, Feng Yao obtained descriptions of that place from Hu Tianlang, and he was able to do so because he possessed the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique at that time. There, he met his rival—a woman who was also born from Yin and Yang, but she was not a living being, and she was the guardian of the Lotus Limbo World. I was his successor, but I did not inherit his physique, so I had to think hard about entering that place. Entering that place is easy, but getting out is really difficult, and I might never be able to get out if I go in there rashly."
Beiming Youhuang, Jia Shengyun, Jia Lingzhu, and Jia Xianzu looked at the qi screen, but they could only see vast darkness—both on the ground and in the air, with countless souls wandering there.

Zhang Fei [5] looked at Su Yuangu again. "Senior, does that mean the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus can send me there? Feng Yao once told me that the woman lives inside the Yin-Yang Lotus, so the lotus should connect the Ashen Lotus Monastery with the Lotus Limbo World, right?"
"Yes," Su Yuangu explained to him. "The Giant Yin-Yang Lotus you encountered in the Ashen Lotus Monastery is the main body, but it has bodies in two different places. Those places are—"
"The Lotus Luminous World was born from Yang, and the Lotus Limbo World was born from Yin."

Su Yuangu continued. "The Giant Yin-Yang Lotus can send you there, but I’m not sure it will because it’s still weak from the disturbance in the balance between Yin and Yang in the past; otherwise, it wouldn’t have asked me to show you the portal to the Lotus Limbo World."

"Well, that’s true." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "When I first met the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus, it was in a weak state, and there was a possibility that it would disappear. If the lotus disappeared, then the balance of Yin and Yang would be destroyed, potentially leading to the destruction of the universe. That’s why the lotus absorbed our Yin and Yang Qi to restore itself, but it hasn’t fully recovered yet, and it still needs a lot of Yin and Yang Qi to fully recover."
"Yes."
Jia Lingzhu then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "What is the Lotus Luminous World?

"I have never seen the Lotus Luminous World myself, but I heard from the two spirits of the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus that it is the opposite of the Lotus Limbo World." They looked at Zhang Fei [5] curiously, making him smile wryly. "According to them, that place is one where enlightened souls live, free from doubt and despair. They have the opportunity to be reincarnated, but they choose not to take that chance; instead, they prefer to live in that place because it is free from evil, burdens, and worldly emotions."
"The world without evil, burdens, and worldly emotions." Beiming Youhuang and the others muttered to themselves.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "Simply put, the Lotus Luminous World is nirvana, and the Lotus Limbo World is hell. For now, our task is to help the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus recover to prevent an imbalance in Yin and Yang; otherwise, this universe will collapse because it is made up of Yin and Yang."
"How can we help the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus?" Beiming Youhuang asked.

"Hahaha." Jia Yuyan laughed at her question. "Senior Youhuang, the easy way is for us to dual cultivate and dual soul cultivate within the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus, and it will slowly absorb our qi and soul power. We had seclusion in the Ashen Lotus Monastery two months ago, and the results were quite amazing."

Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu slapped their foreheads because their granddaughter had changed so much after she got married, and she was becoming increasingly shameless about talking about such things.

"Unfortunately, you don’t have a partner, so you can’t join us to help the lotus." Jia Yuyan glanced at Jia Xianzu. "How about you pair up with Senior Xianzu, Senior Youhuang? You’re both fairies, and you guys don’t have partners either. Moreover, you’re both old friends, so I think it would be beneficial if you two became a couple."
Beiming Youhuang shook her in response. "Xianzu and I have never been interested in marriage, and the two of us will spend our entire lives with our cultivation."

"Hahaha." Jia Xianzu laughed as he rubbed his long beard. "I’ve lived on the run for too long, and I’ve grown accustomed to solitude. Right now, I’ve lost all desire for worldly emotions, and I only want to focus on my cultivation to reach the Celestial God Realm."

Jiya Yuyan could only shake her head after listening to their words. "Back then, I thought the same as you two, but I changed after I met my husband, and I truly enjoy my life now. Besides, we can still pursue our cultivation even if we’re married, and our cultivation progress is much faster if we cultivate together with our partners."
Beiming Youhuang and Jia Xianzu chose not to comment on that, and they asked Zhang Fei [5] to send them back into his soul world because there was still much to be done there.

After he sent them into his soul world, Zhang Fei [5] spoke to Su Yuangu again. "For now, I am not ready to go to the Lotus Limbo World because my cultivation is still at the Celestial King Realm, but I will go there after my cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm in the future, and I will meet women. At that time, I will definitely need your help to go there, Senior."

"When you are ready to go to the Lotus Limbo World, you can come to me again, and I will send you there." Su Yuangu then warned him. "However, you must be careful with that woman because she is not a living being, and she can drain your body of Yin and Yang Qi. If that happens, you will die there, and no one will be able to save this universe."

"I know." Zhang Fei [5] would never take the matter lightly because Feng Yao had already reminded him about that woman, and Su Yuangu had also warned him again. "In that case, I’ll bring Yuyan back, and we’ll enter seclusion for some time. I plan to come out of seclusion once all my wives’ cultivation reaches the Celestial King Realm, but I might extend our seclusion if my cultivation hasn’t broken through to the Celestial Emperor Realm by then."

Su Yuangu nodded at him. "Cultivation cannot be rushed, and you must take one step at a time. If you do it in a hurry, you may face problems in your cultivation, and you may find it difficult to develop in the future."

"Thank you for your advice." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu. "Grandfather! Grandmother! I will take Yuyan away now, and I will bring her to visit you two after we complete our seclusion."
Jia Lingzhu nodded to Zhang Fei [5] and hugged Jia Yuyan. "You two have been married for so long, and I hope you two will give us a great-grandchild soon."

"Hehehe." Jia Yuyan giggled and hugged her grandmother back. "Grandma, I really want to give you a great-grandchild, but my husband isn’t ready for children yet. When he’s ready, I’ll ask him to impregnate me, and you can retire to raise our future child."

Jia Lingzhu nodded in understanding and released her granddaughter from her arms. "No problem, I’ll wait until Zhang Fei is truly ready to be a father. When you two have children, your grandfather and I will retire from our race, and we will enjoy your life with our great-grandchild."

"Yes." Jia Yuyan then looked at her grandfather and briefly hugged him. "Grandpa, I don’t know how long we will be in seclusion, but you can go to the Moonlit Passion Temple if our race gets into trouble, and the sect people will inform us about it."
Jia Shengyun patted her head. "Our race has found peace again, and I hope our peace will last for a long time. For now, you just need to focus on your cultivation, and we will wait for your return."
"Yes, Grandpa." Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] took Jia Yuyan away from the Radiance Domain for the Ice Phoenix Domain.
Jia Shengyun then asked Su Yuangu, "Senior, do you think Zhang Fei can really enter the Lotus Limbo World and come back out?"
"Zhang Fei is the destined one, so he will be able to do it."
"I see." Jia Shengyun nodded in understanding. "In that case, my wife and I won’t disturb you any longer, and we will return now."
"Yes."
