chapters.title: Chapter 1496: Picking Up Three Women
paragraphs: Tian Liefeng looked confused when Tian Qiye returned with an angry expression, especially after Zhang Fei [5] chased her away from the Twin Flames Main Domain. In the paradise realm, no one had ever dared to treat her like that.

However, Zhang Fei [5] was different from Tian Qiye’s previous impressions, and he didn’t hesitate to chase her away, even though he was much weaker than her. Under normal circumstances, she would have used any means to force him to admit his identity as a demon, but she had to think twice about doing that to him, especially with his close relationship with Feng Yao.
Tian Liefeng looked at Tian Yaoqin with a questioning gaze, but she didn’t want to say anything to him. "Did something happen at the Moonlit Passion Temple, Leader?"

"Zhang Fei is a demon." Tian Qiye’s answer shocked Tian Liefeng. "However, I’ve never met a demon who can use the light element and light domain before, and his light element is stronger and purer than mine. I’m not mistaken about his demon aura and scent, but my abilities don’t work against him because he possesses the light element."

Tian Liefeng thought seriously about Zhang Fei because he had never met a demon who possessed the light element, let alone one that could use the light domain. Moreover, Tian Qiye has already reached the Celestial God Realm, and her rank has also reached the True Divine Rank, so her light element is powerful enough to injure demons or even kill them. "Do you think we should do something about him and the sect, Leader?"

"Do you think Empress Huo will let us do that?" Tian Qiye turned the question around by shaking her head. "She has declared that the Moonlit Passion Temple is under her protection, and she said that she will attack anyone who dares to disturb the sect and all its inhabitants. She has never done such a thing in the past, but all the cultivators in this realm have long known that she never jokes with her words, so we will face her and her subordinates if we do that. My cultivation has indeed reached this stage, but I realize that I am no match for the woman who has experienced the reincarnation process and regained her past strength."

"There are rumors in other domains that Empress Huo is Zhang Fei’s wife." Tian Liefeng and Tian Qiye looked at Tian Yaoqin in shock. "I haven’t confirmed the truth of the rumors, but people say that the news came from her mother, so it must be true. If the news were false, there’s no way she would protect him and the Moonlit Passion Temple to such lengths."

Although she didn’t know the truth of the rumors, Tian Qiye believed that they had such a relationship; otherwise, Feng Yao wouldn’t have publicly announced her desire to protect the Moonlit Passion Temple, and she even threatened other cultivators not to mess with the sect.

Tian Qiye let out a soft sigh before speaking to them again. "For now, we don’t need to look for trouble with them because we’ve never heard of Zhang Fei committing any crimes as a demon, and he also has relationships with many cultivators from various races, including Empress Huo and the Golden Dragon Emperor. If we provoke him and his sect, we will have to face the wrath of many people, and we won’t be able to face them."
"Yes." Tian Liefeng agreed with that.

Tian Qiye looked at them thoughtfully. "I want you guys to enter seclusion, and you must reach the Celestial God Realm. Once you all reach that stage, we won’t have to fear Long Wuzhao and Empress Huo, and I’ll think of a way to expose Zhang Fei’s identity then."

"Do we need to inform Tian Yizu and the others about this matter?" Tian Qiye immediately rejected Tian Liefeng’s idea because she didn’t want them to reach that stage too early, and she wanted to solidify his position as the leader of the Winged Race first. "In that case, I will leave now, and I will enter into seclusion together with Tian Hanyun and the others."

Tian Yaoqin also left the place while thinking about the best way to leave the Radiance Domain without raising Tian Qiye’s suspicion; otherwise, she would face serious consequences if her leader discovered her relationship with Zhang Fei, which could result in severe punishment.

After her two subordinates left, Tian Qiye immediately returned to her private room and meditated there, but she couldn’t shake the feeling that Zhang Fei was a demon. She got a hunch that he would be a dangerous cultivator for her race in the future, and she had to prepare something to hinder him, or her race would fall into his control.

Tian You’an and Tian Xuanyin walked into a room, where Tian Yizu and Tian Wei were discussing something. "I don’t know what exactly happened, but our leader just ordered the grand elders on her side to go into seclusion, and she didn’t tell us about this matter."
"Do you need to be surprised by that, Xuanyin?" Tian Yizu asked.
Tian Wei spoke. "Our leader has been itching to get rid of us, but she doesn’t dare do it openly because three-quarters of our race members side with Ancestor Huangjin."
"No." Tian Xuanyin answered Tian Wei with a shake of her head. "Do you two know what happened to our leader?"

"She and Tian Yaoqin had previously visited the Moonlit Passion Temple, but her meeting with Zhang Fei did not go smoothly." Tian Yizu immediately explained to Tian You’an and Tian Xuanyin the details of their previous meeting. "I’m sure she won’t give up so easily, but she also won’t dare to attack the sect rashly because she already knows that Empress Huo is protecting it. She is strong, as her cultivation is in the Celestial God Realm, but she will die if she fights against Empress Huo."
The two women naturally knew that Tian Qiye wouldn’t dare to fight Feng Yao. "So, what do you two think?"

"What else?" Tian Wei stood up. "Our leader has long wanted to eliminate us, and she deliberately didn’t tell us about her orders to all the grand elders under her. Of course, we can’t let that happen, so we will also enter seclusion to increase our strength, and we must reach the Celestial God Realm before them."

After he said that, Tian Wei immediately walked out of the room, followed by Tian You’an and Tian Xuanyi. Tian Yizu released a soft sigh and contacted his daughter, asking her not to leave their domain as long as he and the other grand elder were in seclusion.

Tian Yizu then left the place and returned to his private place to practice seclusion, but he felt that the situation within their race would get out of control soon, mainly because of Tian Qiye’s ambition to get rid of him and the other grand elders.

Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived at the Ice Phoenix Domain, but Jia Yuyan was not with him because he sent her into the training space, as he was not sure she would be able to withstand the extreme cold in the domain.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to the deepest part of the domain, which was a vast expanse of ice fields. He saw Zhang Yue, Feng Xueling, and Feng Jinqiu cultivating seriously. He could sense that the ice element in their bodies had become much stronger than last time, especially the last two women.
Unlike Zhang Yue, Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu had been focused on cultivating in the Ice Phoenix Domain for several months, and they had never left the domain since then.
The three women immediately opened their eyes as soon as Zhang Fei [5] called them in their minds. Zhang Yue directly asked him. "Are you going to take us into seclusion again, Fei’er?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "This place is indeed useful for improving your ice body technique, but it can’t help you improve your cultivation. Even if you guys use my yang qi, you can’t cultivate as fast as in my training space. Therefore, I came here to take you guys there, and we won’t be leaving for a few years."
"Alright, I will follow you." Zhang Yue unhesitatingly agreed with that.

"What about you two?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu, seeing the hesitation in their gazes. "Do you two want to focus on your ice body cultivation for now? If you focus on that, your cultivation will lag behind the others, unless you use a clone technique like mine."

Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu naturally wanted that, but Zhang Fei [5] had already explained to them that his clone technique was part of his demon identity, preventing him from sharing it with others. He had taught them the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique long ago, but that technique was completely different from his clone technique, and their avatars could not cultivate as quickly as his clones.

After they thought about it, Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu chose to improve their cultivation first rather than their body cultivation, so they immediately withdrew their avatars. "We will continue our cultivation in your pavilion."

Zhang Fei [5] was naturally pleased with Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu’s decision, and he sent the three women into the training space. However, he did not join them, and he left the Ice Phoenix Domain for the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain to meet Long Wuzhao.

sentences.text: Tian Liefeng looked confused when Tian Qiye returned with an angry expression, especially after Zhang Fei [5] chased her away from the Twin Flames Main Domain.
In the paradise realm, no one had ever dared to treat her like that.
However, Zhang Fei [5] was different from Tian Qiye’s previous impressions, and he didn’t hesitate to chase her away, even though he was much weaker than her.

Under normal circumstances, she would have used any means to force him to admit his identity as a demon, but she had to think twice about doing that to him, especially with his close relationship with Feng Yao.
Tian Liefeng looked at Tian Yaoqin with a questioning gaze, but she didn’t want to say anything to him.
"Did something happen at the Moonlit Passion Temple, Leader?"
"Zhang Fei is a demon." Tian Qiye’s answer shocked Tian Liefeng.
"However, I’ve never met a demon who can use the light element and light domain before, and his light element is stronger and purer than mine.
I’m not mistaken about his demon aura and scent, but my abilities don’t work against him because he possesses the light element."
Tian Liefeng thought seriously about Zhang Fei because he had never met a demon who possessed the light element, let alone one that could use the light domain.
Moreover, Tian Qiye has already reached the Celestial God Realm, and her rank has also reached the True Divine Rank, so her light element is powerful enough to injure demons or even kill them.
"Do you think we should do something about him and the sect, Leader?"
"Do you think Empress Huo will let us do that?" Tian Qiye turned the question around by shaking her head.
"She has declared that the Moonlit Passion Temple is under her protection, and she said that she will attack anyone who dares to disturb the sect and all its inhabitants.
She has never done such a thing in the past, but all the cultivators in this realm have long known that she never jokes with her words, so we will face her and her subordinates if we do that.
My cultivation has indeed reached this stage, but I realize that I am no match for the woman who has experienced the reincarnation process and regained her past strength."
"There are rumors in other domains that Empress Huo is Zhang Fei’s wife." Tian Liefeng and Tian Qiye looked at Tian Yaoqin in shock.
"I haven’t confirmed the truth of the rumors, but people say that the news came from her mother, so it must be true.
If the news were false, there’s no way she would protect him and the Moonlit Passion Temple to such lengths."

Although she didn’t know the truth of the rumors, Tian Qiye believed that they had such a relationship; otherwise, Feng Yao wouldn’t have publicly announced her desire to protect the Moonlit Passion Temple, and she even threatened other cultivators not to mess with the sect.
Tian Qiye let out a soft sigh before speaking to them again.

"For now, we don’t need to look for trouble with them because we’ve never heard of Zhang Fei committing any crimes as a demon, and he also has relationships with many cultivators from various races, including Empress Huo and the Golden Dragon Emperor.
If we provoke him and his sect, we will have to face the wrath of many people, and we won’t be able to face them."
"Yes." Tian Liefeng agreed with that.
Tian Qiye looked at them thoughtfully.
"I want you guys to enter seclusion, and you must reach the Celestial God Realm.
Once you all reach that stage, we won’t have to fear Long Wuzhao and Empress Huo, and I’ll think of a way to expose Zhang Fei’s identity then."

"Do we need to inform Tian Yizu and the others about this matter?" Tian Qiye immediately rejected Tian Liefeng’s idea because she didn’t want them to reach that stage too early, and she wanted to solidify his position as the leader of the Winged Race first.
"In that case, I will leave now, and I will enter into seclusion together with Tian Hanyun and the others."

Tian Yaoqin also left the place while thinking about the best way to leave the Radiance Domain without raising Tian Qiye’s suspicion; otherwise, she would face serious consequences if her leader discovered her relationship with Zhang Fei, which could result in severe punishment.
After her two subordinates left, Tian Qiye immediately returned to her private room and meditated there, but she couldn’t shake the feeling that Zhang Fei was a demon.
She got a hunch that he would be a dangerous cultivator for her race in the future, and she had to prepare something to hinder him, or her race would fall into his control.
Tian You’an and Tian Xuanyin walked into a room, where Tian Yizu and Tian Wei were discussing something.
"I don’t know what exactly happened, but our leader just ordered the grand elders on her side to go into seclusion, and she didn’t tell us about this matter."
"Do you need to be surprised by that, Xuanyin?" Tian Yizu asked.
Tian Wei spoke.
"Our leader has been itching to get rid of us, but she doesn’t dare do it openly because three-quarters of our race members side with Ancestor Huangjin."
"No." Tian Xuanyin answered Tian Wei with a shake of her head.
"Do you two know what happened to our leader?"

"She and Tian Yaoqin had previously visited the Moonlit Passion Temple, but her meeting with Zhang Fei did not go smoothly." Tian Yizu immediately explained to Tian You’an and Tian Xuanyin the details of their previous meeting.
"I’m sure she won’t give up so easily, but she also won’t dare to attack the sect rashly because she already knows that Empress Huo is protecting it.
She is strong, as her cultivation is in the Celestial God Realm, but she will die if she fights against Empress Huo."
The two women naturally knew that Tian Qiye wouldn’t dare to fight Feng Yao.
"So, what do you two think?"
"What else?" Tian Wei stood up.
"Our leader has long wanted to eliminate us, and she deliberately didn’t tell us about her orders to all the grand elders under her.
Of course, we can’t let that happen, so we will also enter seclusion to increase our strength, and we must reach the Celestial God Realm before them."
After he said that, Tian Wei immediately walked out of the room, followed by Tian You’an and Tian Xuanyi.
Tian Yizu released a soft sigh and contacted his daughter, asking her not to leave their domain as long as he and the other grand elder were in seclusion.

Tian Yizu then left the place and returned to his private place to practice seclusion, but he felt that the situation within their race would get out of control soon, mainly because of Tian Qiye’s ambition to get rid of him and the other grand elders.

Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived at the Ice Phoenix Domain, but Jia Yuyan was not with him because he sent her into the training space, as he was not sure she would be able to withstand the extreme cold in the domain.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to the deepest part of the domain, which was a vast expanse of ice fields.
He saw Zhang Yue, Feng Xueling, and Feng Jinqiu cultivating seriously.
He could sense that the ice element in their bodies had become much stronger than last time, especially the last two women.
Unlike Zhang Yue, Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu had been focused on cultivating in the Ice Phoenix Domain for several months, and they had never left the domain since then.
The three women immediately opened their eyes as soon as Zhang Fei [5] called them in their minds.
Zhang Yue directly asked him.
"Are you going to take us into seclusion again, Fei’er?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"This place is indeed useful for improving your ice body technique, but it can’t help you improve your cultivation.
Even if you guys use my yang qi, you can’t cultivate as fast as in my training space.
Therefore, I came here to take you guys there, and we won’t be leaving for a few years."
"Alright, I will follow you." Zhang Yue unhesitatingly agreed with that.
"What about you two?" Zhang Fei [5] asked Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu, seeing the hesitation in their gazes.
"Do you two want to focus on your ice body cultivation for now?
If you focus on that, your cultivation will lag behind the others, unless you use a clone technique like mine."

Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu naturally wanted that, but Zhang Fei [5] had already explained to them that his clone technique was part of his demon identity, preventing him from sharing it with others.
He had taught them the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique long ago, but that technique was completely different from his clone technique, and their avatars could not cultivate as quickly as his clones.
After they thought about it, Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu chose to improve their cultivation first rather than their body cultivation, so they immediately withdrew their avatars.
"We will continue our cultivation in your pavilion."
Zhang Fei [5] was naturally pleased with Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu’s decision, and he sent the three women into the training space.
However, he did not join them, and he left the Ice Phoenix Domain for the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain to meet Long Wuzhao.

chapters.title: Chapter 1497: Artificial Doll
paragraphs: "What brings you here?" Long Wuzhao asked this question as soon as Zhang Fei appeared in his palace.

"Emperor Long, I will probably be in seclusion for quite some time, so I hope you can help me monitor the movements of the four perils. Their real bodies were in the tunnel, but they left their avatars in their domain before they left." Long Wuzhao was not surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s decision. "All my women’s cultivations have stabilized now, so it’s time for me to help them improve their cultivation, and I hope I can help them break through to the Celestial King Realm as soon as possible. After they break through to that stage, and my cultivation breaks through to the Celestial Emperor Realm, I will bring them back to my sect."
"Are you only thinking about the four perils but not the other races?"

"Not really." Zhang Fei [5] answered with a shake of his head. "Honestly, I still think about Tian Qiye because she can sense my demon aura and scent; however, I’m confident that she won’t seek trouble with me anytime soon, so I try not to dwell on her. Human and demihuman races won’t dare to look for trouble with my sect because Feng Yao has long announced that it is under her protection. The natural races tend to be more peaceful, and the beast races are under your control, so I don’t need to worry about them."
"What about the demon races?"

"Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze are my slaves, so the Nine Nether Demon Race is under my control. Nalan Shizhe, Qi Qingxiu, and Ye Mingran are on my side, but I can’t guess Wu Mian’s plans." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer made Long Wuzhao smile bitterly because the young man in front of him could do many things in a short time, but he couldn’t do all that for years, even though he was the dragon king and much stronger than him. "Mo Shentian is trapped in the tunnel, and he won’t be back anytime soon. I don’t know when Shang Zhanluo will emerge from his seclusion, but one of my clones is currently monitoring him in his domain. The other demon races haven’t acted yet, and I won’t look to trouble them either."

Long Wuzhao nodded in understanding. "I don’t know what’s happening with the other demon races, but I have a feeling that they’re waiting for something, and they’ll make their move when the time comes."

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] had long thought about the matter because the other demon races should already know the situation in the Celestial Demon Domain and the Slaughter Blood Domain. However, they still hadn’t shown any movement, and Wu Mian was still keeping an eye on them all. "For now, I don’t want to think about them, and I will focus on helping all my wives break through to the Celestial King Realm, so they will be better prepared to face any changes that might occur in our situation."
"I will monitor the four perils, but how can I inform you if there is any movement from the four of them?"
"Feng Yao."
"Empress Huo?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "Yes, you can contact her, and she will convey your message to me."
"Alright, I will inform Empress Huo if there are any changes regarding the four perils."
"Thank you." Zhang Fei [5] opened a gate and disappeared inside.
A void gate opened beside Long Wuzhao, and Long Xukong walked out of it. "How much time does that kid need to break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm, Brother Wuzhao?"

"I can’t estimate the exact time, but he will probably break through to that stage in three or five years." Long Xukong looked at Long Wuzhao in disbelief. "You may not have noticed, but I can feel Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran’s auras on his body, which means that the two female demon gods have fallen into his arms."

"That kid is insane!" Long Xukong took a deep breath afterward. "If Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran have really fallen into his arms, that means only Nalan Shizhe is left. However, she is his mother-in-law, so I’m not sure he will take her as his wife."

"Hahaha." Long Wuzhao laughed. "Have you forgotten Little Shengjie’s story about him? He took his mother, grandmother, and two sisters as his wives, remember? Then, what would stop him from taking his mother-in-law as his wife?"
Long Xukong sighed. "I still can’t believe that Tianshi Shengjie would fall in love with a man like him, and I’m sure they’ll be husband and wife soon."
"Let’s see the results in the near future, Brother Xukong."

After leaving the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Zhang Fei [5] did not immediately return to the Moonlit Passion Sect; instead, he went to the Radiance Domain and used his invisibility ability to avoid Tian Qiye’s detection.

Zhang Fei [5] thought of a way to take Tian Yaoqin away from the domain without Tian Qiye’s knowledge, as he needed her yin qi to help him break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm. He could have taken her away without thinking anything, but his actions would only bring trouble for both of them in the future, and her leader would likely punish her after she returned from seclusion. "Is there anything I can use so that woman doesn’t know about her leaving, Mei?"

[There have been many new items in the Shop in the past two decades, but you never checked them out, except for alchemy-related items, Master. I will buy an item now, and you can replace Tian Youqin with it, so Tian Qiye won’t notice that she went with you.]
{You got artificial doll x1.}
{1,000,000,000,000 has been deducted from your balance.}
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow after the two notifications appeared. "Artificial doll? What’s the function of that doll, Mei?"
[Master, you should go see Tian Yaoqin now, and you will find out the function of the doll later.]

Zhang Fei [5] was curious about it, but he couldn’t get close to the main area of the domain because he was afraid that Tian Qiye would notice his presence if he got too close to her. He contacted Tian Yaoqin and asked her to meet him at a location slightly far from the area, preventing her leader from knowing his presence.
Zhang Fei [5] left the area and went to a remote location to avoid Tian Qiye’s detection, waiting for Tian Yaoqin to come to see him.

Zhang Fei [5] had to wait quite a long time because Tian Yaoqin couldn’t carelessly leave her place, mainly because of Tian Qiye. He had to wait an hour for her to come to that location, and he immediately took her into an invisible state.

"Are you crazy? What if my leader notices your presence?" Tian Yaoqin asked in an annoyed tone because Zhang Fei [5] was too careless. "If she finds out about our relationship, she will punish me severely, and she will also hunt you down, which will make your sect members suffer."
Zhang Fei [5] just smiled and took out the artificial doll, surprising Tian Yaoqin. "For now, I need some of your body parts, and you don’t have to worry that Tian Qiye will notice you’re gone."
"Some of my body parts?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Your hair and blood."

Although she was confused by it, Tian Yaoqin immediately cut off a bit of her hair and extracted some of her blood before handing both to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately put them into the doll. A few minutes later, she was stunned when the doll transformed into her, and she observed it with extreme seriousness, but it didn’t move an inch. "Where did you get this doll? How did it turn into me? Why doesn’t it move?"

"This doll is an artificial doll, and it can transform into anyone using that person’s hair and blood." Tian Yaoqin looked at Zhang Fei [5] curiously, but he didn’t want to explain anything to her about the system. So far, only Zhang Lin and Zhang Chen already know about the system and Mei, but he still has no intention of telling his other wives. "To move this doll, inject a bit of your consciousness and soul power into it, and this doll will replace your position in your race."
"Will my leader really not notice that I’m gone?"
"Try it first, and you can see the results for yourself."

Tian Yaoqin was still hesitant about leaving with him, and she was truly afraid that Tian Qiye would discover her departure. She touched the doll’s chest and channeled her soul power into it, along with a bit of her consciousness.

Tian Yaoqin then followed Zhang Fei [5]’s instructions, but she was truly surprised when she did, mainly because the doll moved according to her wishes. Besides, she could sense that the doll’s aura and cultivation matched her own, and she was confident that no one, including her leader, would be able to recognize her. "How could this be possible?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at her reaction. "We’ve known each other for a while, and we’ve even slept together, but you still don’t know anything about me. However, everything will change after today, and you’ll get to know me better in the future. You should send this doll back to your private quarters now, and I’ll take you to my private quarters to begin our seclusion."
"Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 1498: Enter Seclusion Again
paragraphs: After Tian Yaoqin sent her doll back to the main area, Zhang Fei [5] sent her into the training space to join the others, and he went to another domain afterward.

A while later, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, and Feng Yao protected him by disguising his aura so that the avatars of the four perils could not detect his presence. He hurriedly went to the pond where Dong Xuanyin lived to pick her up because her soul power was already quite high, and he needed her help to break through to the perfection stage of the Divine Soul Level.

Dong Xuanyin was too lazy to meet Zhang Fei [5] because he always behaved as he pleased, but she had already experienced the benefits of dual soul cultivation with him. The results were really satisfying for her, even though her soul power was still far from breaking through.

As soon as Dong Xuanyin appeared in front of him, Zhang Fei [5] immediately grabbed her shoulder and sent her into the training space, and he left the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain to return to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

When Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the Moonlit Passion Temple, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling had already finished giving some directions to the elders regarding his desire to increase the number of disciples.
Zhang Fei [5] did not immediately take them into the training space, but he met with all those closest to him and invited them to enter seclusion.
However, not all of them intended to join Zhang Fei [5], except Jing Qiuyue, Meng Guanqiu, and Meng Qi.
Jing Qiuyue had been pondering the effects of the mirror for the past month, and she decided to give up on her feelings for Qiao Liangren because he never loved her.

Zhang Fei [5] had no problem with Jing Qiuyue’s desire to join them, but he did not immediately accept his senior sister as his woman. Although his senior sister had decided to forget Qiao Liangren, he knew that it would never be easy for her to do so because her feelings for his senior brother were hundreds of years old.
Zhang Fei [5] brought Meng Guanqiu and Meng Qi with him for several reasons, but he had no intention of taking them as his women, even though Feng Jiu had long advised him to take the latter as one.

When Xin Yanluo came out of the dimensional rift, Zhang Fei [5] asked her to inform her master that the situation was safe. After receiving this information, Ju Yingzhi immediately brought out all the demons hiding in her dimensional rift.
Zhang Fei [5] offered Xin Yanluo, Ju Yingzhi, Qian Ying, and Tang Ying to join him in seclusion, which the three female demons immediately agreed to.
Apart from the three female demons, Zhang Fei [5] also sent Wang Yin, Nong Qinhua, Bian Luosha, Yan Huanying, and Dong Binghua into the training space.

Zhang Fei [5] had never brought Wang Yin, Nong Qinhua, Bian Luosha, Yan Huanying, and Dong Binghua into his training space because he was worried that Yuan Xiajie had left something inside them, allowing her to infiltrate it. However, Feng Yao told him that he didn’t need to worry about her, and the five female demons were already completely free from her control.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] went to see Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng, asking them to protect the sect while he was in seclusion. He also met with the natural races there, asking them to build residences for several clans who had decided to move or were going to send their members to the domain.
After everything was finished, Zhang Fei [5] brought Yan Jinwu, Sima Huiqing, Qing Qiu’er, and You Feiling into the training space.

At the training ground, Tian Yaoqin felt uneasy because so many female demons were training there, especially the presence of Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, and Nalan Shizhe, who were enemies of the Winged Race.
